info.title: USTariffRates API
info.summary: Provenance-rich US tariff lookup, landed-duty calculation, and customs entry audit — every response cites the Federal Register / Executive Order authority for any overlay applied.
info.description:
USTariffRates exposes a small set of focused endpoints designed for both human integrators and LLM agents:

- **`/v1/lookup`** — current rate stack for an HTS code, with `as_of` retroactive lookups.
- **`/v1/search`** — HTS search by description, exact code, or prefix, returning the same canonical response envelope.
- **`/v1/bulk`** — canonical multi-row HTS lookup and description matching with confidence and alternates.
- **`/v1/calculate`** — landed-duty calculation (base MFN + Section 122 + 232 + 301 + MPF + HMF).
- **`/v1/audit/entry`** — line-by-line audit of a 7501 entry against current rates.

Every response includes a `provenance[]` array with the Federal Register cite and effective date for any tariff overlay applied — so any agent or auditor can trace a number back to its legal authority without leaving the response.

**Authentication.** The first 50 requests/month from any IP are anonymous and unauthenticated; past that, supply an API key via `X-Api-Key`, `Authorization: Bearer …`, or `?api_key=…`. Tier caps are enforced server-side.

**Hosted MCP.** Connect an MCP client to `https://mcp.ustariffrates.com` and send a customer API key with `Authorization: Bearer …` or `X-Api-Key`. The hosted server exposes seven curated tariff workflows without requiring a local package. MCP usage is authorized and billed to the customer account behind that key under its existing plan, quota, and overage rules. Autonomous wallet payments are not enabled for v1.

get.description: Lists presentation definitions only for installed reviewed cases. Availability is not shipment qualification or current-date coverage. Dates remain bounded per case. Does not return rates, company assignments or executable rules. Zero API credits, including unavailable definitions. Requires an active authorized key even when billable credits are exhausted. No evaluation capacity, bonus/top-up credit or overage charge. Limited to 60 definition requests per account or organization per minute, shared across both definition GETs. Screening and assessment POSTs remain metered. No automatic browser prefetch.

post.summary: Current CBP cash-deposit rate for a case, party and entry date
post.description: Selects the CBP cash-deposit rate for one AD/CVD case from reviewed CBP instruction histories: the exporter's listed combination with the producer or its own exporter rate first, then a company rate listed as producer and/or exporter, then the all-others (country-wide) rate, which applies only when both parties are named and neither holds its own rate in a complete reviewed history. Every selection cites the governing CBP message (identifier, number, publication date, URL and SHA-256 of the message body) and its effective dates; where the CBP history has no readable order instruction, the all-others rate may come from the order notice read in full, cited by its Federal Register document number, citation and text hash. Refusals are explicit: unlisted combinations, unreadable or unreviewed later instructions, dates outside the reviewed history or past the last verification, and cases without a reviewed history. Merchandise scope is not evaluated. Deposits are estimates, never final assessed duties. Successful requests use the existing lookup allowance and overage policy.

post.description: Resolves server-owned reviewed cases from declared entry facts. A complete result covers only the requested registered cases, not all potentially applicable orders. Amounts are estimated cash deposits, never final assessed duties or total import charges. Missing evidence, source gaps and unknown company assignments do not become zero. Returns 503 until reviewed case data is available. Successful requests use the existing lookup allowance and overage policy. Omitting knowledge_as_of uses retrospective interpretation of the latest reviewed evidence. For orders decided from the written scope and the reviewed CBP cash-deposit instructions, merchandise inside the scope takes the CBP rate for the declared parties: give the facts exporter and producer exactly as the CBP instruction lists them, and exporter_country when the answer asks for it.

assessment_scope.description: Evaluate every case in the maintained Commerce orders, investigations and revoked-orders inventory. Omit case_numbers. Missing scope programs remain explicit unavailable cases; current inventory is not exhaustive historical coverage. Requires authority evidence availability.

get.description: CBP CROSS rulings as classification evidence, stated as CBP publishes them. A ruling binds only the merchandise and party it was issued for; it is not a classification of your goods. Later rulings are listed as CBP lists them, and a ruling with no later ruling listed is not thereby in force. Successful requests consume one API request under the key's existing quota/overage policy. Provide hts and/or q.

Later rulings are listed as CBP lists them, and a ruling with no later ruling listed is not thereby in force. Successful requests consume one API request under the key's existing quota/overage policy.

post.summary: Assess tariffs, AD/CVD candidates and requirements for one entry
post.description: Customer API key required. One successful request consumes one lookup under existing quota and overage rules, not one per case or requirement. Uses the canonical resolvers and server-owned evidence. Only the classification, origin and entry date are required. Without customs_value_usd, every ad valorem amount, subtotal and MPF/HMF estimate is null, the rate expressions are returned unchanged and the customs value is listed in the missing calculation inputs; it is never assumed to be zero. Without requirement_facts, every requirement family that depends on them stays pending with its questions and missing facts; an unknown answer is never treated as no. Adding the value or answers later changes the entry fingerprint and fills in the dependent results under the same rules. Classification identifies the entry; it does not prove case or requirement applicability. Omitted orders are not cleared. This is not a full landed-cost calculation: Canonical ordinary/additional duty and standard MPF/HMF estimates are included alongside selected AD/CVD deposits. Supported declared Chapter 98 owner components are included when returned by the canonical tariff resolver; unsupported provisions, interactions, taxes and fee exemptions remain explicit. Exhaustive order coverage remains unproven. Requirements screening is not proof of fulfillment. Totals remain null. Missing AD/CVD inventory, reviewed determinations or requirement evidence remains explicit within a partial 200 result, preserving independently valid tariff and requirement results. Omitting case_numbers selects authority-inventory discovery in ranked pages of 20, without excluding unmatched origins, descriptions or revoked/investigated orders. Each page is a separate metered request; subtotals cover only that page, not earlier or later pages. Use next_cursor unchanged with the same entry to continue. Changed entries or inventory revisions require restarting; reaching the final inventory page does not establish legal coverage or clearance. Results identify their reviewed revisions but are not a pinned historical query; reruns may reflect new evidence. Requires renewed answers after reclassification.

identity_document_references.description: Customer-supplied digests and transcribed party names only; documents are not authenticated or independently verified.

items.description: One unverified customer-supplied identity document reference.

line_id.description: Caller line identity, bound into the assessment fingerprint.

hts_code.description: Ten-digit merchandise classification in chapters 01–97, optionally dotted. Not a Chapter 98 claim.

country.description: Origin name or supported ISO alias.

customs_value_usd.description: Full customs value in US dollars, not a Chapter 98 reduced basis. Must fit exact safe-cent arithmetic. Optional: omit when not yet known. It is never defaulted; value-based amounts stay null and the value is reported as a missing calculation input.

tariff_facts.description: Canonical tariff facts, including structured Chapter 98/99 declarations and evidence references. The complete validated declaration is bound to the entry fingerprint.

tariff_claims.description: Chapter 98/99 claims checked by the canonical tariff resolver. Unresolved Chapter 98 treatment is returned for review, not treated as an applied reduced value.

items.description: Chapter 98/99 heading, normalized and bound to this entry.

mode.description: Shipping mode for the standard fee estimate; bound into the entry fingerprint.

quantities.description: Exact reviewed-rate units, at most six decimal places; no conversions.

party_cases.description: Optional mapping from a requested order number to documented company-case identities. Presence selects maintained published deposits for that order after reviewed scope checks; unavailable published evidence never falls back to a reviewed rate. Omit to retain reviewed-rate selection. Requires published evidence availability.

additionalProperties.description: Exact party assignments for one requested order. Omitted identities require more information; null means documented as unassigned.

exporter_company_case_number.description: Exact company case assigned to the exporter under this order, or documented absence.

producer_company_case_number.description: Exact company case assigned to the producer under this order, or documented absence.

origin_exporter_company_case_number.description: Exact company case of the origin-country exporter, or documented absence.

combination_company_case_number.description: Exact exporter-producer combination assignment, or documented absence.

authorization_company_case_number.description: Exact Commerce-authorized company case for the entry, or documented absence; a pending request is not authorization.

assessment_scope.description: Optional explicit inventory discovery selector. Omitted case_numbers defaults to this scope. Cannot be combined with a nonempty explicit case list.

description.description: Product description used only for candidate ranking, not a written-scope determination or classification.

adcvd_cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous inventory page. Keep all entry declarations unchanged. Not a historical snapshot guarantee; changed inventory requires restarting.

case_numbers.description: Optional legacy selection of 1–20 official cases. Omit for authority-inventory discovery. An empty list is accepted only with assessment_scope authority_inventory.

items.description: Official AD or CVD case number, not the catalog's record identifier.

adcvd_facts.description: Documented merchandise/party answers; unknown facts stay omitted. Defaults to an empty object only when case_numbers is omitted.

food_facility_registration_history.description: Does the facility have an uncancelled registration record, has it never registered, or was its previous registration cancelled? This declaration does not verify registration validity.

food_facility_owner_changed.description: Has ownership of the registered facility changed? An operator change alone is not an ownership change.

food_facility_ceased_operations.description: Has the registered facility ceased operations?

food_facility_ceased_us_food.description: Has the registered facility ceased providing food for consumption in the United States?

food_facility_changed_information.description: Which previously submitted registration information changed? Report ownership changes separately; for multiple fields, any listed nonoptional field triggers an update.

food_facility_paper_update_incorrect.description: Was information in a previously submitted mail or fax registration update incorrect when submitted?

food_facility_electronic_waiver.description: Has FDA granted an electronic-submission waiver under 21 CFR 1.245? A pending request is not a granted waiver.

food_facility_submitter.description: Will the owner/operator/agent in charge submit, or a third party? Has the facility authorized that third party?

food_facility_activity.description: Does this facility manufacture/process, pack, or hold food for U.S. consumption under 21 CFR 1.225 and 1.227?

food_facility_location.description: Is the food facility domestic or foreign?

food_facility_registration_exception.description: Is any 21 CFR 1.226 registration exemption claimed (for example a qualifying farm, retail establishment, restaurant or foreign further-processing facility)?

fsvp_exception.description: Legacy summary of 21 CFR 1.501. Answer none only when no exemption or inapplicability applies; a claim is decided from the typed scope facts instead (purpose, USDA inspection, juice/seafood, alcohol).

fsvp_modified_requirements.description: Legacy summary of 21 CFR 1.511–1.513. Answer none only for the standard FSVP; a claim is decided from the typed route facts instead (dietary supplement, route election and eligibility).

food.description: Is this food for human or animal use under the FDA definition?

food_exception.description: Which specific prior-notice exception, if any, is supported by the shipment facts?

cpsc_finished_product.description: Is this a finished product rather than a component?

cpsc_rule_applies.description: Has a specific applicable CPSC safety rule, ban or standard been identified?

cpsc_certificate_exception.description: Does a supported rule-specific certificate exception apply? A testing exception alone is not enough.

children_product.description: Does this fall under the children's-product certification regime?

foreign_manufactured.description: Was the product manufactured outside the United States?

entry_type.description: Is the entry for consumption or warehousing?

ftz_withdrawal.description: Is this a withdrawal from a foreign-trade zone for consumption or warehousing?

cpsc_de_minimis_claimed.description: Is the de minimis duty exemption under 19 U.S.C. 1321(a)(2)(C) claimed for this shipment?

cpsc_noncommercial_gift.description: Is this a noncommercial product sent by a consumer abroad to a consumer in the United States, such as a gift, rather than a purchase or commercial shipment?

cpsc_other_entry_route.description: What is this entry, if not for consumption or warehousing: admission to a foreign-trade zone, in-bond transit or exportation, temporary importation under bond, withdrawal from a bonded warehouse, or another route?

chemical_form.description: Legacy declaration, still accepted; TSCA certification is now decided from the tsca_* product and shipment facts. Is the chemical imported in bulk, a mixture, or as part of an article?

tsca_scope.description: Legacy declaration, still accepted; TSCA certification is now decided from the tsca_* product and shipment facts. Is the chemical subject to TSCA or within a legally established exclusion?

tsca_exclusion_clearly_identified.description: Legacy declaration, still accepted; use tsca_exclusion_identified_on_entry. Is its excluded status clearly identified for entry?

tsca_article_rule_requires_certification.description: Legacy declaration, still accepted; TSCA certification is now decided from the tsca_* product and shipment facts. Does a specific TSCA rule or order require certification for this article?

fcc_import_purpose.description: Is the device being imported for testing/evaluation (FCC compliance, product development or marketing suitability), demonstration at an industry trade show, repair, exclusively for U.S. Government use, solely for export, or another purpose?

fcc_device_quantity_band.description: How many units of this particular device model and generation are being imported: 1–400, 401–4,000, or more than 4,000? Count distinctly different models and separate generations separately; do not split one model/generation into artificial groups.

fcc_sale_or_marketing.description: Will the device be offered for sale or marketed?

fcc_us_sale_or_marketing.description: Will the device be marketed or offered for sale in the United States?

rf_device.description: Is this a radio-frequency device within the FCC import rules?

fcc_import_exception.description: Are you claiming a specific exception under 47 CFR 2.1202?

wood_packaging.description: What wood packaging or dunnage accompanies the shipment? Select solid if ANY solid wood is present, including mixed packaging.

wood_all_pieces_thinner_than_6mm.description: Does EVERY solid wood packaging piece have at least one dimension strictly below 6 mm? Answer no if any piece has all dimensions 6 mm or greater.

wood_packaging_source_country.description: Is the wood packaging being imported from Canada, or from anywhere else?

wood_packaging_botanical_group.description: Which botanical group is the wood packaging made from? Rutaceae subfamilies Aurantioideae, Rutoideae and Toddalioideae, and Fraxinus (ash), are excluded from the Canadian general permit.

wood_packaging_harvest_country.description: Were the trees the wood packaging is derived from harvested in Canada?

wood_packaging_moved_outside_canada.description: Has this wood packaging been moved outside Canada since it was produced? Answer unverified if reuse, recycling or remanufacture means you cannot establish it.

wood_shipment_character.description: Is the shipment commercial or noncommercial?

wood_canada_harvest_declaration.description: What declaration of Canadian harvest accompanies the packaging at importation?

dod_packaging_nonregulated_articles.description: Legacy summary of 7 CFR 319.40-3(b)(4). It is no longer used to decide the mark; the Department of Defense exception is decided from wood_packaging_dod_use and wood_packaged_cargo_regulated_article.

motor_vehicle_or_equipment.description: Is the item legally a motor vehicle, motor vehicle equipment, or neither? nhtsa_article states the same from product facts and is asked instead when this answer is neither.

foreign_origin_article.description: Is this a foreign-origin article? Legal origin is not necessarily the shipment country.

article_marking_exception_claimed.description: Is a specific article-marking exception claimed? Container obligations may remain.

cbp_marking_notice.description: Has CBP issued Form 4647, or its electronic equivalent, requiring marking, redelivery, exportation or destruction?

cbp_marking_disposition.description: How was the CBP marking notice resolved: still pending, marked under CBP supervision, accepted certificate of marking, export under CBP supervision, or destruction under CBP supervision?

article_repacked_before_withdrawal.description: Before withdrawal for consumption, is the article repacked in a bonded warehouse (19 CFR 19.8), manipulated under 19 U.S.C. 1562 (19 CFR 19.11), or manipulated but not manufactured in a foreign-trade zone (19 CFR 146.32)?

retail_repacking_after_release.description: Will the article be repacked in retail containers, such as blister packs, after release from CBP custody? Answer readily_openable_container if the new container can readily be opened for inspection by the ultimate purchaser and bears no U.S. address or other potentially misleading marking.

us_name_in_trademark_or_souvenir.description: Does a U.S. city or location, "United States" or "America" appear on the article as part of a trademark, trade name or souvenir marking?

other_place_name_on_article.description: Apart from a U.S. name in a trademark, trade name or souvenir marking (asked separately), do the words "United States", "American" or "U.S.A." (or a variation), a U.S. city or location, or the name of a foreign country or locality other than where the article was made appear on the article or its container?

tsca_customs_territory_entry.description: Is the shipment being entered into the customs territory of the United States (entry for consumption or warehousing, or withdrawal from a foreign-trade zone)? Answer no for admission into a foreign-trade zone or in-bond movement that is not entered.

tsca_product_use.description: What is the product, as imported and as a whole, for? A pesticide for pesticidal use; tobacco or a tobacco product; source, special nuclear or byproduct material; an article subject to the federal excise tax on firearms and ammunition, or its shot-shell or cartridge components; a food, food additive, drug, cosmetic or device for that use; or any other use. Answer other for an excluded chemical blended into a mixture made for another use.

tsca_fluid_or_particles.description: Is the product a fluid (liquid, gas, paste or solution) or particles (powder, granules, pellets or flakes)?

tsca_formed_to_shape.description: Is the product a manufactured item formed to a specific shape or design during manufacture?

tsca_shape_dependent_end_use.description: Do its end-use functions depend in whole or in part on that shape or design?

tsca_end_use_composition_change.description: Does its chemical composition change during end use? Answer incidental_to_end_use only for a reaction on end use (as with adhesives, paints, fuels, batteries, matches or safety flares) whose product has no commercial purpose separate from the item and is not itself made for distribution in commerce or as an intermediate.

tsca_composition.description: Is the chemical a single chemical substance, or a combination of two or more chemical substances (a mixture)?

tsca_removed_from_container.description: Is the substance in containers used for transportation or containment, intended to be removed from them, with an end use or commercial purpose separate from the container?

tsca_exclusion_identified_on_entry.description: Do the entry documents clearly identify the chemical as that excluded product (a pesticide, tobacco product, nuclear material, taxed firearm or ammunition article, or a food, food additive, drug, cosmetic or device)?

tsca_cbp_action.description: Has CBP taken TSCA action on this shipment: none, detained, released under bond after detention, refused entry, or demanded redelivery of a bonded shipment?

tsca_refusal_disposition.description: What will the importer do with the refused shipment: export it, abandon it, or bring it into compliance for EPA to reassess?

food_import_purpose.description: Why is this food being imported: commercial or other use, transshipment through the United States to another country, processing and future export, research or evaluation, personal consumption, or return of food made or grown in the United States?

food_us_public_distribution.description: Is the food intended for retail sale, or will it be sold or distributed to the public in the United States?

research_food_label.description: Is the food labeled with the exact statement "Food for research or evaluation use"?

research_food_quantity_use_disposal.description: Is the food a small quantity consistent with a research, analysis or quality-assurance purpose, used only for that purpose, with any unused quantity properly disposed of?

research_food_entry_declaration.description: Will the entry filed with CBP carry an electronic declaration that the food will be used for research or evaluation and will not be sold or distributed to the public?

personal_food_quantity_noncommercial.description: Was the food purchased or otherwise acquired by a person in a small quantity consistent with a non-commercial purpose?

us_food_processed_abroad.description: Was this food made, raised or grown in the United States, exported, and further manufactured or processed in a foreign country before its return?

food_usda_inspection.description: At the time of importation, is the food a meat food product under the Federal Meat Inspection Act, a poultry product under the Poultry Products Inspection Act, or an egg product under the Egg Products Inspection Act, subject to USDA requirements? Answer none for food regulated only by FDA, including other egg-containing foods.

food_juice_seafood.description: Is the food juice, fish or a fishery product, or a raw material or ingredient you will use to make juice or fish and fishery products yourself?

juice_seafood_supplier_haccp.description: Is the foreign supplier required to comply with, and in compliance with, the juice (21 CFR part 120) or seafood (21 CFR part 123) HACCP regulation?

importer_juice_seafood_haccp_compliance.description: Are you in compliance with 21 CFR part 120 or part 123 for the juice or fish and fishery products you make from the imported ingredient?

food_alcohol_link.description: Is the food an alcoholic beverage, a non-alcoholic food from an alcoholic-beverage facility, or a raw material or ingredient you will use to make, pack or hold alcoholic beverages yourself?

alcohol_supplier_treasury_permit_type.description: Is the foreign supplier a facility of a type that, if domestic, would need a Treasury permit, registration or approved notice or application under the Federal Alcohol Administration Act or chapter 51 of the Internal Revenue Code?

alcohol_supplier_fda_registered_for_alco.description: Is the foreign supplier required to register with FDA as a food facility because it manufactures or processes alcoholic beverages?

non_alcoholic_food_prepackaged_no_contac.description: Is the non-alcoholic food in prepackaged form that prevents any direct human contact with it?

non_alcoholic_food_share_of_facility_sal.description: As determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, is the non-alcoholic food at most 5 percent of the facility's overall sales, or more?

importer_makes_alcoholic_beverages_regis.description: Will you use the ingredient to make, pack or hold alcoholic beverages yourself at a facility required to register with FDA?

importer_part117_exempt_117_5i.description: Is that facility exempt from 21 CFR part 117 under 21 CFR 117.5(i)?

dietary_supplement.description: Is the food a dietary supplement, a dietary supplement component, or neither?

dietary_supplement_further_manufacturing.description: Is it imported for further manufacturing, processing or packaging as a dietary supplement?

part111_specifications.description: Who must establish specifications for it under 21 CFR 111.70(b) or (d), and is that party in compliance with 21 CFR 111.73 and 111.75 for them: you, your customer, or neither?

customer_part111_written_assurance.description: Do you hold your customer's written assurance of that compliance, obtained within the last year?

fsvp_route_election.description: Which FSVP will you follow for this food and foreign supplier: the standard FSVP, the very-small-importer requirements, the small-foreign-supplier requirements, or the requirements for food from a country with an FDA-recognized or equivalent food-safety system?

very_small_importer_status.description: Do you meet the 21 CFR 1.500 very-small-importer definition for this kind of food (average annual food sales plus U.S. market value of food held without sale below the inflation-adjusted threshold over the applicable 3-year period, including subsidiaries and affiliates)?

small_foreign_supplier_type.description: Is the foreign supplier a qualified facility (21 CFR 117.3 or 507.3), a produce farm that is not a covered farm under part 112, a shell-egg producer with fewer than 3,000 laying hens, or none of these?

food_further_processing_intended.description: Is the food intended for further manufacturing or processing? Packaged food and raw agricultural commodities that will not be commercially processed before consumption are not.

comparable_system_recognition.description: Is the foreign supplier located in, and under the oversight of, a country whose food-safety system FDA has officially recognized as comparable or determined equivalent, with this food within that recognition's scope?

supplier_good_compliance_standing.description: Is the foreign supplier in good compliance standing with the food-safety authority of its country?

us_owner_or_consignee_at_entry.description: At the time of entry, is there a person in the United States who owns the food, has purchased it, or has agreed in writing to purchase it?

us_agent_designation.description: Has the foreign owner or consignee designated a U.S. agent or representative as the FSVP importer, and has that agent signed a statement consenting to serve as importer?

fsvp_importer_ufi.description: Which unique facility identifier will identify the FSVP importer on the entry: a DUNS number, UNK, none, or another identifier?

fsvp_importer_duns_location.description: Does that DUNS number correspond to the importer's U.S. location?

fsvp_program_status.description: Have you developed an FSVP for this food and foreign supplier, and do you maintain and follow it?

food_fdca_418_419.description: Does FD&C Act section 418 (hazard analysis and risk-based preventive controls, 21 CFR part 117 or 507) or section 419 (produce safety, 21 CFR part 112) apply to how this food is produced, or neither?

food_major_food_allergen.description: Does the food contain a major food allergen, so that the FD&C Act section 403(w) allergen-labeling requirements apply?

food_lacf_part113.description: Is the food a thermally processed low-acid food in a hermetically sealed container (21 CFR part 113) that will not be further manufactured or processed, a raw material or ingredient you use to make such a food yourself in compliance with part 113, or neither?

fsvp_receiving_facility.description: Are you a receiving facility for this food under 21 CFR 117.3 or 507.3, and if so, do you implement preventive controls for its hazards (117.135 or 507.34), are you not required to under 117.136 or 507.36, or do you implement a supply-chain program (part 117 subpart G or part 507 subpart E) for it?

fsvp_qualified_individual.description: Is a qualified individual, with the education, training or experience each FSVP activity needs and able to read and understand the language of the records reviewed, assigned to develop the FSVP and perform its activities?

fsvp_hazard_analysis_outcome.description: Does your written hazard analysis for this food (21 CFR 1.504) identify any known or reasonably foreseeable hazard that requires a control?

fsvp_hazard_analysis_by.description: Who conducted the hazard analysis: you, or another entity whose analysis by a qualified individual you have reviewed, assessed and documented, or another entity whose analysis you have not reviewed?

food_covered_produce.description: Is the food a raw agricultural commodity that is a fruit or vegetable and covered produce under 21 CFR 112.3?

food_rte_exposed_no_later_control.description: Is the food ready-to-eat and exposed to the environment before packaging, with no later treatment or control that would significantly minimize environmental pathogens?

fsvp_hazard_control_point.description: Who controls the hazard that requires a control: the foreign supplier, the foreign supplier's raw-material or other supplier, no one because the food cannot be consumed without the control, your customer subject to preventive controls (part 117 or 507 subpart C), your customer not subject to them, an entity later in the distribution chain, or your own documented downstream system?

fsvp_downstream_assurance.description: Do the documents accompanying the food disclose that it is "not processed to control" the hazard, and do you hold the current annual written assurance the downstream route requires?

fsvp_serious_hazard.description: Is there a reasonable probability that exposure to the hazard the foreign supplier controls will result in serious adverse health consequences or death to humans or animals?

fsvp_onsite_audit_status.description: For that hazard, when was the foreign supplier's last onsite audit: within the last 12 months, none or more than 12 months ago, or do you have a written determination that other verification activities or a less frequent audit provide adequate assurance?

fsvp_supplier_evaluation.description: Is your evaluation of this foreign supplier and food current and documented, not yet performed, more than 3 years old, or not yet reevaluated after new information about the supplier or food?

fsvp_supplier_evaluation_by.description: Who evaluated the foreign supplier: you, or another entity (not the supplier) whose evaluation by a qualified individual you have reviewed, assessed and documented, or another entity whose evaluation you have not reviewed?

fsvp_supplier_fda_compliance.description: Is any FDA warning letter, import alert or other FDA compliance action known for this foreign supplier?

fsvp_supplier_approval.description: Is the foreign supplier approved on the basis of its documented evaluation, used temporarily without approval with a documented justification and verification before import, or not approved?

fsvp_verification_activity.description: Which verification activity have you determined for this food and supplier: onsite audit, sampling and testing, review of the supplier's food-safety records, another appropriate activity, or not yet determined?

fsvp_verification_determined_by.description: Who determined the verification activity and its frequency: you, another entity (not the supplier) whose determination by a qualified individual you have reviewed, assessed and documented, or the foreign supplier?

fsvp_verification_performer.description: Who performs the verification activity: you or a qualified third party, or the foreign supplier or its employees?

fsvp_verification_conflict.description: Is the person performing the verification activity free of financial conflicts of interest that influence the results, with payment not related to the results?

fsvp_supplier_noncompliance.description: Have you determined that the foreign supplier does not use processes and procedures that provide the required level of protection, or produced food that is adulterated or misbranded under section 403(w): not known, found through verification or reevaluation, or found through other information?

fsvp_noncompliance_response.description: After that determination, have you taken corrective action and addressed its causes, discontinued the supplier until the causes are addressed, or continued using it without addressing them?

fsvp_records_language.description: Are your FSVP records kept in English or in another language?

fsvp_records_location.description: Where are your FSVP records kept: onsite, offsite and retrievable within 24 hours of an FDA request, or electronically and accessible from an onsite location?

fsvp_records_existing.description: Are the FSVP records new, existing records kept for other federal, state or local requirements that already contain all required information, or existing records supplemented with the missing information?

fsvp_entry_line_transmission.description: For each food line, will the filer transmit entity role code FSV with the FSVP importer's name, email address and DUNS number, FSV with one of those missing, or no FSVP code (FSV, FSX or RNE) at all?

fsvp_importer_duns_format.description: Is the importer's identifier in the Entity Number field exactly nine numeric digits, or another format?

fsvp_importer_duns_selection.description: Does the importer have one U.S. location with a DUNS number, or several; and if several, will it use the DUNS of the location where it keeps its FSVP records, of another location from which the records can be provided within 24 hours, or a different DUNS on different entries?

fsvp_verification_results.description: Have the results of the dietary-supplement verification activities been promptly reviewed, assessed and documented, not reviewed, or do they show the supplier is not producing to part 111's level of protection?

fsvp_food_for.description: Is the food you import as a very small importer human food, animal food, or both?

fsvp_vsi_status_documentation.description: Have you documented that you meet the very-small-importer definition for this calendar year (before first importing as one and by December 31 each year), or not?

fsvp_vsi_sales_currency.description: Were all food sales in the 3-year period in U.S. dollars, or were some in other currencies?

fsvp_small_supplier_status_assurance.description: Do you hold the supplier's written assurance that it meets the small-foreign-supplier criterion for this calendar year, obtained before approving it for the year and renewed by December 31, or is it missing or not renewed?

fsvp_1512_supplier_assurance.description: Is the foreign supplier's written assurance under 21 CFR 1.512(b)(3) current (obtained before importing and within the last 2 years), or missing or older than 2 years?

fsvp_qualified_facility_assurance_conten.description: Does the qualified facility's written assurance include a brief description of its preventive controls for the applicable hazard, a statement that it complies with applicable non-Federal (including foreign) food-safety law, or neither?

wood_packaging_dod_use.description: Is the wood packaging used by the U.S. Department of Defense to package this shipment: a DOD shipment, a commercial shipment under a DOD contract, or neither?

wood_packaged_cargo_regulated_article.description: Does the cargo in the wood packaging include any unprocessed or only primarily processed wood article listed in 7 CFR 319.40-1: logs, lumber, trees or tree portions, bark, cork, laths, hog fuel, sawdust, painted raw wood products, excelsior, wood chips, wood mulch, wood shavings, pickets, stakes, shingles, solid wood packing materials, humus, compost, litter or wooden handicrafts?

wood_packaging_ippc_mark.description: Does every solid wood packaging piece carry the IPPC mark with the country code, producer number and HT or MB treatment code? Answer unknown if it has not been checked.

wood_loose_packing.description: Does the shipment include loose wood packing material (excelsior or wood wool, sawdust or wood shavings)? If so, is it dry?

nhtsa_article.description: What is being imported: a vehicle manufactured primarily for use on public streets, roads and highways; a vehicle not manufactured primarily for public-road use; a system, part, component or accessory of a road vehicle; an item that is not a system, part or component of a road vehicle but could be taken for one; or goods unrelated to vehicles?

nhtsa_entry_basis.description: Which basis will the declaration state: certified conforming; replica imported by a low-volume manufacturer; Canadian-certified vehicle for personal use; conformance by a Registered Importer; solely for export; nonresident temporary personal use; foreign-government personnel; foreign armed forces; vehicle 25 or more years old or equipment made before any applicable standard; research, investigation, show or display, demonstration, training or racing; further manufacturing required; theft-marked equipment; or import to prepare an eligibility petition?

nhtsa_certification_label.description: Does the vehicle bear the certification label permanently affixed by its original manufacturer (or, for equipment, does the item or its delivery container bear the manufacturer's certification) that it conforms to all applicable safety, bumper and theft prevention standards?

nhtsa_low_volume_replica.description: Is the vehicle a replica motor vehicle eligible for an exemption under 49 CFR part 586, imported by a low-volume manufacturer as defined in 49 CFR 586.4?

nhtsa_canadian_certification.description: Was the vehicle certified by its original manufacturer as complying with all applicable Canadian motor vehicle safety standards?

nhtsa_manufacturer_us_conformity.description: Has the original manufacturer informed NHTSA that the vehicle conforms to all applicable U.S. safety, bumper and theft prevention standards, or to all of them except the labeling requirements of Standards 101 and 110 or 120 and/or the daytime running lamp specifications of Standard 108?

nhtsa_salvage_or_reconstructed.description: Is the vehicle a salvage motor vehicle (repair cost above 75% of retail value, acquired by an insurer in a damage settlement, or voluntarily designated salvage), a repaired salvage vehicle, a reconstructed vehicle (body under 25 years old on a chassis or frame that is not its original and is under 25 years old), or none of these?

nhtsa_personal_use.description: Is the vehicle imported for the importer's personal use?

nhtsa_theft_standard_conformity.description: Does the vehicle conform to all applicable Federal theft prevention standards?

nhtsa_registered_importer.description: Is the importer a Registered Importer with NHTSA whose registration is not suspended or revoked, has the importer contracted with such a Registered Importer, or neither?

nhtsa_model_eligibility.description: Has NHTSA determined under 49 CFR part 593 that this model and model year is eligible for importation?

nhtsa_vehicle_count.description: Does this entry cover a single vehicle or more than one?

nhtsa_export_label.description: Do the vehicle or equipment item, and the outside of any container of the equipment item, bear a label or tag stating that it is intended solely for export?

nhtsa_nonresident_foreign_registration.description: Is the importer a nonresident of the United States importing a vehicle registered in a country other than the United States?

nhtsa_temporary_stay.description: Will the vehicle be imported temporarily for personal use for no more than one year, not be sold during that time, and be exported within one year after entry?

nhtsa_assignment_status.description: Is the importer foreign-government personnel on assignment in the United States (or a member of the Secretariat of a designated public international organization) within the class the Department of State has authorized for free entry of vehicles, a member of a foreign country's armed forces on assignment in the United States, or neither?

nhtsa_vehicle_age.description: Is the vehicle 25 or more years old?

nhtsa_equipment_pre_standard.description: Was the equipment item manufactured on a date when no applicable safety or theft prevention standard was in effect?

nhtsa_special_purpose.description: Is the vehicle or equipment imported solely for research, investigations, show or display, demonstrations or training, or competitive racing events, or for another purpose?

nhtsa_special_purpose_authority.description: Does the importer hold NHTSA's written permission for this importation, is the importer an original manufacturer of vehicles certified to all applicable safety standards (or a wholly owned subsidiary of one), or neither?

nhtsa_further_manufacturing.description: Does the vehicle or equipment require further manufacturing operations to perform its intended function, or only the addition of readily attachable items (such as mirrors, wipers or tire and rim assemblies) or minor finishing such as painting?

nhtsa_theft_marking.description: Are the parts that 49 CFR part 541 requires to be marked marked in accordance with that part, not marked, or does part 541 require no marking for this vehicle or item?

nhtsa_petition_notice.description: Has the Registered Importer informed NHTSA in writing that it intends to submit, or has submitted, a petition for a decision that the vehicle is eligible for importation?

nhtsa_petition_permission.description: Has the Registered Importer received NHTSA's written permission to import the vehicle to prepare that eligibility petition?

rough_diamond_goods.description: Does the shipment include diamonds, and in what state: unsorted (HTS 7102.10); unworked or simply sawn, cleaved or bruted (7102.21 or 7102.31); worked beyond that; synthetic or reconstructed (heading 7104); or no diamonds?

rough_diamond_movement.description: Are the rough diamonds imported into the United States, brought through the United States in transit or transshipment to another country, or exported from the United States?

rough_diamond_entry.description: Are the rough diamonds entered for consumption, entered for a bonded warehouse, or admitted to a foreign-trade zone?

rough_diamond_export_territory.description: From which territory are the rough diamonds exported to the United States? Give the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of that territory, or other if it is not listed.

rough_diamond_destination_territory.description: To which territory are the rough diamonds exported from the United States? Give the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of that territory, or other if it is not listed.

rough_diamond_container.description: How is the shipment packed: sealed in a container with an indicator or barrier to entry that would show visible evidence of tampering; standard mailing or express-consignment packaging; packaging that only contains a resealable plastic bag; or unsealed?

rough_diamond_kp_certificate.description: Does the original Kimberley Process Certificate accompany the shipment, only a copy, or no certificate?

rough_diamond_certificate_language.description: Is the Kimberley Process Certificate in English, in another language with an English translation incorporated, or in another language without one?

rough_diamond_parcel_origin.description: Are all parcels in the shipment of unmixed origin (each from one country), or does it include a parcel of mixed-origin rough diamonds?

rough_diamond_entry_filing.description: Will the entry be filed through CBP's Automated Broker Interface (ABI), or as a non-ABI entry on CBP Form 7501?

rough_diamond_us_person.description: Is the party that imports (or, for an export, exports) the shipment a United States person: a U.S. citizen or permanent resident, an entity organized under U.S. law (including its foreign branches), or any person in the United States?

rough_diamond_transit_identical_state.description: Will the shipment leave the United States in the identical state in which it entered?

rough_diamond_kp_issuer.description: Is the Kimberley Process Certificate for the export issued by the U.S. Kimberley Process Authority (USKPA) or an entity it has licensed, or by someone else?

rough_diamond_aes_itn.description: Has the shipment been reported in the Automated Export System and an Internal Transaction Number (ITN) obtained before exportation?

rough_diamond_certificate_voided.description: Was any Kimberley Process Certificate intended for this export cancelled (voided), for example for loss or error?

shell_egg_goods.description: Does the shipment include eggs, and of what kind: shell eggs of the domesticated chicken, turkey, duck, goose or guinea; eggs of other species; egg products (dried, frozen or liquid eggs); or no eggs?

shell_egg_import_basis.description: Why are the shell eggs imported: for sale, distribution or other commercial use; exclusively for the consignee's personal use, display or laboratory analysis and not for sale or distribution; purchased abroad by an individual for consumption by the household, nonpaying guests and employees; or returned from abroad after inspection and marking by USDA?

shell_egg_small_import_quantity.description: How many shell eggs are in the personal-use, display or laboratory importation: 30 dozen or fewer; more than 30 dozen with the AMS Administrator's authorization; or more than 30 dozen without it?

shell_egg_sound_not_adulterated.description: Are the eggs sound, healthful, wholesome and fit for human food, not adulterated, and free of any substance not permitted by the Egg Products Inspection Act or 7 CFR part 57?

shell_egg_restricted_content.description: What do the eggs consist of: graded eggs within the tolerance for restricted eggs in the official standards for U.S. Consumer Grade B; graded eggs exceeding that tolerance; checks or dirties; leakers; or loss, inedible or incubator-reject eggs?

shell_egg_denatured.description: Have the loss, inedible or incubator-reject eggs been denatured or decharacterized and identified as 7 CFR part 57 requires?

shell_egg_consumer_packed.description: Are the eggs packed into containers destined for the ultimate consumer (a household consumer, restaurant, institution or other party purchasing or receiving shell eggs for consumption)?

shell_egg_refrigerated_45f.description: Have the consumer-packed eggs, at all times after packing, been stored and transported under refrigeration at an ambient temperature of no greater than 45 °F (7.2 °C)?

shell_egg_foreign_certificate.description: Is the consignment accompanied by a foreign inspection certificate with every item 7 CFR 57.915(b) lists; by one whose content the AMS Administrator has approved otherwise; by one missing items; or by none?

shell_egg_breaking_sealed_certified.description: Is this a properly sealed and certified shipment imported for breaking at an official egg products processing plant, to be segregated and controlled on arrival at that plant?

shell_egg_labeling.description: Do the immediate and shipping containers bear the labels 7 CFR 57.950 and 57.955 require, printed in English; are labels missing, incomplete or not in English; or is any label false or misleading?

shell_egg_pre_inspection_movement.description: Before AMS inspection, will the eggs stay at the port of arrival where first unloaded, move sealed to the place designated for inspection, or be delivered to the consignee under a customs bond?

tobacco_article.description: What is imported: cigarettes; cigars; chewing tobacco; snuff; pipe tobacco; roll-your-own tobacco; cigarette papers; cigarette tubes; processed tobacco (stemmed, fermented, threshed, cut, flavored or combined with non-tobacco ingredients, but not a finished tobacco product); unprocessed leaf tobacco (only grown, cured, baled or packed); or none of these? Processed tobacco in a package bearing a smokeless or pipe tobacco notice is declared as that product.

tobacco_origin.description: Where are the articles shipped from: a foreign country, the U.S. Virgin Islands, another U.S. possession, Puerto Rico, or are they U.S.-manufactured articles previously exported and now returned?

tobacco_export_labeled.description: Do the returned U.S.-manufactured articles bear the export mark, label or notice of 27 CFR 44.185 (including one concealed or covered, for example by a sticker)?

tobacco_returned_unchanged.description: Are the returned articles classifiable under HTSUS 9801.00.80 and returned without any change to the product or its shipping container?

tobacco_customs_exemption.description: Is an exemption claimed with CBP under the HTSUS or 19 CFR: none; in passenger baggage; for crew-member use; by a foreign official; a personal-use quantity CBP allows free of tax; or (not a tax exemption) tobacco products for personal consumption or a bona fide gift arriving in passenger baggage or by mail valued at $250 or less?

tobacco_weight_class.description: Do the cigarettes or cigars weigh not more than 3 pounds per thousand, or more than 3 pounds per thousand?

tobacco_length.description: Are the cigarettes, cigarette papers or cigarette tubes up to 6 1/2 inches long, or over 6 1/2 inches?

tobacco_large_cigar_price.description: Is the sale price of the large cigars (the price for which the importer sells them, including goods or services exchanged) $763.222 or less per thousand, or more than $763.222 per thousand?

tobacco_pipe_declaration.description: Does every package bear the declaration "pipe tobacco" in direct conjunction with, parallel to and as conspicuous as the brand name each time the brand name appears, or is it missing or less conspicuous anywhere?

tobacco_other_use_representation.description: Do the package, point-of-sale advertising or other product communications suggest a use other than pipe smoking, or does the package include cigarette papers or tubes?

tobacco_processed_container.description: Does each container of processed tobacco hold 10 pounds or less (including added non-tobacco ingredients), or more than 10 pounds?

tobacco_processed_removal_purpose.description: What is the processed tobacco removed for: destruction; export; delivery as a sample to a manufacturer to solicit orders; scientific or equipment testing that destroys or returns it; or another purpose (for example sale)?

tobacco_release.description: How are the articles released from customs custody: entered for consumption with tax paid; entered for a customs bonded warehouse or foreign-trade zone; in bond to an export warehouse proprietor; in bond to a manufacturer of tobacco products or cigarette papers and tubes; or, for returned U.S. articles, to the original manufacturer or to an export warehouse it has authorized?

tobacco_consumer_packages.description: Are the articles put up in the packages in which they will be sold or delivered to consumers?

tobacco_destined_for_export.description: Are the warehoused or FTZ articles shown to the satisfaction of TTB to be destined for export?

tobacco_consignee_ttb_permit.description: Does the manufacturer or export warehouse proprietor receiving the articles in bond hold a TTB permit (or, for cigarette papers and tubes, a TTB-assigned number) under 27 CFR part 40 or 44?

tobacco_entry_filing.description: Is the entry (or entry summary) filed electronically with CBP, or on paper?

tobacco_importer_permit.description: Does the importer hold a current TTB importer permit (TTB F 5200.24, effective on or after 2013-08-26 and not expired), a permit past expiry with a renewal filed within the 30 days before expiry, or no current permit (including a permit effective before 2013-08-26)?

tobacco_permit_scope.description: Does the permit authorize importing tobacco products, tobacco products and processed tobacco (an amended permit), or processed tobacco only?

tobacco_importer_entity.description: Is the applicant an individual, a corporation, or a partnership or association?

tobacco_trade_name.description: Does the applicant operate under a trade name?

tobacco_attorney_in_fact_signs.description: Will an attorney in fact (including a partner or member) sign the application or other documents for the importer, other than an officer whose authority comes with the corporate documents?

tobacco_eft_required.description: Was the importer (with its controlled group, more than 50% control) liable in the previous calendar year for $5,000,000 or more in taxes on cigars, cigarettes, cigarette papers and cigarette tubes under 27 CFR parts 40 and 41?

tobacco_permit_change.description: Has any of these changed or is it planned since the permit was issued: none; individual name; trade name; corporate name; a fiduciary taking over as a continuing business; a fiduciary only liquidating; transfer of ownership (including a partner or member change); a new officer or director or a person acquiring more than 10% of the stock; change in control of the corporation; relocation of the principal business office; address change by local authorities; or (processed tobacco) a change of storage premises?

tobacco_processed_non_permittee_sale.description: Does the importer export processed tobacco, or sell or transfer it to a person without a TTB permit as importer, manufacturer or export warehouse proprietor?

commerce_license_entry_route.description: How do the goods enter: a formal entry for consumption, an informal entry, admission to a foreign-trade zone, withdrawal from a zone for consumption, entry into a bonded warehouse, withdrawal from a warehouse for consumption, a temporary importation bond, or transportation and exportation?

commerce_license_ftz_admission.description: When the goods were admitted to the foreign-trade zone, was a Commerce import license reported on the admission (CBP Form 214)?

commerce_license_filer_registered.description: Is the party that will file for the license (importer, customs broker or agent) registered on Commerce's SIMA/AIM licensing system?

commerce_license_filer_address.description: What address does the party that would register have in the United States: a street address, only a P.O. box, or none?

commerce_license_status.description: Has the Commerce import license been issued yet? If so, is it valid (issued no more than 75 days earlier) on the date of importation, or did it expire before that date?

commerce_license_covered_value.description: Is the total value of the covered steel or aluminum portion of this entry under $5,000, or $5,000 or more?

commerce_license_parties.description: Across the covered lines of the entry, are the importer, exporter, manufacturer and country of origin the same, or do they differ between lines?

steel_melt_pour_country.description: Is the country where the raw steel was first melted in a steel-making furnace and poured into its first solid shape identified, for example on the mill test certificate?

aluminum_primary_content.description: Does the aluminum product contain primary aluminum (smelted from alumina), or only secondary aluminum re-melted from scrap?

aluminum_largest_smelt_country.description: Is the country where the largest volume of the primary aluminum in the product was smelted identified?

aluminum_second_smelt_country.description: Is the country where the second-largest volume of the primary aluminum was smelted identified, or is there no second source of primary aluminum?

aluminum_cast_country.description: Is the country where the aluminum was last liquified and cast into a solid state identified?

commerce_license_privileges.description: Does the filer still have electronic licensing privileges, or has Commerce revoked them?

commerce_license_system.description: Is Commerce's automatic licensing system available, or is it down for an extended period?

prior_notice_food_class.description: Is the article food under section 201(f) of the FD&C Act, or is it only a food contact substance (section 409(h)(6)) or a pesticide (7 U.S.C. 136(u))? Food includes feed, pet food, ingredients, additives, dietary supplements, beverages including alcohol and bottled water, and live food animals.

prior_notice_destination.description: Is the food imported into the customs territory of the United States (the 50 States, the District of Columbia or Puerto Rico), or only into a U.S. territory outside it (for example Guam or the U.S. Virgin Islands)?

prior_notice_accompanies_individual.description: Will the food be carried by, or otherwise accompany, an individual arriving in the United States?

prior_notice_personal_use.description: Is the food carried by or accompanying the individual for that individual's personal use (not for sale, distribution or business)?

prior_notice_made_in_personal_residence.description: Was the food made by an individual in that individual's personal residence?

prior_notice_sent_by_maker_as_personal_g.description: Is the food sent by the individual who made it, as a personal gift for nonbusiness reasons, to an individual in the United States?

prior_notice_submission_system.description: How will prior notice be submitted: through CBP ABI/ACE/ITDS; through the FDA Prior Notice System Interface (PNSI); because the broker's or self-filer's system or ABI/ACE/ITDS is not working; or under FDA's posted instructions during an FDA PNSI or OASIS outage?

prior_notice_express_consignment.description: Is the food arriving by an express consignment operator or carrier?

prior_notice_natural_state.description: Is the food in its natural state (for example harvested crops cleaned, trimmed or cooled attendant to harvest), or no longer in its natural state (made, cut, cooked, frozen, packaged or otherwise processed)?

prior_notice_transportation_exportation_.description: Is the food imported for transshipment through the United States under a Transportation and Exportation (T&E) entry?

prior_notice_post_confirmation_change.description: After FDA confirmed the prior notice, did any information change: none; only the quantity, anticipated arrival or planned shipment information; for mail, only the anticipated mailing date; other required information; or will the food no longer be imported?

prior_notice_arrival_outcome.description: At arrival: has the food not yet arrived; did it arrive after the full prior-notice time elapsed on a confirmed, accurate notice; did it arrive with no confirmed prior notice; was the notice found inaccurate; or did it arrive before the full time elapsed, with or without FDA having already reviewed the notice and advised CBP?

prior_notice_refused_food_disposition.description: For food refused for inadequate prior notice: will it be exported immediately from the port of arrival under CBP supervision with CBP concurrence, held within the port, or held at a secure facility outside the port?

prior_notice_foreign_facility_registrati.description: Is every foreign facility that must register under 21 CFR part 1, subpart H for this food registered (or not required to register), or is a facility that is required to register not registered?

cpsc_primarily_for_children_12_or_under.description: Is the product designed or intended primarily for children 12 years of age or younger? Consider the manufacturer's reasonable statement or label, how it is represented in packaging, display, promotion or advertising, whether consumers commonly recognize it as for that age, and CPSC's Age Determination Guidelines (15 U.S.C. 2052(a)(2)).

cpsc_private_labeled.description: Is the product manufactured in the United States labeled with the brand or trademark of someone other than its manufacturer, who authorized or caused that labeling, with no manufacturer brand or trademark on the label (a private label)?

cpsc_manufacturer_issues_certificate.description: For the privately labeled product, will the manufacturer itself issue the finished product certificate?

cpsc_ior_is_customs_broker.description: Is the importer of record a licensed customs broker making entry on behalf of an owner, purchaser or consignee?

cpsc_gcc_rule_requires_third_party.description: For a product that is not a children's product, does an identified rule, ban, standard or regulation require testing by an independent third party for that rule or for this class of products?

cpsc_third_party_testing_exclusion.description: Does a statutory exclusion from third-party testing apply to this children's product: an ordinary book or ordinary paper-based printed material (paper or cardboard, inks or toners, conventionally bound; not a book with play value, not for a child 3 or younger, no nonpaper parts), metal component parts of a bicycle for the lead content limits only, another exclusion stated in a specific rule, or none?

cpsc_small_batch_registered.description: Has the manufacturer (including an importer) registered with CPSC as a small batch manufacturer before using the small batch alternative or exemption?

cpsc_small_batch_revenue_within_threshol.description: In the previous calendar year, were the manufacturer's total gross revenues from sales of all consumer products, including every entity that controls, is controlled by or is under common control with it, at or below the small batch threshold ($1,000,000 as adjusted annually for inflation and published by CPSC)?

cpsc_small_batch_units_prior_year.description: How many units of this same product did the manufacturer make in the previous calendar year: 7,500 or fewer, or more than 7,500?

cpsc_small_batch_excluded_requirement.description: Is any applicable requirement one that small batch relief never covers: lead in paint (16 CFR 1303), full-size or non-full-size cribs or pacifiers, small parts, lead in children's metal jewelry, or baby bouncers, walkers and jumpers (listed_requirement); or is the product a durable infant or toddler product; or none?

cpsc_periodic_testing_basis.description: How is continued compliance of the children's product assured between certifications: a periodic testing plan only, a production testing plan, or continued testing by an ISO/IEC 17025-accredited testing laboratory?

cpsc_material_change.description: Has the children's product undergone a change in design, manufacturing process or sourcing of component parts that, exercising due care, could affect its ability to comply with an applicable rule?

cpsc_certificate_form.description: Apart from any eFiling, will the certificate be furnished and made available as a hard copy, or as an electronic certificate identified by a unique identifier and reached through a URL or other electronic means?

cpsc_relies_on_other_party_testing.description: Will the certifier rely, in whole or in part, on component part certificates or test reports, or on another party's finished product certificate or test reports?

doe_gas_product.description: What is being brought in: natural gas by pipeline in gaseous form; liquefied natural gas (LNG, including LNG in ISO containers); compressed natural gas (CNG); natural gas in another form (for example a gel, or natural gas mixed with artificial gas); only artificial or synthetic gas containing no natural gas; natural gas liquids or LPG (ethane, propane, butane); or other goods?

doe_gas_movement.description: Does the gas physically enter the United States for use or sale here (an import); cross the United States between points of one foreign country, or leave the United States through one foreign country and come back (in transit, returning to the country of origin); or is it an exchange by displacement, where authorized imported volumes are replaced by other gas for storage or flexibility and no gas crosses the border?

doe_gas_in_transit_path.description: Is the in-transit gas physically moved between two border crossing points along a commercially reasonable path without being diverted for other use, or is it a backhaul, displacement or other virtual movement, or diverted along the way?

doe_gas_in_transit_days.description: Does the gas cross the U.S. points of entry and exit within 30 days, or does it take longer?

doe_gas_displacement_term.description: What is the term of the exchange-by-displacement agreement: up to 5 years, or longer?

doe_gas_displacement_volume.description: Do the volumes imported under the exchange stay within the volumes of the existing import authorization, or exceed them?

doe_gas_displacement_net_effect.description: Is the net effect of the exchange the same as under the existing import authorization, or does it differ?

doe_gas_source_country.description: From which country is the natural gas imported (the country it is shipped to the United States from)?

doe_gas_transport_mode.description: How does the LNG or CNG reach the United States: by vessel, in ISO containers by vessel, by truck, by rail, or by other waterborne transport?

doe_gas_contract_term.description: What is the term of the gas purchase contract behind this import: two years or less (including spot purchases), or longer than two years?

doe_gas_authorization.description: What DOE authorization does the importer hold for this gas: none, an application pending with DOE, a blanket (short-term) authorization, or a long-term authorization?

doe_gas_authorization_scope.description: Does the DOE order cover this import (in its term, source country, form of gas, volumes and company name), or has it expired, or does this import fall outside its terms?

doe_gas_application_lead_time.description: Will the application be filed at least 90 days before the first import, or less than 90 days before it?

doe_gas_blanket_applicant.description: Is this the company's first blanket application, or a renewal under the same company name and associates as its previous authorization?

doe_gas_us_presence.description: Does the applicant or authorization holder reside or have a place of business or other corporate presence in the United States?

doe_gas_control_change.description: Has the applicant or authorization holder had a change in control (for example a sale, merger or 10% or more of voting securities changing hands), a change of company name, or neither?

shrimp_goods.description: Does the shipment contain shrimp, or products from shrimp (products containing shrimp), or neither?

shrimp_harvesting_nation.description: What is the harvesting nation: the nation or economy where the shrimp was raised in an aquaculture facility, or in whose waters it was harvested, whatever flag the vessel flies? Give the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or other if it is not listed. A country that only processed or re-exported the shrimp is not the harvesting nation.

shrimp_harvest_method.description: Was the shrimp raised and harvested in an aquaculture facility, or caught in the wild?

shrimp_aquaculture_pond_days.description: Did the shrimp spend at least 30 days in ponds of the aquaculture facility before being harvested?

shrimp_fishery.description: In which fishery, and with which gear or species, was the wild shrimp harvested: one the Department of State has made a determination for, or other?

shrimp_harvested_with_teds.description: Was the shrimp harvested by commercial trawl vessels using turtle excluder devices (TEDs)?

shrimp_export_date_period.description: When is the date of export, the date the shipment departed the last port of the harvesting nation: on or after 2026-04-21; 2025-06-01 to 2026-04-20; 2025-05-12 to 2025-05-31; or before 2025-05-12?

shrimp_ds2031.description: Is the shipment accompanied by a DS-2031 Shrimp Exporter's/Importer's Declaration with every block complete and legible and original signatures in all required signature blocks; one with a block incomplete or a signature missing; or none?

shrimp_government_attestation.description: Who signed Block 8 (government attestation) of the DS-2031 before export: an official of the harvesting nation's government, employed full time and identified to the Department of State; someone else (a private-sector representative or part-time employee); or no one?

shrimp_ds2031_all_stages.description: Did the original DS-2031 accompany the shipment through every stage of the export process, including any processing of the original product and any shipment through an intermediary nation?

composite_wood_goods.description: Does the shipment contain hardwood plywood (with a veneer or composite core), medium-density fiberboard or particleboard, and in what form: panels or bundles of panels; component parts used to assemble finished goods and not sold directly to consumers; finished goods, including component parts sold directly to consumers; or none? Hardboard, structural plywood (PS 1-19), structural panels (PS 2-18), structural composite lumber, oriented strand board, glued laminated lumber, prefabricated wood I-joists and finger-jointed lumber are not regulated composite wood products.

composite_wood_exclusion.description: Does a 40 CFR 770.1(c) exclusion apply: none; a finished good previously sold or supplied to an end user (for example an antique or secondhand furniture); wood packaging such as pallets, crates, spools or dunnage; or composite wood used inside a new vehicle (not a recreational vehicle) built entirely from new parts and never sold at retail or registered, a new rail car, new boat, new aerospace craft or new aircraft?

composite_wood_window_door.description: Is the product a window with less than 5 percent composite wood by volume; an exterior or garage door made from composite wood products manufactured with no-added formaldehyde-based or ultra low-emitting formaldehyde resins; an exterior or garage door with less than 3 percent composite wood by volume; or none of these?

composite_wood_testing_import.description: Are the panels imported solely for TSCA Title VI quality control or quarterly testing by a third-party certifier, not for sale?

composite_wood_supplier_statement.description: Do the bills of lading, invoices or comparable documents include the supplier's written statement that the goods are TSCA Title VI compliant; that the composite wood products were produced before June 1, 2018; or no such statement?

composite_wood_panel_label.description: Before import, is each panel labeled with the panel producer's name or number, lot number, EPA TSCA Title VI third-party certifier number and the TSCA Title VI certified statement; is only the bundle labeled, with a method such as color-coded edge marking that identifies each panel's supplier; is only the bundle labeled without such a method; or are the panels not labeled?

composite_wood_de_minimis.description: Does the finished good contain no more than 144 square inches of regulated composite wood, measured on the surface area of its largest face, and is it not designed to be used in combination or in multiples to create larger surfaces, finished goods or component parts?

composite_wood_goods_label.description: Before import, does each finished good carry the fabricator's label in legible English (fabricator's name, month and year of production and the TSCA Title VI compliant statement); does only each box or bundle carry it; or is there no such label?

radiation_product_category.description: Which FDA performance standard's applicability paragraph covers the product: television receiver with a cathode-ray tube (21 CFR 1020.10); cold-cathode gas discharge tube (1020.20); diagnostic x-ray system or listed component, including CT (1020.30–1020.33); cabinet x-ray system (1020.40); microwave oven (1030.10); laser product, other than one sold to a manufacturer for use as a component or replacement under 1040.10(a)(1)–(2) (1040.10–1040.11); sunlamp product or ultraviolet lamp for one (1040.20); high-intensity mercury vapor discharge lamp (1040.30); another electronic product that no standard covers (including ultrasonic therapy products, whose standard was removed in 2023); or not an electronic product?

radiation_manufacturer_agent.description: Has the product's manufacturer designated a permanent U.S. resident as its agent for service of process with FDA's Center for Devices and Radiological Health under 21 CFR 1005.25?

radiation_export_only.description: Is the product intended solely for export: no; yes, with the product and the outside of its shipping container labeled or tagged for export and the product meeting all requirements of the destination country; or yes, but without that labeling or destination compliance?

radiation_declaration_basis.description: Which declaration can the importer of record make on Form FDA 2877: the products were manufactured before the applicable standard's effective date; they comply with all applicable standards and carry the certification label or tag; they do not comply but are imported for research, investigations, studies, demonstrations or training, will not enter commerce and an exemption has been or will be requested; they do not comply but a petition to bring them into compliance has been or will be filed; or none of these?

hctp_article.description: Is this an HCT/P (human cells or tissues intended for implantation, transplantation, infusion or transfer into a human recipient), whole blood or a blood component, another biological product, or outside those categories? The exclusions in 21 CFR 1271.3(d) matter.

hctp_minimally_manipulated.description: Does the product meet 21 CFR 1271.3(f)'s minimal-manipulation definition?

hctp_homologous_use_only.description: Is the product intended only for homologous use, as shown by labeling, advertising and other objective-intent evidence?

hctp_combination.description: Is it uncombined, or combined only with water, crystalloids, or a sterilizing/preserving/storage agent that raises no new clinical safety concern; or combined with another article?

hctp_systemic_or_metabolic.description: Does it have a systemic effect or depend on living cells' metabolic activity for its primary function?

hctp_qualifying_use.description: If it has a systemic/metabolic effect, is its use autologous, allogeneic in a first- or second-degree blood relative, reproductive, or none of these?

hctp_establishment_exception.description: Which exact 21 CFR 1271.15 establishment exception, if any, applies? The contracted-recovery exception relieves only independent registration/listing.

hctp_intimate_partner_reproductive_impor.description: Is this a reproductive HCT/P donated by the recipient's sexually intimate partner for reproductive use?

hctp_peripheral_blood_stem_cell.description: Is this a peripheral-blood stem/progenitor-cell HCT/P?

hctp_unreasonable_disease_risk.description: For an imported peripheral-blood stem/progenitor-cell HCT/P, are there circumstances indicating an unreasonable risk of communicable-disease transmission?

hctp_ace_entry_data.description: Are the applicable 21 CFR 1.72 and 1.78 ACE entry fields and affirmations declared complete, or incomplete/missing? This does not verify FDA registration or admission.

ozone_bulk_substance.description: Is a substance imported in bulk, that is in a container for its transportation or storage such as a cylinder, drum, ISO tank or small can, and which: an HFC regulated substance listed in appendix A to 40 CFR part 84, alone or in a blend; a class I controlled substance listed in appendix A to 40 CFR part 82, subpart A (for example CFCs, halons, carbon tetrachloride, methyl chloroform, methyl bromide, HBFCs); a class II controlled substance listed in appendix B (HCFCs); a blend containing both an HFC and a controlled substance; substances only inside manufactured products such as appliances, aerosol cans or foams; or none of these?

ozone_hfc_import_basis.description: On what basis are the bulk HFCs imported: by expending consumption or application-specific allowances; under an EPA non-objection notice for use in a process resulting in their transformation or destruction; used HFCs under an EPA non-objection notice for destruction; as a transhipment through the United States to another country; or none of these?

ozone_container_100_lb_or_less.description: Are the HFCs imported for transformation or destruction in containers designed to hold 100 pounds or less of HFCs?

ozone_arrival_mode.description: Does the shipment arrive by marine vessel, or by another mode (truck, rail, auto or air)?

ozone_certificate_of_analysis.description: Is a certificate of analysis for the HFCs physically with the shipment, submitted electronically with the advance CBP filing instead, or neither?

ozone_container_label.description: Does each HFC container carry a durable label or permanent marking on its outside stating the common name, chemical name or ASHRAE designation of the HFC or blend and, for a blend, the percentages; or are the containers unlabeled or mislabeled?

ozone_class_i_import_basis.description: On what basis is the class I controlled substance imported: within essential-use allowances or exemptions or critical-use allowances held for it; a used substance under an EPA non-objection notice; for destruction under an EPA non-objection notice; for use in a process resulting in its transformation; as a transhipment; as a heel (no more than 10 percent of the container volume left after discharge); used halon in aircraft halon bottles for hydrostatic testing; methyl bromide solely for quarantine or preshipment applications; or none of these?

ozone_class_ii_import_basis.description: On what basis is the class II controlled substance (HCFC) imported: within unexpended consumption allowances held for it; a used substance under an EPA non-objection notice; for destruction under an EPA non-objection notice; for use in a process resulting in its transformation; as a transhipment; as a heel (no more than 10 percent of the container volume left after discharge); or none of these?
