fda_tobacco_article.description: What is the article: cigarettes; cigarette tobacco; roll-your-own tobacco; smokeless tobacco; a product containing nicotine not made or derived from tobacco (such as synthetic nicotine pouches or e-liquids); a cigar other than a premium cigar; a premium cigar; another tobacco product FDA deemed subject to its authority (e-cigarettes and other electronic nicotine delivery systems, e-liquids, pipe tobacco, hookah tobacco, nicotine gels, dissolvables, and components or parts of these); an accessory of such a deemed product (for example an ashtray, a lighter or a humidor, which contains no tobacco); a drug, device or combination product (for example a smoking cessation product); tobacco leaf held by a tobacco product manufacturer; tobacco leaf not held by a manufacturer; or none of these (21 U.S.C. 321(rr), 387a(b)–(c); 21 CFR 1100.2)?

fda_tobacco_marketing_authorization.description: What is the product's FDA marketing status: commercially marketed in the United States as of February 15, 2007 and not modified since; authorized by an FDA order finding it substantially equivalent; a minor modification FDA exempted from substantial equivalence, with the abbreviated report filed; authorized by a marketing granted order on a premarket tobacco product application; first introduced between February 15, 2007 and March 22, 2011 with a substantial equivalence report filed in that period and still pending; or no marketing order in effect (never authorized, or the order was denied, withdrawn, rescinded or suspended) (21 U.S.C. 387j(a), 387e(j))?

fda_tobacco_cigarette_characterizing_fla.description: Does the cigarette or any of its component parts (tobacco, filter or paper) contain an artificial or natural flavor other than tobacco or menthol, or an herb or spice, that is a characterizing flavor of the product or its smoke (21 U.S.C. 387g(a)(1)(A))?

fda_tobacco_modified_risk_representation.description: Does the label, labeling or advertising represent the product as presenting a lower risk of disease, being less harmful, containing a reduced level of or being free of a substance, or use the descriptors "light", "mild", "low" or similar; and if so, is an FDA modified risk order in effect for it (21 U.S.C. 387k)?

fda_tobacco_user_fee.description: Has the manufacturer or importer paid every FDA tobacco user fee assessed to it by its due date, or has none been assessed, or is an assessed fee past due and unpaid (21 U.S.C. 387s, 387b(4))?

fda_tobacco_us_establishment.description: Will the product be manufactured, prepared, compounded or processed, including repackaged or relabeled, at an establishment in a State; and if so, is that establishment registered with FDA with the product listed, first engaging in that activity now, or not registered or not listing the product (21 U.S.C. 387e(a)–(c), (i))?

fda_tobacco_package_form.description: Is the tobacco product imported in package form, that is, in the pack, box, carton or container in which it will be sold to consumers (21 U.S.C. 387c(a)(2); 21 CFR 1100.3)?

fda_tobacco_package_label.description: Does the package label bear the name and place of business of the manufacturer, packer or distributor, an accurate quantity statement, the percentages of domestically and foreign grown tobacco, the statement "sale only allowed in the United States" (for tobacco products other than cigarettes) and the required warning statement (21 U.S.C. 387c(a)(2), 387t(a); 21 CFR part 1143)?

epa_vehicle_import_item.description: What is imported: a light-duty vehicle or highway motorcycle; a heavy-duty highway vehicle or engine (installed or loose); a nonroad or stationary engine or equipment containing one; or none of these (19 CFR 12.73(a), 12.74(a); 40 CFR 85.1501(a), 1068.301(a))?

epa_vehicle_entry_circumstance.description: Is this an ordinary import, a vehicle of a resident returning from Canada, Mexico or another EPA-designated country, or a Canadian or Mexican commuter or tourist vehicle for which the port director issued the 19 CFR 12.73(c)(2) waiver identification?

epa_vehicle_manufacturer_import.description: Is the importer the company that manufactured the vehicle or engine, does it hold the valid EPA certificate of conformity covering it, and does the imported article bear the conformity label (19 CFR 12.73(i)(1), 12.74(b)(1))?

epa_vehicle_certification.description: What is the EPA emission-certification status on import: covered by a certificate and properly labeled; manufactured for compliance with certification pending; previously certified or admitted, catalyst/O2-sensor equipped, labeled and driven abroad; built before standards applied; or nonconforming (19 CFR 12.73(b); 40 CFR 85.1502(a)(9), 85.1512, 1068.301(b))?

epa_vehicle_catalyst_program.description: Is the previously certified/admitted vehicle included in a catalyst and oxygen-sensor control program EPA approved for the model year (40 CFR 85.1512(a)–(b))?

epa_vehicle_nonconforming_basis.description: Which route applies to this nonconforming light-duty vehicle or highway motorcycle: an ICI certificate route, an ICI modification-and-test route, a manufacture-date exclusion, the over-20-original-production-year ICI exemption, racing, a temporary repair/testing/prototype/display/export route, national security, hardship, diplomatic or foreign military use, nonresident personal use, or none (40 CFR 85.1503, 85.1511; 19 CFR 12.73(e)–(h))?

epa_vehicle_modification_test_eligibilit.description: For the ICI modification-and-test route, is the vehicle at least six original-production years old, a qualifying vehicle owned, purchased and used overseas by U.S. Government military or civilian personnel, or neither (40 CFR 85.1509(a))?

epa_vehicle_engine_exemption.description: Which 40 CFR part 1068 route applies to the nonconforming heavy-duty engine/vehicle or nonroad/stationary engine/equipment: competition, stationary, hobby or another standard-setting exclusion; a national-security, manufacturer-owned, replacement-engine, hardship or identical-configuration permanent exemption; a temporary repair, testing, display, export, diplomatic/military, delegated-assembly or partially-complete route; or none (40 CFR 1068.310, 1068.315, 1068.325)?

epa_vehicle_declaration.description: Was the required EPA declaration filed with CBP at entry (or at the weekly FTZ entry summary): Form 3520-1 for light-duty vehicles and highway motorcycles, or Form 3520-21 for heavy-duty and nonroad/stationary engines and equipment (19 CFR 12.73(i)(3)–(4), 12.74(b)(3)–(4))?

faa_uscg_product.description: What is imported: an aircraft engine or propeller; an aviation article (material, part, appliance or TSO article); an aircraft; a recreational boat (a vessel manufactured or used primarily for noncommercial use, 33 CFR 181.3); associated equipment for such boats; equipment or material that 46 CFR chapter I requires to be Coast Guard approved (such as lifesaving or fire protection equipment); or none of these?

faa_uscg_bilateral_agreement.description: Is the country or jurisdiction of manufacture subject to an agreement with the United States for the acceptance of this aviation product or article (14 CFR 21.500(a), 21.502(a), 21.29(a))?

faa_uscg_aircraft_category.description: Which airworthiness certificate is sought for the aircraft: standard category (normal, utility, acrobatic, commuter, transport, manned free balloon or special class), restricted category, or another category (primary, limited, light-sport, experimental and others)?

faa_uscg_aircraft_condition.description: Is the aircraft newly produced under the authority of its State of Manufacture, which certifies under the export provisions of its agreement with the United States that it conforms to its type design and is in condition for safe operation; or is it a used aircraft or otherwise not so certified (14 CFR 21.183(c), (d))?

faa_uscg_us_type_certificate.description: Does the aircraft, engine or propeller already hold a U.S. type certificate (14 CFR 21.21, 21.25 or 21.29), or not?

faa_uscg_export_only.description: Is the boat or equipment intended solely for export, and so labeled, tagged or marked on the item and on the outside of any container (33 CFR 181.11(a))?

faa_uscg_outboard_183_710.description: Is the equipment an outboard motor or starting control to which 33 CFR 183.710 applies (33 CFR 181.11(c))?

faa_uscg_part183_standard.description: Does a Coast Guard safety standard in 33 CFR part 183 apply to the boat or equipment (33 CFR 181.5)?

faa_uscg_boat_purpose.description: Is the boat imported for sale, or for the importer's own use and not for sale (33 CFR 181.23)?

faa_uscg_cg_approval.description: Does the equipment hold a Coast Guard certificate of approval, a Coast Guard approval issued by a foreign authority under an effective Mutual Recognition Agreement, or no approval yet (46 CFR 159.003-3, 159.005-13)?

nhtsa_ri_route.description: Is the vehicle entered under 49 CFR 591.5(f) because it does not conform to all applicable Federal motor vehicle safety and bumper standards (but conforms to the theft prevention standards) and will be conformed by a Registered Importer, or on another 591.5 basis (certified conforming, 25 years or older, temporary, special purpose, export only and others)?

nhtsa_ri_registered_importer.description: Is the importer a Registered Importer with NHTSA (49 CFR part 592), has it contracted with one, is the Registered Importer's registration suspended or revoked, or is no Registered Importer involved?

nhtsa_ri_suspension_timing.description: Had the Registered Importer already entered the vehicle when its registration was suspended or revoked, or is the vehicle not yet entered (49 CFR 592.7(d))?

nhtsa_ri_eligibility.description: Has NHTSA decided under 49 CFR part 593 that the vehicle's model and model year is eligible for importation (a vehicle eligibility number on NHTSA's list, or a granted petition), or not?

nhtsa_ri_petition_basis.description: On which basis could the vehicle be found eligible: substantially similar to a model certified for sale in the United States and capable of being readily modified to conform; safety features that comply with, or can be modified to comply with, all applicable standards; or neither (49 CFR 593.5(a))?

nhtsa_ri_first_certification.description: Is this the Registered Importer's first certification to NHTSA of this make, model and model year, or a subsequent one (49 CFR 592.6(d)(6)–(7))?

aphis_ani_article.description: What is imported: a live ruminant (cattle, other bovines, sheep, goats, camelids, cervids or other ruminants), live swine, live poultry other than hatching eggs (chickens, doves, ducks, geese, grouse, guinea fowl, partridges, pea fowl, pheasants, pigeons, quail, swans or turkeys), another live animal (horses, other birds, hatching eggs, dogs, elephants, aquatic animals and others), meat of ruminants or swine, another animal product (poultry meat or eggs, milk, organs, gelatin and others, 9 CFR part 94), an animal byproduct or hay or straw (9 CFR part 95), a veterinary biological product (9 CFR part 104), an organism or vector of animal disease (9 CFR part 122), or none of these?

aphis_ani_origin.description: Where are the live animals shipped from: Canada or Mexico, Central America or the West Indies, or another region (9 CFR part 93)?

aphis_ani_ruminant_species.description: Is the ruminant a bovine, camelid, cervid, sheep or goat, or another ruminant (9 CFR 93.401(a))?

aphis_ani_fmd_region.description: Was the animal or meat raised (and, for meat, slaughtered) in a region on the APHIS list of regions declared free of foot-and-mouth disease, and does the shipment enter a port in or transit a region where the disease exists on the way; or is it from a region not on that list (9 CFR 94.1)?

aphis_ani_wild.description: Are the ruminants or swine wild animals, such as giraffes, deer, antelopes or wild swine for exhibition (9 CFR 93.404(c), 93.504(c))?

aphis_ani_poultry_disease_status.description: Did the poultry originate in or transit a region APHIS lists under 9 CFR 94.6(a) where highly pathogenic avian influenza or Newcastle disease exists in commercial poultry, or were they vaccinated for the H5 or H7 subtype of avian influenza (9 CFR 93.201(a))?

aphis_ani_meat_species.description: Is the meat from ruminants (beef, veal, lamb, mutton, goat and other ruminants) or from swine (pork)?

aphis_ani_meat_form.description: Is the meat fresh (chilled or frozen); cured and fully dried so it keeps without refrigeration; cooked; or canned meat as defined in 9 CFR part 431 (9 CFR 94.1, 94.4)?

aphis_ani_beef_ovine_94_29.description: Is the fresh meat beef or ovine meat from a region 9 CFR 94.29 specifies, exported under the conditions of that section (9 CFR 94.1(b)(4))?

aphis_ani_asf_region.description: Is the region of origin on the APHIS list of regions where African swine fever exists or is reasonably believed to exist (9 CFR 94.8(a))?

aphis_ani_byproduct_diseased.description: Was the byproduct taken or removed from an animal affected with anthrax, foot-and-mouth disease, highly pathogenic avian influenza or Newcastle disease (9 CFR 95.3)?

aphis_ani_byproduct_entry.description: Does the byproduct meet the requirements for entry its own 9 CFR part 95 section states (for example untanned hides from foot-and-mouth disease free regions, 95.16), or will it enter under that section's restrictions or the BSE conditions for bovine-derived materials (95.4–95.14, 95.17–95.39)?

aphis_ani_biologic_permit.description: Which U.S. Veterinary Biological Product Permit does the import need: for research and evaluation, for distribution and sale, or for transit shipment only through the United States (9 CFR 104.2)?

aphis_ani_organism_part102_permit.description: Has an import permit already been issued for these organisms under 9 CFR part 102 (9 CFR 122.2)?

lacey_plant_content.description: Does the imported article contain plant material? Select none only when there is zero plant material.

lacey_material_class.description: Does the plant satisfy the 7 CFR 357.2 qualified common-cultivar, common-food-crop, research-specimen, or planting exclusion, or is it wild material or a tree? A tree is never a common cultivar.

lacey_protected_listing.description: Is any plant material CITES-listed, ESA-listed, or protected by a qualifying State conservation law? Unknown status must not be treated as unlisted.

lacey_packaging_role.description: Is the plant used exclusively as packaging to support, protect or carry another imported item, or is the plant packaging itself merchandise?

lacey_plant_unit_weight.description: Does the plant material represent no more than 5 percent of the total weight of each individual product unit?

lacey_plant_entry_line_weight.description: Does the total plant material in this entry of products under the same 10-digit HTS provision weigh no more than 2.9 kg?

lacey_schedule_heading.description: Which exact APHIS Lacey Act implementation-schedule heading matches the declared 10-digit HTS classification? Select not_on_published_schedule only after checking the official schedule; classification is declared, not verified.

lacey_species_details.description: Does the declaration name genus and species, or every possible species when a plant product uses varying unknown species?

lacey_harvest_details.description: Does the declaration name the harvest country, or every possible country when a multi-country species has unknown harvest origin?

lacey_value_quantity_unit.description: Does the declaration provide import value, plant quantity and the unit of measure?

lacey_recycled_paper.description: Does this paper or paperboard product include recycled plant content?

lacey_recycled_percent.description: Is the average recycled-content percentage supplied in addition to non-recycled plant information?

lacey_filing_channel.description: Was the declaration submitted through CBP ACE, APHIS LAWGS, or paper/not submitted? Paper is no longer accepted after 2026-01-01.

aphis_soil_material.description: Is the material unsterilized soil, sterilized soil, or not soil as defined in 7 CFR 330.100?

aphis_soil_other_rule.description: Is this soil regulated under another APHIS chapter rule or the 7 CFR 319.37-10 planting-medium rule?

aphis_soil_origin.description: Is this soil from an area of Canada that Canada's national plant protection organization does not regulate for a soil-borne plant pest, or from another or regulated area?

aphis_soil_permit.description: Has APHIS issued a currently valid import permit covering this shipment and its conditions, is it expired or revoked, or is there only an application or no permit?

aphis_soil_purpose.description: Is the soil imported for ordinary use, extraction of plant pests, or disposal of contaminating plant pests?

aphis_soil_facility.description: For pest extraction or contaminated-soil disposal, is the direct destination an APHIS-approved facility for that purpose?

aphis_soil_hand_carry.description: Will the soil be hand-carried into the United States?

aphis_soil_hand_carry_authorization.description: Does the issued permit name the authorized hand carrier and did the permittee give APHIS that carrier's name at least 20 days before movement?

aphis_pest_identity.description: Is the organism a plant pest under 7 CFR 330.100 or an APHIS 330.200(b) determination, not a plant pest, or an unknown-risk organism without an APHIS determination?

aphis_pest_other_route.description: Is the import authorized by another APHIS chapter regulation, an APHIS general permit, or a claimed explicit exception, or is none of those asserted?

aphis_pest_permit.description: Has APHIS issued a currently valid import permit covering this plant pest and shipment conditions, is it expired or revoked, is there only an application or no permit, or only a continued-curation permit?

aphis_pest_hand_carry.description: Will the plant pest be hand-carried into the United States?

aphis_pest_hand_carry_authorization.description: Does the issued permit name an authorized hand carrier with notice to APHIS at least 20 days before movement, is either condition missing or late, or has APHIS cancelled authorization?

fas_dairy_license_intent.description: Do you intend to enter this article under a FAS dairy import license? This does not determine whether a license is required or valid.

fas_dairy_entry_kind.description: Is this a consumption entry, a warehouse withdrawal for consumption, or another entry kind?

fas_dairy_purchase_route.description: Was the licensee's purchase a direct sale from a foreign supplier, a sale in transit, or a purchase in warehouse?

fas_dairy_supplier_warehoused.description: For the direct foreign sale, did the foreign supplier enter the article into warehouse?

fsis_article_class.description: Is this a meat product, poultry product, human-food egg product, shell egg or another article?

fsis_meat_route.description: Is this an ordinary meat import, or is an exception under 9 CFR 327.16 or 327.17 claimed? An exception claim is not verified.

avocado_use.description: Are the avocados for ordinary use, charitable consumption, relief distribution, seed, or commercial processing into products?

avocado_weight_band.description: Is the avocado shipment at most 55 pounds or above 55 pounds? This is a declared band, not a measured weight.

avocado_maturity_group.description: Are all avocados Hass, Fuerte, Zutano or Edranol, or are other, mixed or unknown varieties present?

fee_entry.description: Is the merchandise formally entered or released (including release under immediate delivery and withdrawal from warehouse for consumption, 19 CFR 24.23(a)(2)), informally entered or released, or only admitted to a foreign-trade zone?

fee_conveyance.description: On what conveyance does the merchandise arrive: a commercial vessel, a commercial truck, a commercial railroad car, a commercial aircraft, or another way (such as mail, pipeline or a non-commercial vehicle)?

fee_excise_product.description: Is the merchandise subject to a federal excise tax collected at entry: distilled spirits, wine or beer; tobacco products or cigarette papers or tubes; taxable fuel (gasoline, diesel fuel or kerosene, 26 U.S.C. 4081); alcohol beverages or tobacco products brought from Puerto Rico or the Virgin Islands; or none of these?

fee_aqi_treatment.description: Does the consignment require treatment on arrival, as a preassigned condition of entry or as a remedial measure ordered after APHIS or CBP inspection (7 CFR 354.3(h))?

fee_mpf_exemption.description: Does a 19 CFR 24.23(c) merchandise processing fee exemption apply: none; an article of HTSUS chapter 98 other than 9802.00.60 or 9802.00.80; an article of 9802.00.60 or 9802.00.80; a product of a U.S. insular possession, a CBERA beneficiary country or a least-developed beneficiary developing country; merchandise of General Note 19, released under 19 U.S.C. 1321 or imported by mail (other than formally entered Inbound EMS); USMCA-originating goods or products of Israel; or goods originating under the Singapore, Chile, Australia, Bahrain, CAFTA-DR, Oman, Peru, Korea, Colombia or Panama agreements?

fee_hmf_port.description: Is the cargo unloaded from the commercial vessel at a port listed in 19 CFR 24.24(b)(1) as subject to the harbor maintenance fee?

fee_hmf_exemption.description: Is the cargo exempt from the harbor maintenance fee under 19 CFR 24.24(c) (bunker fuel and ship's stores, fish not previously landed, ferry passengers and vehicles, listed Alaska, Hawaii and possession movements, vessels paying the Inland Waterway Fuel Tax, in-bond cargo for direct exportation, U.S. Government cargo, or certified humanitarian cargo)?

fee_fuel_bulk_transfer.description: Is the taxable fuel entered into the United States by bulk transfer (pipeline or vessel, 26 CFR 48.4081-1)?

fee_fuel_enterer_registrant.description: Is the enterer of the taxable fuel a taxable fuel registrant (registered under 26 U.S.C. 4101)?

p65_california_consumers.description: Will the imported product be sold or otherwise made available to consumers in California, so that individuals in California may be exposed to it (Cal. Health & Safety Code 25249.6)?

p65_business.description: Does the business responsible for the product employ 10 or more employees, fewer than 10 employees, or is it a city, county, district, the state, the federal government or one of their agencies, or an entity operating a public water system (Cal. Health & Safety Code 25249.11(b))?

p65_listed_chemical.description: Can the product expose individuals to a chemical on the Proposition 65 list of chemicals known to the state to cause cancer or reproductive toxicity (Cal. Health & Safety Code 25249.8): a listed carcinogen; a listed reproductive toxicant; both a listed carcinogen and a different listed reproductive toxicant; a chemical listed for both cancer and reproductive toxicity; or no listed chemical? The listing status is declared.

p65_exemption.description: Does a Health & Safety Code 25249.10 exemption apply to the exposure: none; the exposure takes place less than twelve months after the chemical was listed; the business can show the exposure poses no significant risk (carcinogens) and no observable effect at 1,000 times the level (reproductive toxicants); or federal law governs the warning in a manner that preempts state authority?

p65_product.description: Is the product a consumer product under the general safe-harbor warning methods and content (27 CCR 25602, 25603); a food or dietary supplement (27 CCR 25607.1, 25607.2); or a product or exposure for which another section of 27 CCR 25607 et seq. states its own warning method and content?

p65_sales_channel.description: Does the importer sell or transfer the product to another business (a distributor or retail seller) that sells it to consumers in California, or sell it directly to consumers itself, including over the internet or by catalog?

p65_written_agreement.description: Has the importer entered into a written agreement with the business it sells or transfers the product to that allocates legal responsibility for providing the warning between them (27 CCR 25600.2(i))?

abc_origin.description: Are the alcoholic beverages brought into California from outside the United States, or from another state?

abc_destination.description: Are the beverages brought into California for delivery or use within California (beverages consigned to a California destination are presumed to be, Cal. Business and Professions Code 23663), or only in transit through the state?

abc_exemption.description: Does an exception apply: none; a reasonable amount brought by an adult from outside the United States for personal or household use (23661(c)); a personal or household shipment by an adult member of the U.S. Armed Forces serving abroad (23661(e)); or a passenger carrier bringing beverages only for sale on board (23664)?

abc_carrier.description: Are the beverages brought into California by a common carrier?

abc_consignee.description: To whom are the beverages consigned in California: a licensed importer at its licensed premises; a licensed importer or customs broker at the premises of a licensed public warehouse; a licensed customs broker at its own premises; or another person?

abc_beverage.description: Are the beverages distilled spirits, wine or beer?

requirement_facts.description: Documented requirement answers for the same entry; unknown answers remain omitted. Optional: omitting it is the same as declaring no answers, and dependent requirement families stay pending.

rule_ids.description: Omit to screen all catalog families. An empty array selects none and never means clearance. Duplicate identifiers are evaluated once in catalog order; unknown identifiers are rejected.

items.description: One U.S. state, as an ISO 3166-2 code.

destination_states.description: U.S. states the goods will be sold or distributed in. Each named state's requirements are returned in state_requirements; an unsupported code is rejected. Omit to assess no state; the federal results do not change either way.

200.description: Same-entry scoped results, potentially incomplete. Neither 200 nor a known deposit implies clearance.

assessment_statuses.description: Versioned independent assessment axes. Deposit estimates cannot promote scope or identity.

known_conditional_deposit_subtotal_usd.description: Sum of known conditional case deposits only. Unresolved cases are not zero; this is never a payable total.

unresolved_deposit_cases.description: Selected cases excluded from the known conditional subtotal because their deposit is unresolved.

cases.description: Independent statuses for each selected case.

items.description: One case with separate evidence, identity, scope and deposit outcomes.

scope.description: One independent assessment axis, conditional on declared facts and admitted evidence.

status.description: Independent status; resolved_on_declarations never authenticates customer facts.

missing_sources.description: Specific missing authority or documentary proof, not an instruction to infer it.

declared_identity.description: One independent assessment axis, conditional on declared facts and admitted evidence.

status.description: Independent status; resolved_on_declarations never authenticates customer facts.

missing_sources.description: Specific missing authority or documentary proof, not an instruction to infer it.

documentary_support.description: One independent assessment axis, conditional on declared facts and admitted evidence.

status.description: Independent status; resolved_on_declarations never authenticates customer facts.

missing_sources.description: Specific missing authority or documentary proof, not an instruction to infer it.

references.description: Supplied document hashes, not proof of authenticity.

items.description: Document digest and declared party role; no raw document or private storage location.

official_party.description: One independent assessment axis, conditional on declared facts and admitted evidence.

status.description: Independent status; resolved_on_declarations never authenticates customer facts.

missing_sources.description: Specific missing authority or documentary proof, not an instruction to infer it.

deposit.description: One independent assessment axis, conditional on declared facts and admitted evidence.

status.description: Independent status; resolved_on_declarations never authenticates customer facts.

missing_sources.description: Specific missing authority or documentary proof, not an instruction to infer it.

conditional_on_merchandise_scope.description: A proven party/date deposit is conditional on unresolved merchandise scope; legacy payable components remain null.

valuation.description: Full declared customs value and exact quantities; no inferred conversions.

customs_value_usd.description: Full declared customs value in USD, not reduced Chapter98 value; absent when no value was declared.

freshness.description: One independent assessment axis, conditional on declared facts and admitted evidence.

status.description: Independent status; resolved_on_declarations never authenticates customer facts.

missing_sources.description: Specific missing authority or documentary proof, not an instruction to infer it.

provenance.description: One independent assessment axis, conditional on declared facts and admitted evidence.

status.description: Independent status; resolved_on_declarations never authenticates customer facts.

missing_sources.description: Specific missing authority or documentary proof, not an instruction to infer it.

producer_exporter_pair_independently_ver.description: No independent shipment producer/exporter pair authentication has occurred.

classification.description: Official statistical reporting units of the declared line, from the same resolver as GET /v1/lookup.

entry_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of normalized classification, entry identity/date/value/quantities and all declared facts; not legal evidence.

scope.description: Explicit cases or one bounded inventory page, plus selected requirement families. Never full legal coverage.

assessment_scope.description: Present when this result assesses one bounded page of the observed inventory.

inventory_revision.description: Immutable authority inventory revision selecting the assessed case set.

inventory_observed_at.description: Acquisition time of the authority inventory, not its legal effective date.

inventory_case_count.description: Distinct authority inventory cases attempted, including cases with missing reviewed evidence.

screening.description: Present for authority_inventory requests. All reconciled cases remain visible, including not-prioritized cases. Ranking is not applicability.

scope_hts_match_count.description: Orders whose scope-HTS statement lists the supplied classification, a line a later HTS revision transferred a listed line's goods to, or a provision in the same 6- or 8-digit subheading. Ranking only.

scope_hts_stated_case_count.description: Screened orders with a scope-HTS statement read from CBP instructions; the rest are unknown, never unlisted.

scope_hts_match.description: Where the supplied classification sits against the order's scope-HTS statement, which the order itself says is for convenience and customs purposes; the written scope is dispositive. unknown when no classification was supplied or no statement was read.

items.description: One stated HTSUS provision, as written in the source.

scope_hts_matched_provisions.description: The stated provisions producing the match, as the source writes them.

scope_hts_revision.description: For listed_successor, the HTS revision whose Change Record transferred the listed line's goods (in part) to the supplied line.

release.description: USITC HTS release whose Change Record states the transfer.

deleted.description: The listed line the release deleted.

effective_from.description: Date the transfer took effect in the HTS.

scope_hts_source.description: The CBP instruction whose scope text states the list.

published_on.description: CBP publication date of the message.

body_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the message body read.

registry_generation.description: Reviewed dataset revision used for these decisions, not a legal effective date.

exhaustive_order_coverage.description: Always false: the observed authority inventory and reviewed decisions do not prove exhaustive historical or circumvention coverage.

total_import_charges_usd.description: Always null: these case decisions do not determine all base duties, additional duties, fees or other orders.

cash_deposit_subtotal_usd.description: US dollars. Null when any requested case is unresolved; never a full import-charge total.

unavailable_cases.description: Requested cases lacking usable reviewed evidence. Any such case leaves the requested subtotal unresolved.

items.description: One requested case without usable reviewed evidence.

order_results.description: Separate canonical scope and deposit statuses for every requested order, including unsupported cases.

official_party_match.description: Source-defined assignment matches declared parties, not independent shipment identity.

case_coverage.description: Separate source-supported entry windows and evidence publication boundaries for each available case.

items.description: The reviewed entry window and evidence knowledge date for one case.

supported_from.description: First entry date supported by this reviewed record, inclusive.

verified_through.description: Last entry date verified against source evidence, inclusive. This is not a retrieval date or a guaranteed future legal end.

evidence_known_from.description: Earliest date the governing evidence was published or known; null when no separate knowledge boundary is recorded.

decisions.description: Reviewed per-case decisions for the supplied case set only.

items.description: One source-backed case decision; not a final assessment or exhaustive order search.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of the reviewed case revision used for this decision.

official_party_match.description: Source-defined party assignment match on unverified customer declarations.

selected_rate_id.description: Selected reviewed rate revision, or null when no rate is selected. Null alone does not establish exemption.

cash_deposit_estimate_usd.description: Case-specific estimated cash deposit in US dollars.

final_assessment.description: Always false: an estimated cash deposit is not final assessed liability.

evidence.description: Governing source snapshots for the case decision.

items.description: A retained official source and its exact evidence fingerprint.

locator.description: Section or paragraph identifying the governing statement within the source.

source_availability.description: Present when an AD/CVD source needed for this assessment is unavailable.

items.description: One unavailable evidence category, not a customer answer.

missing_sources.description: Unusable source categories, distinct from missing customer facts.

discovery.description: Inventory page accounting; every candidate remains in the traversal even if not prioritized.

status.description: Whether the current reconciled inventory was readable and source-current.

inventory_revision.description: Immutable inventory revision; null during an outage.

inventory_observed_at.description: Actual inventory acquisition time, not legal effective date; null when unavailable.

inventory_case_count.description: Distinct cases in the complete observed inventory, not all legal orders; null if unavailable.

page_size.description: Maximum cases evaluated and returned per request.

page_offset.description: Zero-based offset in the same ranked inventory revision.

returned_case_count.description: Cases returned and attempted on this page, including unresolved cases.

remaining_case_count.description: Inventory cases after this page; null when inventory is unavailable. Zero is not clearance.

next_cursor.description: Continuation for the same declaration and inventory revision, or null. Null during an outage is not completion.

is_last_page.description: This is the final inventory page; it does not prove prior pages were consumed, every legal order was discovered or every determination resolved.

exhaustive_order_coverage.description: No page or completed inventory traversal certifies exhaustive legal coverage.

screening.description: Existing authority-inventory ranking and limitations, with orders restricted to this page. Neither ranking nor an HTS mismatch excludes an order.

scope_hts_match_count.description: Orders whose scope-HTS statement lists the supplied classification, a line a later HTS revision transferred a listed line's goods to, or a provision in the same 6- or 8-digit subheading. Ranking only.

scope_hts_stated_case_count.description: Screened orders with a scope-HTS statement read from CBP instructions; the rest are unknown, never unlisted.

scope_hts_match.description: Where the supplied classification sits against the order's scope-HTS statement, which the order itself says is for convenience and customs purposes; the written scope is dispositive. unknown when no classification was supplied or no statement was read.

items.description: One stated HTSUS provision, as written in the source.

scope_hts_matched_provisions.description: The stated provisions producing the match, as the source writes them.

scope_hts_revision.description: For listed_successor, the HTS revision whose Change Record transferred the listed line's goods (in part) to the supplied line.

release.description: USITC HTS release whose Change Record states the transfer.

deleted.description: The listed line the release deleted.

effective_from.description: Date the transfer took effect in the HTS.

scope_hts_source.description: The CBP instruction whose scope text states the list.

published_on.description: CBP publication date of the message.

body_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the message body read.

adcvd.description: Canonical explicit-case or inventory-page AD/CVD determination. Discovery ranking is not scope or liability. Unavailable evidence is not a zero deposit.

charges.description: Same-entry AD/CVD deposit components; not a full charge calculation.

entry_fingerprint.description: Same normalized entry fingerprint as the top-level result.

coverage.description: Only supplied canonical owner components are composed.

known_duty_component_subtotal_usd.description: This operation does not calculate ordinary or additional duty.

selected_case_cash_deposit_subtotal_usd.description: Selected case deposits in USD; null if any selected case is unresolved, unavailable or outside the arithmetic bounds.

total_import_charges_usd.description: Full import charges are not determined.

exhaustive_order_coverage.description: No exhaustive order search has been established.

items.description: One unresolved composition condition; not an exemption.

components.description: One canonical deposit component per distinct selected case.

items.description: One source-backed case component or official evidence receipt.

owner.description: This endpoint composes only the AD/CVD owner.

status.description: Whether the component can be included in the selected-case subtotal.

amount_usd.description: Case deposit in USD, or null while unresolved.

reason.description: Unresolved composition condition, or null when included.

basis.description: Full declared inputs used by the canonical deposit resolver, including specific/compound rate quantities.

kind.description: Full entry inputs, never a Chapter 98 reduced valuation.

customs_value_usd.description: Full declared customs value in USD; absent when no value was declared.

quantities.description: Declared quantities in exact reviewed-rate units.

source.description: Owner evidence revision and finite coverage, empty when no reviewed case is available.

revision.description: Reviewed evidence revision identifier, or empty if unavailable.

supported_from.description: Earliest supported entry date, or empty if unavailable.

verified_through.description: Latest supported entry date, or empty if unavailable.

checked_at.description: Maintenance timestamp, not the legal coverage date.

items.description: One source-backed case component or official evidence receipt.

sha256.description: Digest of the retained source bytes.

locator.description: Governing section or passage in the source.

requirements.description: Screening completion is separate from proof of fulfilled obligations.

heading.description: Single assessed Chapter98 heading; null when none or multiple alternatives exist.

coverage.description: Known supplied components, not exhaustive import charges.

components.description: Independent ordinary, additional-duty, fee and tax owners, without counterfactual or alternative-claim duplication.

items.description: One canonical declared charge component with independent value basis and authority.

status.description: A declaration-based amount is not documentary verification.

amount_usd.description: Owner amount rounded to cents; unknown is null, not zero.

basis_usd.description: This owner’s monetary base, where applicable; not automatically the ordinary reduced basis.

source_url.description: Canonical owner’s legal source; detailed hashes and dates remain in tariff_calculation.result.

source_note.description: Specific retained authority or statutory scope explanation.

known_component_subtotal_usd.description: Sum of independently known components only; omitted owners remain unresolved.

items.description: One remaining legal-owner or source condition.

unresolved.description: Canonical unresolved assessments and composition conflicts.

known_declared_components_and_selected_d.description: Known single-claim components plus selected-case cash deposits, preserving each owner’s separate basis. Not added to the standard tariff subtotal; other owners, order coverage and document acceptance remain unresolved.

full_total_blockers.description: Remaining legal coverage conditions preventing a complete payable total.

total_import_charges_usd.description: No complete payable total is computed.

items.description: One owner with no assessed component.

unassessed_charge_owners.description: Owners without a canonical assessed component. An assessed component does not establish complete owner coverage; remaining conditions are retained in full_total_blockers.

400.description: Invalid or unknown input; customer evidence, rates and completion flags are rejected.

403.description: Operation not allowed for this credential.

404.description: The declared classification is not in the current schedule; no tariff result is returned. `classification` reports `data_unavailable` for it.

409.description: Inventory cursor no longer matches the entry or current inventory. Restart without a cursor.

503.description: Canonical tariff calculation unavailable. AD/CVD source outages alone are reported in a partial 200 result.

post.summary: Assess selected AD/CVD cases and requirements for one entry
post.description: Compatibility operation for explicit selected cases. Customer API key required. One successful request consumes one lookup under existing quota and overage rules. Required AD/CVD or party evidence outages return 503 before tariff calculation and do not consume a successful-request credit. Requirement evidence may remain unresolved within a partial result. Totals remain incomplete; results do not establish clearance. For product-first inventory discovery use POST /v1/import-assessments.

identity_document_references.description: Customer-supplied digests and transcribed party names only; documents are not authenticated or independently verified.

items.description: One unverified customer-supplied identity document reference.

line_id.description: Caller line identity, bound into the assessment fingerprint.

hts_code.description: Ten-digit merchandise classification in chapters 01–97, optionally dotted. Not a Chapter 98 claim.

country.description: Origin name or supported ISO alias.

customs_value_usd.description: Full customs value in US dollars, not a Chapter 98 reduced basis. Must fit exact safe-cent arithmetic. Optional: omit when not yet known. It is never defaulted; value-based amounts stay null and the value is reported as a missing calculation input.

tariff_facts.description: Canonical tariff facts, including structured Chapter 98/99 declarations and evidence references. The complete validated declaration is bound to the entry fingerprint.

tariff_claims.description: Chapter 98/99 claims checked by the canonical tariff resolver. Unresolved Chapter 98 treatment is returned for review, not treated as an applied reduced value.

items.description: Chapter 98/99 heading, normalized and bound to this entry.

mode.description: Shipping mode for the standard fee estimate; bound into the entry fingerprint.

quantities.description: Exact reviewed-rate units, at most six decimal places; no conversions.

party_cases.description: Optional mapping from a requested order number to documented company-case identities. Presence selects maintained published deposits for that order after reviewed scope checks; unavailable published evidence never falls back to a reviewed rate. Omit to retain reviewed-rate selection. Requires published evidence availability.

additionalProperties.description: Exact party assignments for one requested order. Omitted identities require more information; null means documented as unassigned.

exporter_company_case_number.description: Exact company case assigned to the exporter under this order, or documented absence.

producer_company_case_number.description: Exact company case assigned to the producer under this order, or documented absence.

origin_exporter_company_case_number.description: Exact company case of the origin-country exporter, or documented absence.

combination_company_case_number.description: Exact exporter-producer combination assignment, or documented absence.

authorization_company_case_number.description: Exact Commerce-authorized company case for the entry, or documented absence; a pending request is not authorization.

case_numbers.description: Requested official order identifiers. Duplicate identifiers are resolved once; omitted or unknown orders are not inferred inapplicable.

items.description: Official AD or CVD case number, not the catalog's record identifier.

adcvd_facts.description: Case-specific product and party facts only, e.g. silicon_weight_pct, exporter, producer. Unknown facts remain omitted. Reviewed rate assignments and source evidence cannot be supplied by the caller.

food_facility_registration_history.description: Does the facility have an uncancelled registration record, has it never registered, or was its previous registration cancelled? This declaration does not verify registration validity.

food_facility_owner_changed.description: Has ownership of the registered facility changed? An operator change alone is not an ownership change.

food_facility_ceased_operations.description: Has the registered facility ceased operations?

food_facility_ceased_us_food.description: Has the registered facility ceased providing food for consumption in the United States?

food_facility_changed_information.description: Which previously submitted registration information changed? Report ownership changes separately; for multiple fields, any listed nonoptional field triggers an update.

food_facility_paper_update_incorrect.description: Was information in a previously submitted mail or fax registration update incorrect when submitted?

food_facility_electronic_waiver.description: Has FDA granted an electronic-submission waiver under 21 CFR 1.245? A pending request is not a granted waiver.

food_facility_submitter.description: Will the owner/operator/agent in charge submit, or a third party? Has the facility authorized that third party?

food_facility_activity.description: Does this facility manufacture/process, pack, or hold food for U.S. consumption under 21 CFR 1.225 and 1.227?

food_facility_location.description: Is the food facility domestic or foreign?

food_facility_registration_exception.description: Is any 21 CFR 1.226 registration exemption claimed (for example a qualifying farm, retail establishment, restaurant or foreign further-processing facility)?

fsvp_exception.description: Legacy summary of 21 CFR 1.501. Answer none only when no exemption or inapplicability applies; a claim is decided from the typed scope facts instead (purpose, USDA inspection, juice/seafood, alcohol).

fsvp_modified_requirements.description: Legacy summary of 21 CFR 1.511–1.513. Answer none only for the standard FSVP; a claim is decided from the typed route facts instead (dietary supplement, route election and eligibility).

food.description: Is this food for human or animal use under the FDA definition?

food_exception.description: Which specific prior-notice exception, if any, is supported by the shipment facts?

cpsc_finished_product.description: Is this a finished product rather than a component?

cpsc_rule_applies.description: Has a specific applicable CPSC safety rule, ban or standard been identified?

cpsc_certificate_exception.description: Does a supported rule-specific certificate exception apply? A testing exception alone is not enough.

children_product.description: Does this fall under the children's-product certification regime?

foreign_manufactured.description: Was the product manufactured outside the United States?

entry_type.description: Is the entry for consumption or warehousing?

ftz_withdrawal.description: Is this a withdrawal from a foreign-trade zone for consumption or warehousing?

cpsc_de_minimis_claimed.description: Is the de minimis duty exemption under 19 U.S.C. 1321(a)(2)(C) claimed for this shipment?

cpsc_noncommercial_gift.description: Is this a noncommercial product sent by a consumer abroad to a consumer in the United States, such as a gift, rather than a purchase or commercial shipment?

cpsc_other_entry_route.description: What is this entry, if not for consumption or warehousing: admission to a foreign-trade zone, in-bond transit or exportation, temporary importation under bond, withdrawal from a bonded warehouse, or another route?

chemical_form.description: Legacy declaration, still accepted; TSCA certification is now decided from the tsca_* product and shipment facts. Is the chemical imported in bulk, a mixture, or as part of an article?

tsca_scope.description: Legacy declaration, still accepted; TSCA certification is now decided from the tsca_* product and shipment facts. Is the chemical subject to TSCA or within a legally established exclusion?

tsca_exclusion_clearly_identified.description: Legacy declaration, still accepted; use tsca_exclusion_identified_on_entry. Is its excluded status clearly identified for entry?

tsca_article_rule_requires_certification.description: Legacy declaration, still accepted; TSCA certification is now decided from the tsca_* product and shipment facts. Does a specific TSCA rule or order require certification for this article?

fcc_import_purpose.description: Is the device being imported for testing/evaluation (FCC compliance, product development or marketing suitability), demonstration at an industry trade show, repair, exclusively for U.S. Government use, solely for export, or another purpose?

fcc_device_quantity_band.description: How many units of this particular device model and generation are being imported: 1–400, 401–4,000, or more than 4,000? Count distinctly different models and separate generations separately; do not split one model/generation into artificial groups.

fcc_sale_or_marketing.description: Will the device be offered for sale or marketed?

fcc_us_sale_or_marketing.description: Will the device be marketed or offered for sale in the United States?

rf_device.description: Is this a radio-frequency device within the FCC import rules?

fcc_import_exception.description: Are you claiming a specific exception under 47 CFR 2.1202?

wood_packaging.description: What wood packaging or dunnage accompanies the shipment? Select solid if ANY solid wood is present, including mixed packaging.

wood_all_pieces_thinner_than_6mm.description: Does EVERY solid wood packaging piece have at least one dimension strictly below 6 mm? Answer no if any piece has all dimensions 6 mm or greater.

wood_packaging_source_country.description: Is the wood packaging being imported from Canada, or from anywhere else?

wood_packaging_botanical_group.description: Which botanical group is the wood packaging made from? Rutaceae subfamilies Aurantioideae, Rutoideae and Toddalioideae, and Fraxinus (ash), are excluded from the Canadian general permit.

wood_packaging_harvest_country.description: Were the trees the wood packaging is derived from harvested in Canada?

wood_packaging_moved_outside_canada.description: Has this wood packaging been moved outside Canada since it was produced? Answer unverified if reuse, recycling or remanufacture means you cannot establish it.

wood_shipment_character.description: Is the shipment commercial or noncommercial?

wood_canada_harvest_declaration.description: What declaration of Canadian harvest accompanies the packaging at importation?

dod_packaging_nonregulated_articles.description: Legacy summary of 7 CFR 319.40-3(b)(4). It is no longer used to decide the mark; the Department of Defense exception is decided from wood_packaging_dod_use and wood_packaged_cargo_regulated_article.

motor_vehicle_or_equipment.description: Is the item legally a motor vehicle, motor vehicle equipment, or neither? nhtsa_article states the same from product facts and is asked instead when this answer is neither.

foreign_origin_article.description: Is this a foreign-origin article? Legal origin is not necessarily the shipment country.

article_marking_exception_claimed.description: Is a specific article-marking exception claimed? Container obligations may remain.

cbp_marking_notice.description: Has CBP issued Form 4647, or its electronic equivalent, requiring marking, redelivery, exportation or destruction?

cbp_marking_disposition.description: How was the CBP marking notice resolved: still pending, marked under CBP supervision, accepted certificate of marking, export under CBP supervision, or destruction under CBP supervision?

article_repacked_before_withdrawal.description: Before withdrawal for consumption, is the article repacked in a bonded warehouse (19 CFR 19.8), manipulated under 19 U.S.C. 1562 (19 CFR 19.11), or manipulated but not manufactured in a foreign-trade zone (19 CFR 146.32)?

retail_repacking_after_release.description: Will the article be repacked in retail containers, such as blister packs, after release from CBP custody? Answer readily_openable_container if the new container can readily be opened for inspection by the ultimate purchaser and bears no U.S. address or other potentially misleading marking.

us_name_in_trademark_or_souvenir.description: Does a U.S. city or location, "United States" or "America" appear on the article as part of a trademark, trade name or souvenir marking?

other_place_name_on_article.description: Apart from a U.S. name in a trademark, trade name or souvenir marking (asked separately), do the words "United States", "American" or "U.S.A." (or a variation), a U.S. city or location, or the name of a foreign country or locality other than where the article was made appear on the article or its container?

tsca_customs_territory_entry.description: Is the shipment being entered into the customs territory of the United States (entry for consumption or warehousing, or withdrawal from a foreign-trade zone)? Answer no for admission into a foreign-trade zone or in-bond movement that is not entered.

tsca_product_use.description: What is the product, as imported and as a whole, for? A pesticide for pesticidal use; tobacco or a tobacco product; source, special nuclear or byproduct material; an article subject to the federal excise tax on firearms and ammunition, or its shot-shell or cartridge components; a food, food additive, drug, cosmetic or device for that use; or any other use. Answer other for an excluded chemical blended into a mixture made for another use.

tsca_fluid_or_particles.description: Is the product a fluid (liquid, gas, paste or solution) or particles (powder, granules, pellets or flakes)?

tsca_formed_to_shape.description: Is the product a manufactured item formed to a specific shape or design during manufacture?

tsca_shape_dependent_end_use.description: Do its end-use functions depend in whole or in part on that shape or design?

tsca_end_use_composition_change.description: Does its chemical composition change during end use? Answer incidental_to_end_use only for a reaction on end use (as with adhesives, paints, fuels, batteries, matches or safety flares) whose product has no commercial purpose separate from the item and is not itself made for distribution in commerce or as an intermediate.

tsca_composition.description: Is the chemical a single chemical substance, or a combination of two or more chemical substances (a mixture)?

tsca_removed_from_container.description: Is the substance in containers used for transportation or containment, intended to be removed from them, with an end use or commercial purpose separate from the container?

tsca_exclusion_identified_on_entry.description: Do the entry documents clearly identify the chemical as that excluded product (a pesticide, tobacco product, nuclear material, taxed firearm or ammunition article, or a food, food additive, drug, cosmetic or device)?

tsca_cbp_action.description: Has CBP taken TSCA action on this shipment: none, detained, released under bond after detention, refused entry, or demanded redelivery of a bonded shipment?

tsca_refusal_disposition.description: What will the importer do with the refused shipment: export it, abandon it, or bring it into compliance for EPA to reassess?

food_import_purpose.description: Why is this food being imported: commercial or other use, transshipment through the United States to another country, processing and future export, research or evaluation, personal consumption, or return of food made or grown in the United States?

food_us_public_distribution.description: Is the food intended for retail sale, or will it be sold or distributed to the public in the United States?

research_food_label.description: Is the food labeled with the exact statement "Food for research or evaluation use"?

research_food_quantity_use_disposal.description: Is the food a small quantity consistent with a research, analysis or quality-assurance purpose, used only for that purpose, with any unused quantity properly disposed of?

research_food_entry_declaration.description: Will the entry filed with CBP carry an electronic declaration that the food will be used for research or evaluation and will not be sold or distributed to the public?

personal_food_quantity_noncommercial.description: Was the food purchased or otherwise acquired by a person in a small quantity consistent with a non-commercial purpose?

us_food_processed_abroad.description: Was this food made, raised or grown in the United States, exported, and further manufactured or processed in a foreign country before its return?

food_usda_inspection.description: At the time of importation, is the food a meat food product under the Federal Meat Inspection Act, a poultry product under the Poultry Products Inspection Act, or an egg product under the Egg Products Inspection Act, subject to USDA requirements? Answer none for food regulated only by FDA, including other egg-containing foods.

food_juice_seafood.description: Is the food juice, fish or a fishery product, or a raw material or ingredient you will use to make juice or fish and fishery products yourself?

juice_seafood_supplier_haccp.description: Is the foreign supplier required to comply with, and in compliance with, the juice (21 CFR part 120) or seafood (21 CFR part 123) HACCP regulation?

importer_juice_seafood_haccp_compliance.description: Are you in compliance with 21 CFR part 120 or part 123 for the juice or fish and fishery products you make from the imported ingredient?

food_alcohol_link.description: Is the food an alcoholic beverage, a non-alcoholic food from an alcoholic-beverage facility, or a raw material or ingredient you will use to make, pack or hold alcoholic beverages yourself?

alcohol_supplier_treasury_permit_type.description: Is the foreign supplier a facility of a type that, if domestic, would need a Treasury permit, registration or approved notice or application under the Federal Alcohol Administration Act or chapter 51 of the Internal Revenue Code?

alcohol_supplier_fda_registered_for_alco.description: Is the foreign supplier required to register with FDA as a food facility because it manufactures or processes alcoholic beverages?

non_alcoholic_food_prepackaged_no_contac.description: Is the non-alcoholic food in prepackaged form that prevents any direct human contact with it?

non_alcoholic_food_share_of_facility_sal.description: As determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, is the non-alcoholic food at most 5 percent of the facility's overall sales, or more?

importer_makes_alcoholic_beverages_regis.description: Will you use the ingredient to make, pack or hold alcoholic beverages yourself at a facility required to register with FDA?

importer_part117_exempt_117_5i.description: Is that facility exempt from 21 CFR part 117 under 21 CFR 117.5(i)?

dietary_supplement.description: Is the food a dietary supplement, a dietary supplement component, or neither?

dietary_supplement_further_manufacturing.description: Is it imported for further manufacturing, processing or packaging as a dietary supplement?

part111_specifications.description: Who must establish specifications for it under 21 CFR 111.70(b) or (d), and is that party in compliance with 21 CFR 111.73 and 111.75 for them: you, your customer, or neither?

customer_part111_written_assurance.description: Do you hold your customer's written assurance of that compliance, obtained within the last year?

fsvp_route_election.description: Which FSVP will you follow for this food and foreign supplier: the standard FSVP, the very-small-importer requirements, the small-foreign-supplier requirements, or the requirements for food from a country with an FDA-recognized or equivalent food-safety system?

very_small_importer_status.description: Do you meet the 21 CFR 1.500 very-small-importer definition for this kind of food (average annual food sales plus U.S. market value of food held without sale below the inflation-adjusted threshold over the applicable 3-year period, including subsidiaries and affiliates)?

small_foreign_supplier_type.description: Is the foreign supplier a qualified facility (21 CFR 117.3 or 507.3), a produce farm that is not a covered farm under part 112, a shell-egg producer with fewer than 3,000 laying hens, or none of these?

food_further_processing_intended.description: Is the food intended for further manufacturing or processing? Packaged food and raw agricultural commodities that will not be commercially processed before consumption are not.

comparable_system_recognition.description: Is the foreign supplier located in, and under the oversight of, a country whose food-safety system FDA has officially recognized as comparable or determined equivalent, with this food within that recognition's scope?

supplier_good_compliance_standing.description: Is the foreign supplier in good compliance standing with the food-safety authority of its country?

us_owner_or_consignee_at_entry.description: At the time of entry, is there a person in the United States who owns the food, has purchased it, or has agreed in writing to purchase it?

us_agent_designation.description: Has the foreign owner or consignee designated a U.S. agent or representative as the FSVP importer, and has that agent signed a statement consenting to serve as importer?

fsvp_importer_ufi.description: Which unique facility identifier will identify the FSVP importer on the entry: a DUNS number, UNK, none, or another identifier?

fsvp_importer_duns_location.description: Does that DUNS number correspond to the importer's U.S. location?

fsvp_program_status.description: Have you developed an FSVP for this food and foreign supplier, and do you maintain and follow it?

food_fdca_418_419.description: Does FD&C Act section 418 (hazard analysis and risk-based preventive controls, 21 CFR part 117 or 507) or section 419 (produce safety, 21 CFR part 112) apply to how this food is produced, or neither?

food_major_food_allergen.description: Does the food contain a major food allergen, so that the FD&C Act section 403(w) allergen-labeling requirements apply?

food_lacf_part113.description: Is the food a thermally processed low-acid food in a hermetically sealed container (21 CFR part 113) that will not be further manufactured or processed, a raw material or ingredient you use to make such a food yourself in compliance with part 113, or neither?

fsvp_receiving_facility.description: Are you a receiving facility for this food under 21 CFR 117.3 or 507.3, and if so, do you implement preventive controls for its hazards (117.135 or 507.34), are you not required to under 117.136 or 507.36, or do you implement a supply-chain program (part 117 subpart G or part 507 subpart E) for it?

fsvp_qualified_individual.description: Is a qualified individual, with the education, training or experience each FSVP activity needs and able to read and understand the language of the records reviewed, assigned to develop the FSVP and perform its activities?

fsvp_hazard_analysis_outcome.description: Does your written hazard analysis for this food (21 CFR 1.504) identify any known or reasonably foreseeable hazard that requires a control?

fsvp_hazard_analysis_by.description: Who conducted the hazard analysis: you, or another entity whose analysis by a qualified individual you have reviewed, assessed and documented, or another entity whose analysis you have not reviewed?

food_covered_produce.description: Is the food a raw agricultural commodity that is a fruit or vegetable and covered produce under 21 CFR 112.3?

food_rte_exposed_no_later_control.description: Is the food ready-to-eat and exposed to the environment before packaging, with no later treatment or control that would significantly minimize environmental pathogens?

fsvp_hazard_control_point.description: Who controls the hazard that requires a control: the foreign supplier, the foreign supplier's raw-material or other supplier, no one because the food cannot be consumed without the control, your customer subject to preventive controls (part 117 or 507 subpart C), your customer not subject to them, an entity later in the distribution chain, or your own documented downstream system?

fsvp_downstream_assurance.description: Do the documents accompanying the food disclose that it is "not processed to control" the hazard, and do you hold the current annual written assurance the downstream route requires?

fsvp_serious_hazard.description: Is there a reasonable probability that exposure to the hazard the foreign supplier controls will result in serious adverse health consequences or death to humans or animals?

fsvp_onsite_audit_status.description: For that hazard, when was the foreign supplier's last onsite audit: within the last 12 months, none or more than 12 months ago, or do you have a written determination that other verification activities or a less frequent audit provide adequate assurance?

fsvp_supplier_evaluation.description: Is your evaluation of this foreign supplier and food current and documented, not yet performed, more than 3 years old, or not yet reevaluated after new information about the supplier or food?

fsvp_supplier_evaluation_by.description: Who evaluated the foreign supplier: you, or another entity (not the supplier) whose evaluation by a qualified individual you have reviewed, assessed and documented, or another entity whose evaluation you have not reviewed?

fsvp_supplier_fda_compliance.description: Is any FDA warning letter, import alert or other FDA compliance action known for this foreign supplier?

fsvp_supplier_approval.description: Is the foreign supplier approved on the basis of its documented evaluation, used temporarily without approval with a documented justification and verification before import, or not approved?

fsvp_verification_activity.description: Which verification activity have you determined for this food and supplier: onsite audit, sampling and testing, review of the supplier's food-safety records, another appropriate activity, or not yet determined?

fsvp_verification_determined_by.description: Who determined the verification activity and its frequency: you, another entity (not the supplier) whose determination by a qualified individual you have reviewed, assessed and documented, or the foreign supplier?

fsvp_verification_performer.description: Who performs the verification activity: you or a qualified third party, or the foreign supplier or its employees?

fsvp_verification_conflict.description: Is the person performing the verification activity free of financial conflicts of interest that influence the results, with payment not related to the results?

fsvp_supplier_noncompliance.description: Have you determined that the foreign supplier does not use processes and procedures that provide the required level of protection, or produced food that is adulterated or misbranded under section 403(w): not known, found through verification or reevaluation, or found through other information?

fsvp_noncompliance_response.description: After that determination, have you taken corrective action and addressed its causes, discontinued the supplier until the causes are addressed, or continued using it without addressing them?

fsvp_records_language.description: Are your FSVP records kept in English or in another language?

fsvp_records_location.description: Where are your FSVP records kept: onsite, offsite and retrievable within 24 hours of an FDA request, or electronically and accessible from an onsite location?

fsvp_records_existing.description: Are the FSVP records new, existing records kept for other federal, state or local requirements that already contain all required information, or existing records supplemented with the missing information?

fsvp_entry_line_transmission.description: For each food line, will the filer transmit entity role code FSV with the FSVP importer's name, email address and DUNS number, FSV with one of those missing, or no FSVP code (FSV, FSX or RNE) at all?

fsvp_importer_duns_format.description: Is the importer's identifier in the Entity Number field exactly nine numeric digits, or another format?

fsvp_importer_duns_selection.description: Does the importer have one U.S. location with a DUNS number, or several; and if several, will it use the DUNS of the location where it keeps its FSVP records, of another location from which the records can be provided within 24 hours, or a different DUNS on different entries?

fsvp_verification_results.description: Have the results of the dietary-supplement verification activities been promptly reviewed, assessed and documented, not reviewed, or do they show the supplier is not producing to part 111's level of protection?

fsvp_food_for.description: Is the food you import as a very small importer human food, animal food, or both?

fsvp_vsi_status_documentation.description: Have you documented that you meet the very-small-importer definition for this calendar year (before first importing as one and by December 31 each year), or not?

fsvp_vsi_sales_currency.description: Were all food sales in the 3-year period in U.S. dollars, or were some in other currencies?

fsvp_small_supplier_status_assurance.description: Do you hold the supplier's written assurance that it meets the small-foreign-supplier criterion for this calendar year, obtained before approving it for the year and renewed by December 31, or is it missing or not renewed?

fsvp_1512_supplier_assurance.description: Is the foreign supplier's written assurance under 21 CFR 1.512(b)(3) current (obtained before importing and within the last 2 years), or missing or older than 2 years?

fsvp_qualified_facility_assurance_conten.description: Does the qualified facility's written assurance include a brief description of its preventive controls for the applicable hazard, a statement that it complies with applicable non-Federal (including foreign) food-safety law, or neither?

wood_packaging_dod_use.description: Is the wood packaging used by the U.S. Department of Defense to package this shipment: a DOD shipment, a commercial shipment under a DOD contract, or neither?

wood_packaged_cargo_regulated_article.description: Does the cargo in the wood packaging include any unprocessed or only primarily processed wood article listed in 7 CFR 319.40-1: logs, lumber, trees or tree portions, bark, cork, laths, hog fuel, sawdust, painted raw wood products, excelsior, wood chips, wood mulch, wood shavings, pickets, stakes, shingles, solid wood packing materials, humus, compost, litter or wooden handicrafts?

wood_packaging_ippc_mark.description: Does every solid wood packaging piece carry the IPPC mark with the country code, producer number and HT or MB treatment code? Answer unknown if it has not been checked.

wood_loose_packing.description: Does the shipment include loose wood packing material (excelsior or wood wool, sawdust or wood shavings)? If so, is it dry?

nhtsa_article.description: What is being imported: a vehicle manufactured primarily for use on public streets, roads and highways; a vehicle not manufactured primarily for public-road use; a system, part, component or accessory of a road vehicle; an item that is not a system, part or component of a road vehicle but could be taken for one; or goods unrelated to vehicles?

nhtsa_entry_basis.description: Which basis will the declaration state: certified conforming; replica imported by a low-volume manufacturer; Canadian-certified vehicle for personal use; conformance by a Registered Importer; solely for export; nonresident temporary personal use; foreign-government personnel; foreign armed forces; vehicle 25 or more years old or equipment made before any applicable standard; research, investigation, show or display, demonstration, training or racing; further manufacturing required; theft-marked equipment; or import to prepare an eligibility petition?

nhtsa_certification_label.description: Does the vehicle bear the certification label permanently affixed by its original manufacturer (or, for equipment, does the item or its delivery container bear the manufacturer's certification) that it conforms to all applicable safety, bumper and theft prevention standards?

nhtsa_low_volume_replica.description: Is the vehicle a replica motor vehicle eligible for an exemption under 49 CFR part 586, imported by a low-volume manufacturer as defined in 49 CFR 586.4?

nhtsa_canadian_certification.description: Was the vehicle certified by its original manufacturer as complying with all applicable Canadian motor vehicle safety standards?

nhtsa_manufacturer_us_conformity.description: Has the original manufacturer informed NHTSA that the vehicle conforms to all applicable U.S. safety, bumper and theft prevention standards, or to all of them except the labeling requirements of Standards 101 and 110 or 120 and/or the daytime running lamp specifications of Standard 108?

nhtsa_salvage_or_reconstructed.description: Is the vehicle a salvage motor vehicle (repair cost above 75% of retail value, acquired by an insurer in a damage settlement, or voluntarily designated salvage), a repaired salvage vehicle, a reconstructed vehicle (body under 25 years old on a chassis or frame that is not its original and is under 25 years old), or none of these?

nhtsa_personal_use.description: Is the vehicle imported for the importer's personal use?

nhtsa_theft_standard_conformity.description: Does the vehicle conform to all applicable Federal theft prevention standards?

nhtsa_registered_importer.description: Is the importer a Registered Importer with NHTSA whose registration is not suspended or revoked, has the importer contracted with such a Registered Importer, or neither?

nhtsa_model_eligibility.description: Has NHTSA determined under 49 CFR part 593 that this model and model year is eligible for importation?

nhtsa_vehicle_count.description: Does this entry cover a single vehicle or more than one?

nhtsa_export_label.description: Do the vehicle or equipment item, and the outside of any container of the equipment item, bear a label or tag stating that it is intended solely for export?

nhtsa_nonresident_foreign_registration.description: Is the importer a nonresident of the United States importing a vehicle registered in a country other than the United States?

nhtsa_temporary_stay.description: Will the vehicle be imported temporarily for personal use for no more than one year, not be sold during that time, and be exported within one year after entry?

nhtsa_assignment_status.description: Is the importer foreign-government personnel on assignment in the United States (or a member of the Secretariat of a designated public international organization) within the class the Department of State has authorized for free entry of vehicles, a member of a foreign country's armed forces on assignment in the United States, or neither?

nhtsa_vehicle_age.description: Is the vehicle 25 or more years old?

nhtsa_equipment_pre_standard.description: Was the equipment item manufactured on a date when no applicable safety or theft prevention standard was in effect?

nhtsa_special_purpose.description: Is the vehicle or equipment imported solely for research, investigations, show or display, demonstrations or training, or competitive racing events, or for another purpose?

nhtsa_special_purpose_authority.description: Does the importer hold NHTSA's written permission for this importation, is the importer an original manufacturer of vehicles certified to all applicable safety standards (or a wholly owned subsidiary of one), or neither?

nhtsa_further_manufacturing.description: Does the vehicle or equipment require further manufacturing operations to perform its intended function, or only the addition of readily attachable items (such as mirrors, wipers or tire and rim assemblies) or minor finishing such as painting?

nhtsa_theft_marking.description: Are the parts that 49 CFR part 541 requires to be marked marked in accordance with that part, not marked, or does part 541 require no marking for this vehicle or item?

nhtsa_petition_notice.description: Has the Registered Importer informed NHTSA in writing that it intends to submit, or has submitted, a petition for a decision that the vehicle is eligible for importation?

nhtsa_petition_permission.description: Has the Registered Importer received NHTSA's written permission to import the vehicle to prepare that eligibility petition?

rough_diamond_goods.description: Does the shipment include diamonds, and in what state: unsorted (HTS 7102.10); unworked or simply sawn, cleaved or bruted (7102.21 or 7102.31); worked beyond that; synthetic or reconstructed (heading 7104); or no diamonds?
