rough_diamond_movement.description: Are the rough diamonds imported into the United States, brought through the United States in transit or transshipment to another country, or exported from the United States?

rough_diamond_entry.description: Are the rough diamonds entered for consumption, entered for a bonded warehouse, or admitted to a foreign-trade zone?

rough_diamond_export_territory.description: From which territory are the rough diamonds exported to the United States? Give the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of that territory, or other if it is not listed.

rough_diamond_destination_territory.description: To which territory are the rough diamonds exported from the United States? Give the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of that territory, or other if it is not listed.

rough_diamond_container.description: How is the shipment packed: sealed in a container with an indicator or barrier to entry that would show visible evidence of tampering; standard mailing or express-consignment packaging; packaging that only contains a resealable plastic bag; or unsealed?

rough_diamond_kp_certificate.description: Does the original Kimberley Process Certificate accompany the shipment, only a copy, or no certificate?

rough_diamond_certificate_language.description: Is the Kimberley Process Certificate in English, in another language with an English translation incorporated, or in another language without one?

rough_diamond_parcel_origin.description: Are all parcels in the shipment of unmixed origin (each from one country), or does it include a parcel of mixed-origin rough diamonds?

rough_diamond_entry_filing.description: Will the entry be filed through CBP's Automated Broker Interface (ABI), or as a non-ABI entry on CBP Form 7501?

rough_diamond_us_person.description: Is the party that imports (or, for an export, exports) the shipment a United States person: a U.S. citizen or permanent resident, an entity organized under U.S. law (including its foreign branches), or any person in the United States?

rough_diamond_transit_identical_state.description: Will the shipment leave the United States in the identical state in which it entered?

rough_diamond_kp_issuer.description: Is the Kimberley Process Certificate for the export issued by the U.S. Kimberley Process Authority (USKPA) or an entity it has licensed, or by someone else?

rough_diamond_aes_itn.description: Has the shipment been reported in the Automated Export System and an Internal Transaction Number (ITN) obtained before exportation?

rough_diamond_certificate_voided.description: Was any Kimberley Process Certificate intended for this export cancelled (voided), for example for loss or error?

shell_egg_goods.description: Does the shipment include eggs, and of what kind: shell eggs of the domesticated chicken, turkey, duck, goose or guinea; eggs of other species; egg products (dried, frozen or liquid eggs); or no eggs?

shell_egg_import_basis.description: Why are the shell eggs imported: for sale, distribution or other commercial use; exclusively for the consignee's personal use, display or laboratory analysis and not for sale or distribution; purchased abroad by an individual for consumption by the household, nonpaying guests and employees; or returned from abroad after inspection and marking by USDA?

shell_egg_small_import_quantity.description: How many shell eggs are in the personal-use, display or laboratory importation: 30 dozen or fewer; more than 30 dozen with the AMS Administrator's authorization; or more than 30 dozen without it?

shell_egg_sound_not_adulterated.description: Are the eggs sound, healthful, wholesome and fit for human food, not adulterated, and free of any substance not permitted by the Egg Products Inspection Act or 7 CFR part 57?

shell_egg_restricted_content.description: What do the eggs consist of: graded eggs within the tolerance for restricted eggs in the official standards for U.S. Consumer Grade B; graded eggs exceeding that tolerance; checks or dirties; leakers; or loss, inedible or incubator-reject eggs?

shell_egg_denatured.description: Have the loss, inedible or incubator-reject eggs been denatured or decharacterized and identified as 7 CFR part 57 requires?

shell_egg_consumer_packed.description: Are the eggs packed into containers destined for the ultimate consumer (a household consumer, restaurant, institution or other party purchasing or receiving shell eggs for consumption)?

shell_egg_refrigerated_45f.description: Have the consumer-packed eggs, at all times after packing, been stored and transported under refrigeration at an ambient temperature of no greater than 45 °F (7.2 °C)?

shell_egg_foreign_certificate.description: Is the consignment accompanied by a foreign inspection certificate with every item 7 CFR 57.915(b) lists; by one whose content the AMS Administrator has approved otherwise; by one missing items; or by none?

shell_egg_breaking_sealed_certified.description: Is this a properly sealed and certified shipment imported for breaking at an official egg products processing plant, to be segregated and controlled on arrival at that plant?

shell_egg_labeling.description: Do the immediate and shipping containers bear the labels 7 CFR 57.950 and 57.955 require, printed in English; are labels missing, incomplete or not in English; or is any label false or misleading?

shell_egg_pre_inspection_movement.description: Before AMS inspection, will the eggs stay at the port of arrival where first unloaded, move sealed to the place designated for inspection, or be delivered to the consignee under a customs bond?

tobacco_article.description: What is imported: cigarettes; cigars; chewing tobacco; snuff; pipe tobacco; roll-your-own tobacco; cigarette papers; cigarette tubes; processed tobacco (stemmed, fermented, threshed, cut, flavored or combined with non-tobacco ingredients, but not a finished tobacco product); unprocessed leaf tobacco (only grown, cured, baled or packed); or none of these? Processed tobacco in a package bearing a smokeless or pipe tobacco notice is declared as that product.

tobacco_origin.description: Where are the articles shipped from: a foreign country, the U.S. Virgin Islands, another U.S. possession, Puerto Rico, or are they U.S.-manufactured articles previously exported and now returned?

tobacco_export_labeled.description: Do the returned U.S.-manufactured articles bear the export mark, label or notice of 27 CFR 44.185 (including one concealed or covered, for example by a sticker)?

tobacco_returned_unchanged.description: Are the returned articles classifiable under HTSUS 9801.00.80 and returned without any change to the product or its shipping container?

tobacco_customs_exemption.description: Is an exemption claimed with CBP under the HTSUS or 19 CFR: none; in passenger baggage; for crew-member use; by a foreign official; a personal-use quantity CBP allows free of tax; or (not a tax exemption) tobacco products for personal consumption or a bona fide gift arriving in passenger baggage or by mail valued at $250 or less?

tobacco_weight_class.description: Do the cigarettes or cigars weigh not more than 3 pounds per thousand, or more than 3 pounds per thousand?

tobacco_length.description: Are the cigarettes, cigarette papers or cigarette tubes up to 6 1/2 inches long, or over 6 1/2 inches?

tobacco_large_cigar_price.description: Is the sale price of the large cigars (the price for which the importer sells them, including goods or services exchanged) $763.222 or less per thousand, or more than $763.222 per thousand?

tobacco_pipe_declaration.description: Does every package bear the declaration "pipe tobacco" in direct conjunction with, parallel to and as conspicuous as the brand name each time the brand name appears, or is it missing or less conspicuous anywhere?

tobacco_other_use_representation.description: Do the package, point-of-sale advertising or other product communications suggest a use other than pipe smoking, or does the package include cigarette papers or tubes?

tobacco_processed_container.description: Does each container of processed tobacco hold 10 pounds or less (including added non-tobacco ingredients), or more than 10 pounds?

tobacco_processed_removal_purpose.description: What is the processed tobacco removed for: destruction; export; delivery as a sample to a manufacturer to solicit orders; scientific or equipment testing that destroys or returns it; or another purpose (for example sale)?

tobacco_release.description: How are the articles released from customs custody: entered for consumption with tax paid; entered for a customs bonded warehouse or foreign-trade zone; in bond to an export warehouse proprietor; in bond to a manufacturer of tobacco products or cigarette papers and tubes; or, for returned U.S. articles, to the original manufacturer or to an export warehouse it has authorized?

tobacco_consumer_packages.description: Are the articles put up in the packages in which they will be sold or delivered to consumers?

tobacco_destined_for_export.description: Are the warehoused or FTZ articles shown to the satisfaction of TTB to be destined for export?

tobacco_consignee_ttb_permit.description: Does the manufacturer or export warehouse proprietor receiving the articles in bond hold a TTB permit (or, for cigarette papers and tubes, a TTB-assigned number) under 27 CFR part 40 or 44?

tobacco_entry_filing.description: Is the entry (or entry summary) filed electronically with CBP, or on paper?

tobacco_importer_permit.description: Does the importer hold a current TTB importer permit (TTB F 5200.24, effective on or after 2013-08-26 and not expired), a permit past expiry with a renewal filed within the 30 days before expiry, or no current permit (including a permit effective before 2013-08-26)?

tobacco_permit_scope.description: Does the permit authorize importing tobacco products, tobacco products and processed tobacco (an amended permit), or processed tobacco only?

tobacco_importer_entity.description: Is the applicant an individual, a corporation, or a partnership or association?

tobacco_trade_name.description: Does the applicant operate under a trade name?

tobacco_attorney_in_fact_signs.description: Will an attorney in fact (including a partner or member) sign the application or other documents for the importer, other than an officer whose authority comes with the corporate documents?

tobacco_eft_required.description: Was the importer (with its controlled group, more than 50% control) liable in the previous calendar year for $5,000,000 or more in taxes on cigars, cigarettes, cigarette papers and cigarette tubes under 27 CFR parts 40 and 41?

tobacco_permit_change.description: Has any of these changed or is it planned since the permit was issued: none; individual name; trade name; corporate name; a fiduciary taking over as a continuing business; a fiduciary only liquidating; transfer of ownership (including a partner or member change); a new officer or director or a person acquiring more than 10% of the stock; change in control of the corporation; relocation of the principal business office; address change by local authorities; or (processed tobacco) a change of storage premises?

tobacco_processed_non_permittee_sale.description: Does the importer export processed tobacco, or sell or transfer it to a person without a TTB permit as importer, manufacturer or export warehouse proprietor?

commerce_license_entry_route.description: How do the goods enter: a formal entry for consumption, an informal entry, admission to a foreign-trade zone, withdrawal from a zone for consumption, entry into a bonded warehouse, withdrawal from a warehouse for consumption, a temporary importation bond, or transportation and exportation?

commerce_license_ftz_admission.description: When the goods were admitted to the foreign-trade zone, was a Commerce import license reported on the admission (CBP Form 214)?

commerce_license_filer_registered.description: Is the party that will file for the license (importer, customs broker or agent) registered on Commerce's SIMA/AIM licensing system?

commerce_license_filer_address.description: What address does the party that would register have in the United States: a street address, only a P.O. box, or none?

commerce_license_status.description: Has the Commerce import license been issued yet? If so, is it valid (issued no more than 75 days earlier) on the date of importation, or did it expire before that date?

commerce_license_covered_value.description: Is the total value of the covered steel or aluminum portion of this entry under $5,000, or $5,000 or more?

commerce_license_parties.description: Across the covered lines of the entry, are the importer, exporter, manufacturer and country of origin the same, or do they differ between lines?

steel_melt_pour_country.description: Is the country where the raw steel was first melted in a steel-making furnace and poured into its first solid shape identified, for example on the mill test certificate?

aluminum_primary_content.description: Does the aluminum product contain primary aluminum (smelted from alumina), or only secondary aluminum re-melted from scrap?

aluminum_largest_smelt_country.description: Is the country where the largest volume of the primary aluminum in the product was smelted identified?

aluminum_second_smelt_country.description: Is the country where the second-largest volume of the primary aluminum was smelted identified, or is there no second source of primary aluminum?

aluminum_cast_country.description: Is the country where the aluminum was last liquified and cast into a solid state identified?

commerce_license_privileges.description: Does the filer still have electronic licensing privileges, or has Commerce revoked them?

commerce_license_system.description: Is Commerce's automatic licensing system available, or is it down for an extended period?

prior_notice_food_class.description: Is the article food under section 201(f) of the FD&C Act, or is it only a food contact substance (section 409(h)(6)) or a pesticide (7 U.S.C. 136(u))? Food includes feed, pet food, ingredients, additives, dietary supplements, beverages including alcohol and bottled water, and live food animals.

prior_notice_destination.description: Is the food imported into the customs territory of the United States (the 50 States, the District of Columbia or Puerto Rico), or only into a U.S. territory outside it (for example Guam or the U.S. Virgin Islands)?

prior_notice_accompanies_individual.description: Will the food be carried by, or otherwise accompany, an individual arriving in the United States?

prior_notice_personal_use.description: Is the food carried by or accompanying the individual for that individual's personal use (not for sale, distribution or business)?

prior_notice_made_in_personal_residence.description: Was the food made by an individual in that individual's personal residence?

prior_notice_sent_by_maker_as_personal_g.description: Is the food sent by the individual who made it, as a personal gift for nonbusiness reasons, to an individual in the United States?

prior_notice_submission_system.description: How will prior notice be submitted: through CBP ABI/ACE/ITDS; through the FDA Prior Notice System Interface (PNSI); because the broker's or self-filer's system or ABI/ACE/ITDS is not working; or under FDA's posted instructions during an FDA PNSI or OASIS outage?

prior_notice_express_consignment.description: Is the food arriving by an express consignment operator or carrier?

prior_notice_natural_state.description: Is the food in its natural state (for example harvested crops cleaned, trimmed or cooled attendant to harvest), or no longer in its natural state (made, cut, cooked, frozen, packaged or otherwise processed)?

prior_notice_transportation_exportation_.description: Is the food imported for transshipment through the United States under a Transportation and Exportation (T&E) entry?

prior_notice_post_confirmation_change.description: After FDA confirmed the prior notice, did any information change: none; only the quantity, anticipated arrival or planned shipment information; for mail, only the anticipated mailing date; other required information; or will the food no longer be imported?

prior_notice_arrival_outcome.description: At arrival: has the food not yet arrived; did it arrive after the full prior-notice time elapsed on a confirmed, accurate notice; did it arrive with no confirmed prior notice; was the notice found inaccurate; or did it arrive before the full time elapsed, with or without FDA having already reviewed the notice and advised CBP?

prior_notice_refused_food_disposition.description: For food refused for inadequate prior notice: will it be exported immediately from the port of arrival under CBP supervision with CBP concurrence, held within the port, or held at a secure facility outside the port?

prior_notice_foreign_facility_registrati.description: Is every foreign facility that must register under 21 CFR part 1, subpart H for this food registered (or not required to register), or is a facility that is required to register not registered?

cpsc_primarily_for_children_12_or_under.description: Is the product designed or intended primarily for children 12 years of age or younger? Consider the manufacturer's reasonable statement or label, how it is represented in packaging, display, promotion or advertising, whether consumers commonly recognize it as for that age, and CPSC's Age Determination Guidelines (15 U.S.C. 2052(a)(2)).

cpsc_private_labeled.description: Is the product manufactured in the United States labeled with the brand or trademark of someone other than its manufacturer, who authorized or caused that labeling, with no manufacturer brand or trademark on the label (a private label)?

cpsc_manufacturer_issues_certificate.description: For the privately labeled product, will the manufacturer itself issue the finished product certificate?

cpsc_ior_is_customs_broker.description: Is the importer of record a licensed customs broker making entry on behalf of an owner, purchaser or consignee?

cpsc_gcc_rule_requires_third_party.description: For a product that is not a children's product, does an identified rule, ban, standard or regulation require testing by an independent third party for that rule or for this class of products?

cpsc_third_party_testing_exclusion.description: Does a statutory exclusion from third-party testing apply to this children's product: an ordinary book or ordinary paper-based printed material (paper or cardboard, inks or toners, conventionally bound; not a book with play value, not for a child 3 or younger, no nonpaper parts), metal component parts of a bicycle for the lead content limits only, another exclusion stated in a specific rule, or none?

cpsc_small_batch_registered.description: Has the manufacturer (including an importer) registered with CPSC as a small batch manufacturer before using the small batch alternative or exemption?

cpsc_small_batch_revenue_within_threshol.description: In the previous calendar year, were the manufacturer's total gross revenues from sales of all consumer products, including every entity that controls, is controlled by or is under common control with it, at or below the small batch threshold ($1,000,000 as adjusted annually for inflation and published by CPSC)?

cpsc_small_batch_units_prior_year.description: How many units of this same product did the manufacturer make in the previous calendar year: 7,500 or fewer, or more than 7,500?

cpsc_small_batch_excluded_requirement.description: Is any applicable requirement one that small batch relief never covers: lead in paint (16 CFR 1303), full-size or non-full-size cribs or pacifiers, small parts, lead in children's metal jewelry, or baby bouncers, walkers and jumpers (listed_requirement); or is the product a durable infant or toddler product; or none?

cpsc_periodic_testing_basis.description: How is continued compliance of the children's product assured between certifications: a periodic testing plan only, a production testing plan, or continued testing by an ISO/IEC 17025-accredited testing laboratory?

cpsc_material_change.description: Has the children's product undergone a change in design, manufacturing process or sourcing of component parts that, exercising due care, could affect its ability to comply with an applicable rule?

cpsc_certificate_form.description: Apart from any eFiling, will the certificate be furnished and made available as a hard copy, or as an electronic certificate identified by a unique identifier and reached through a URL or other electronic means?

cpsc_relies_on_other_party_testing.description: Will the certifier rely, in whole or in part, on component part certificates or test reports, or on another party's finished product certificate or test reports?

doe_gas_product.description: What is being brought in: natural gas by pipeline in gaseous form; liquefied natural gas (LNG, including LNG in ISO containers); compressed natural gas (CNG); natural gas in another form (for example a gel, or natural gas mixed with artificial gas); only artificial or synthetic gas containing no natural gas; natural gas liquids or LPG (ethane, propane, butane); or other goods?

doe_gas_movement.description: Does the gas physically enter the United States for use or sale here (an import); cross the United States between points of one foreign country, or leave the United States through one foreign country and come back (in transit, returning to the country of origin); or is it an exchange by displacement, where authorized imported volumes are replaced by other gas for storage or flexibility and no gas crosses the border?

doe_gas_in_transit_path.description: Is the in-transit gas physically moved between two border crossing points along a commercially reasonable path without being diverted for other use, or is it a backhaul, displacement or other virtual movement, or diverted along the way?

doe_gas_in_transit_days.description: Does the gas cross the U.S. points of entry and exit within 30 days, or does it take longer?

doe_gas_displacement_term.description: What is the term of the exchange-by-displacement agreement: up to 5 years, or longer?

doe_gas_displacement_volume.description: Do the volumes imported under the exchange stay within the volumes of the existing import authorization, or exceed them?

doe_gas_displacement_net_effect.description: Is the net effect of the exchange the same as under the existing import authorization, or does it differ?

doe_gas_source_country.description: From which country is the natural gas imported (the country it is shipped to the United States from)?

doe_gas_transport_mode.description: How does the LNG or CNG reach the United States: by vessel, in ISO containers by vessel, by truck, by rail, or by other waterborne transport?

doe_gas_contract_term.description: What is the term of the gas purchase contract behind this import: two years or less (including spot purchases), or longer than two years?

doe_gas_authorization.description: What DOE authorization does the importer hold for this gas: none, an application pending with DOE, a blanket (short-term) authorization, or a long-term authorization?

doe_gas_authorization_scope.description: Does the DOE order cover this import (in its term, source country, form of gas, volumes and company name), or has it expired, or does this import fall outside its terms?

doe_gas_application_lead_time.description: Will the application be filed at least 90 days before the first import, or less than 90 days before it?

doe_gas_blanket_applicant.description: Is this the company's first blanket application, or a renewal under the same company name and associates as its previous authorization?

doe_gas_us_presence.description: Does the applicant or authorization holder reside or have a place of business or other corporate presence in the United States?

doe_gas_control_change.description: Has the applicant or authorization holder had a change in control (for example a sale, merger or 10% or more of voting securities changing hands), a change of company name, or neither?

shrimp_goods.description: Does the shipment contain shrimp, or products from shrimp (products containing shrimp), or neither?

shrimp_harvesting_nation.description: What is the harvesting nation: the nation or economy where the shrimp was raised in an aquaculture facility, or in whose waters it was harvested, whatever flag the vessel flies? Give the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or other if it is not listed. A country that only processed or re-exported the shrimp is not the harvesting nation.

shrimp_harvest_method.description: Was the shrimp raised and harvested in an aquaculture facility, or caught in the wild?

shrimp_aquaculture_pond_days.description: Did the shrimp spend at least 30 days in ponds of the aquaculture facility before being harvested?

shrimp_fishery.description: In which fishery, and with which gear or species, was the wild shrimp harvested: one the Department of State has made a determination for, or other?

shrimp_harvested_with_teds.description: Was the shrimp harvested by commercial trawl vessels using turtle excluder devices (TEDs)?

shrimp_export_date_period.description: When is the date of export, the date the shipment departed the last port of the harvesting nation: on or after 2026-04-21; 2025-06-01 to 2026-04-20; 2025-05-12 to 2025-05-31; or before 2025-05-12?

shrimp_ds2031.description: Is the shipment accompanied by a DS-2031 Shrimp Exporter's/Importer's Declaration with every block complete and legible and original signatures in all required signature blocks; one with a block incomplete or a signature missing; or none?

shrimp_government_attestation.description: Who signed Block 8 (government attestation) of the DS-2031 before export: an official of the harvesting nation's government, employed full time and identified to the Department of State; someone else (a private-sector representative or part-time employee); or no one?

shrimp_ds2031_all_stages.description: Did the original DS-2031 accompany the shipment through every stage of the export process, including any processing of the original product and any shipment through an intermediary nation?

composite_wood_goods.description: Does the shipment contain hardwood plywood (with a veneer or composite core), medium-density fiberboard or particleboard, and in what form: panels or bundles of panels; component parts used to assemble finished goods and not sold directly to consumers; finished goods, including component parts sold directly to consumers; or none? Hardboard, structural plywood (PS 1-19), structural panels (PS 2-18), structural composite lumber, oriented strand board, glued laminated lumber, prefabricated wood I-joists and finger-jointed lumber are not regulated composite wood products.

composite_wood_exclusion.description: Does a 40 CFR 770.1(c) exclusion apply: none; a finished good previously sold or supplied to an end user (for example an antique or secondhand furniture); wood packaging such as pallets, crates, spools or dunnage; or composite wood used inside a new vehicle (not a recreational vehicle) built entirely from new parts and never sold at retail or registered, a new rail car, new boat, new aerospace craft or new aircraft?

composite_wood_window_door.description: Is the product a window with less than 5 percent composite wood by volume; an exterior or garage door made from composite wood products manufactured with no-added formaldehyde-based or ultra low-emitting formaldehyde resins; an exterior or garage door with less than 3 percent composite wood by volume; or none of these?

composite_wood_testing_import.description: Are the panels imported solely for TSCA Title VI quality control or quarterly testing by a third-party certifier, not for sale?

composite_wood_supplier_statement.description: Do the bills of lading, invoices or comparable documents include the supplier's written statement that the goods are TSCA Title VI compliant; that the composite wood products were produced before June 1, 2018; or no such statement?

composite_wood_panel_label.description: Before import, is each panel labeled with the panel producer's name or number, lot number, EPA TSCA Title VI third-party certifier number and the TSCA Title VI certified statement; is only the bundle labeled, with a method such as color-coded edge marking that identifies each panel's supplier; is only the bundle labeled without such a method; or are the panels not labeled?

composite_wood_de_minimis.description: Does the finished good contain no more than 144 square inches of regulated composite wood, measured on the surface area of its largest face, and is it not designed to be used in combination or in multiples to create larger surfaces, finished goods or component parts?

composite_wood_goods_label.description: Before import, does each finished good carry the fabricator's label in legible English (fabricator's name, month and year of production and the TSCA Title VI compliant statement); does only each box or bundle carry it; or is there no such label?

radiation_product_category.description: Which FDA performance standard's applicability paragraph covers the product: television receiver with a cathode-ray tube (21 CFR 1020.10); cold-cathode gas discharge tube (1020.20); diagnostic x-ray system or listed component, including CT (1020.30–1020.33); cabinet x-ray system (1020.40); microwave oven (1030.10); laser product, other than one sold to a manufacturer for use as a component or replacement under 1040.10(a)(1)–(2) (1040.10–1040.11); sunlamp product or ultraviolet lamp for one (1040.20); high-intensity mercury vapor discharge lamp (1040.30); another electronic product that no standard covers (including ultrasonic therapy products, whose standard was removed in 2023); or not an electronic product?

radiation_manufacturer_agent.description: Has the product's manufacturer designated a permanent U.S. resident as its agent for service of process with FDA's Center for Devices and Radiological Health under 21 CFR 1005.25?

radiation_export_only.description: Is the product intended solely for export: no; yes, with the product and the outside of its shipping container labeled or tagged for export and the product meeting all requirements of the destination country; or yes, but without that labeling or destination compliance?

radiation_declaration_basis.description: Which declaration can the importer of record make on Form FDA 2877: the products were manufactured before the applicable standard's effective date; they comply with all applicable standards and carry the certification label or tag; they do not comply but are imported for research, investigations, studies, demonstrations or training, will not enter commerce and an exemption has been or will be requested; they do not comply but a petition to bring them into compliance has been or will be filed; or none of these?

hctp_article.description: Is this an HCT/P (human cells or tissues intended for implantation, transplantation, infusion or transfer into a human recipient), whole blood or a blood component, another biological product, or outside those categories? The exclusions in 21 CFR 1271.3(d) matter.

hctp_minimally_manipulated.description: Does the product meet 21 CFR 1271.3(f)'s minimal-manipulation definition?

hctp_homologous_use_only.description: Is the product intended only for homologous use, as shown by labeling, advertising and other objective-intent evidence?

hctp_combination.description: Is it uncombined, or combined only with water, crystalloids, or a sterilizing/preserving/storage agent that raises no new clinical safety concern; or combined with another article?

hctp_systemic_or_metabolic.description: Does it have a systemic effect or depend on living cells' metabolic activity for its primary function?

hctp_qualifying_use.description: If it has a systemic/metabolic effect, is its use autologous, allogeneic in a first- or second-degree blood relative, reproductive, or none of these?

hctp_establishment_exception.description: Which exact 21 CFR 1271.15 establishment exception, if any, applies? The contracted-recovery exception relieves only independent registration/listing.

hctp_intimate_partner_reproductive_impor.description: Is this a reproductive HCT/P donated by the recipient's sexually intimate partner for reproductive use?

hctp_peripheral_blood_stem_cell.description: Is this a peripheral-blood stem/progenitor-cell HCT/P?

hctp_unreasonable_disease_risk.description: For an imported peripheral-blood stem/progenitor-cell HCT/P, are there circumstances indicating an unreasonable risk of communicable-disease transmission?

hctp_ace_entry_data.description: Are the applicable 21 CFR 1.72 and 1.78 ACE entry fields and affirmations declared complete, or incomplete/missing? This does not verify FDA registration or admission.

ozone_bulk_substance.description: Is a substance imported in bulk, that is in a container for its transportation or storage such as a cylinder, drum, ISO tank or small can, and which: an HFC regulated substance listed in appendix A to 40 CFR part 84, alone or in a blend; a class I controlled substance listed in appendix A to 40 CFR part 82, subpart A (for example CFCs, halons, carbon tetrachloride, methyl chloroform, methyl bromide, HBFCs); a class II controlled substance listed in appendix B (HCFCs); a blend containing both an HFC and a controlled substance; substances only inside manufactured products such as appliances, aerosol cans or foams; or none of these?

ozone_hfc_import_basis.description: On what basis are the bulk HFCs imported: by expending consumption or application-specific allowances; under an EPA non-objection notice for use in a process resulting in their transformation or destruction; used HFCs under an EPA non-objection notice for destruction; as a transhipment through the United States to another country; or none of these?

ozone_container_100_lb_or_less.description: Are the HFCs imported for transformation or destruction in containers designed to hold 100 pounds or less of HFCs?

ozone_arrival_mode.description: Does the shipment arrive by marine vessel, or by another mode (truck, rail, auto or air)?

ozone_certificate_of_analysis.description: Is a certificate of analysis for the HFCs physically with the shipment, submitted electronically with the advance CBP filing instead, or neither?

ozone_container_label.description: Does each HFC container carry a durable label or permanent marking on its outside stating the common name, chemical name or ASHRAE designation of the HFC or blend and, for a blend, the percentages; or are the containers unlabeled or mislabeled?

ozone_class_i_import_basis.description: On what basis is the class I controlled substance imported: within essential-use allowances or exemptions or critical-use allowances held for it; a used substance under an EPA non-objection notice; for destruction under an EPA non-objection notice; for use in a process resulting in its transformation; as a transhipment; as a heel (no more than 10 percent of the container volume left after discharge); used halon in aircraft halon bottles for hydrostatic testing; methyl bromide solely for quarantine or preshipment applications; or none of these?

ozone_class_ii_import_basis.description: On what basis is the class II controlled substance (HCFC) imported: within unexpended consumption allowances held for it; a used substance under an EPA non-objection notice; for destruction under an EPA non-objection notice; for use in a process resulting in its transformation; as a transhipment; as a heel (no more than 10 percent of the container volume left after discharge); or none of these?

ftc_textile_category.description: Which textile fiber product is imported, by the 16 CFR 303.45(a) list: wearing apparel; floor coverings; another listed household textile (handkerchiefs, scarfs, bedding, curtains, draperies, table linens, towels, wash and dish cloths, ironing board covers, umbrellas, batts, flags with heading or over 216 square inches, cushions, furniture covers, afghans and throws, sleeping bags, antimacassars, hammocks, dresser scarfs); fibers, yarns or fabrics (including narrow fabrics other than packaging ribbons); a textile product not on that list; or no textile product?

ftc_fur.description: Is any article of wearing apparel in the shipment made in whole or in part of fur or used fur?

ftc_wool.description: Does the textile product contain, purport to contain or is it represented as containing wool, reprocessed wool or reused wool, and is it: an ordinary wool product; a carpet, rug, mat or upholstery; a wool product made more than 20 years before importation; or does it contain no wool?

ftc_textile_exclusion.description: Does a 16 CFR 303.45(b) exclusion apply: none; belts, suspenders, arm bands, permanently knotted neckties, garters, sanitary belts, diaper liners, labels, looper clips for handicraft, book cloth, artists' canvases, tapestry cloth or shoe laces; coated fabrics; discernibly secondhand household textile articles; disposable non-woven products for one-time use; curtains, casements, draperies or place mats made principally of slats, rods or strips of wood, metal, plastic or leather; products procured by the U.S. military services to specifications (not sold through exchanges, commissaries or ship stores); Navajo hand woven rugs with the Indian Arts and Crafts Board certificate of genuineness; or products made by company-store operators and sold only to their own employees?

ftc_fiber_representation.description: Does any label or advertisement for the product make a representation about its fiber content: none, or only with a full fiber content disclosure; an incomplete fiber content representation; or a false, deceptive or misleading one?

ftc_textile_form.description: Is the product in the form intended for sale, delivery to or use by the ultimate consumer; not yet in that form (for example piece goods or components for further manufacturing); or intended for uses outside the Textile Fiber Products Identification Act, with an invoice or other document stating so?

ftc_label_status.description: At entry, does every product already carry the label the FTC rules require (for fur, also on the invoice); or are products unlabeled or incorrectly labeled?

ftc_care_product.description: Is the product textile wearing apparel (a finished garment covering or protecting the body, including hosiery); footwear, gloves, hats or other articles used only to cover the head or hands; piece goods sold by the piece from bolts or rolls to make home sewn apparel; or other?

ftc_care_exemption.description: Does a 16 CFR 423.8 care labeling exemption apply: none; a totally reversible garment without pockets; an exemption the Commission granted on a written request; reliable proof that the product can be cleaned safely by all the harshest procedures listed in 423.8(d); or sale to institutional buyers for commercial use?

energy_covered_product.description: Which covered consumer product described in 16 CFR 305.3–305.6 is imported: an electric refrigerator, refrigerator-freezer or freezer; a clothes washer; a dishwasher; a water heater other than an electric instantaneous one; an electric instantaneous water heater; a room air conditioner; a portable air conditioner; a pool heater; a central air conditioner or heat pump rated below 65,000 Btu per hour; a furnace or boiler; a ceiling fan (not a large-diameter or high-speed small-diameter fan); a television with an internal tuner; a general service LED or OLED lamp; another general service lamp (medium base compact fluorescent or general service incandescent); a specialty consumer lamp; a general service fluorescent or incandescent reflector lamp; a fluorescent lamp ballast; a metal halide lamp fixture; a showerhead or faucet; a water closet or urinal; or none of these?

energy_new_product.description: Are the products new covered products, that is title has not yet passed to a purchaser buying them for purposes other than resale or leasing for more than one year, or has title already passed to such a purchaser?

energy_export.description: Are the products for distribution in commerce for use in the United States, imported or held for export and marked (on the product or its container) with a stamp or label stating they are intended for export, or held for export without that marking?

energy_produced_before_coverage_date.description: Was the television manufactured before May 10, 2011, or the portable air conditioner produced before October 1, 2022?

energy_label_status.description: Do the products carry the EnergyGuide label, Lighting Facts label or efficiency and water use marking 16 CFR part 305 requires for them, or are they not labeled?

energy_model_reported.description: Has the model's data (with the label website address, where required) already been reported to the FTC or to the Department of Energy through its Compliance and Certification Management System, or is it a new model not yet reported?

wildlife_shipment.description: Does the shipment contain fish or wildlife (any wild animal, alive or dead, including its parts, products, eggs and manufactured articles made from it); only domesticated animals 50 CFR 14.4 lists (for example cattle, horses, domestic dogs and cats, chickens, or routinely farm-raised insects) not obtained from wild populations; or no wildlife?

wildlife_import_category.description: Which describes the import: a general shipment; shellfish or nonliving fishery products imported for human or animal consumption (or taken for recreation in U.S. waters or on the high seas); live fish for those purposes; pearls; noncommercial wildlife products or articles worn as clothing or in accompanying personal baggage; wildlife products in the household effects of a person moving their residence; wildlife lawfully taken by a U.S. resident in the United States, Canada or Mexico and imported for noncommercial purposes; fish taken for recreation in Canada or Mexico; dead, preserved, dried or embedded specimens imported by accredited scientists or scientific institutions for taxonomic or systematic research, not taken by sport hunting; an article at least 100 years old made in part of an endangered or threatened species, not scrimshaw and not repaired with such species since December 28, 1973; a marine mammal lawfully taken on the high seas by a U.S. resident with Marine Mammal Protection Act authorization and imported directly; a personally owned pet bird; or wildlife moving in transit between two foreign countries and not unloaded in the United States?

wildlife_fur_hide_or_trophy.description: Is the item a raw fur, a dressed fur, a raw, salted or crusted hide or skin, a game trophy, or none of these?

wildlife_permit_parts_16_17_18_21_23.description: Does the wildlife require a permit under 50 CFR part 16, 17, 18, 21 or 23 (16 injurious wildlife, 17 endangered and threatened species, 18 marine mammals, 21 migratory birds, 22 eagles, 23 CITES)?

wildlife_permit_parts_17_23.description: Does the wildlife require a permit under 50 CFR part 17 or 23 (16 injurious wildlife, 17 endangered and threatened species, 18 marine mammals, 21 migratory birds, 22 eagles, 23 CITES)?

wildlife_permit_parts_16_17_18_21.description: Does the wildlife require a permit under 50 CFR part 16, 17, 18 or 21 (16 injurious wildlife, 17 endangered and threatened species, 18 marine mammals, 21 migratory birds, 22 eagles, 23 CITES)?

wildlife_permit_parts_16_17_18_21_22_23.description: Does the wildlife require a permit under 50 CFR part 16, 17, 18, 21, 22 or 23 (16 injurious wildlife, 17 endangered and threatened species, 18 marine mammals, 21 migratory birds, 22 eagles, 23 CITES)?

wildlife_permit_parts_16_17_23.description: Does the wildlife require a permit under 50 CFR part 16, 17 or 23 (16 injurious wildlife, 17 endangered and threatened species, 18 marine mammals, 21 migratory birds, 22 eagles, 23 CITES)?

wildlife_us_resident.description: Is the person importing the recreationally taken fish a U.S. resident importing it for noncommercial purposes?

wildlife_port.description: At which port is the wildlife imported: one of the designated ports of 50 CFR 14.12; a border port 50 CFR 14.16 lists for wildlife of that country of origin (Canada or the United States at the Canadian border, Mexico or the United States at the Mexican border); a special port 50 CFR 14.19 names for the final destination in Alaska, Puerto Rico, the Virgin Islands or Guam; a port named in a designated port exception permit; or another port?

wildlife_business.description: Is the wildlife imported for commercial purposes (sale, resale, trade, barter or other pursuit of gain; eight or more similar unused items are presumed commercial), for noncommercial purposes, by a public museum or public scientific or educational institution for noncommercial research or education, or by a Federal, State, tribal or municipal agency?

wildlife_live_or_perishable.description: Is the shipment live wild mammals or birds, other live or perishable wildlife, or neither?

wildlife_container_marking.description: How is each container or package marked: with the shipper's and consignee's names and addresses and accompanied by a contents list by scientific name, number and venomous status; marked "fish" or "wildlife" (or the species common name) with an accompanying invoice, packing list or bill of lading stating the parties and species; with the shipper's FWS import/export license number; captive-bred furbearers with a signed statement; fish or shellfish in FDA-labeled retail packages; or not marked?

cultural_designated_material.description: Is the object archaeological or ethnological material of a State Party (an object of archaeological interest at least 250 years old, or of ethnological interest from a tribal or nonindustrial society, or a fragment of one) that falls within the Designated List in a CBP or Treasury decision 19 CFR 12.104g names for that State Party, or within the Designated List for Iraq (CBP Dec. 08-17) or Syria (CBP Dec. 16-10)?

cultural_stolen_from_institution.description: Is the object cultural property documented as appertaining to the inventory of a museum, religious or secular public monument or similar institution in a State Party to the 1970 UNESCO Convention (19 CFR 12.104b) and stolen from it: after April 12, 1983 or after the Convention entered into force for that State Party, whichever is later; on or before that date; or not documented as stolen?

cultural_exemption.description: Does an exemption of 19 CFR 12.104h apply: immunity from seizure for temporary exhibition under 22 U.S.C. 2459; held in the United States at least 3 consecutive years by a recognized museum or similar institution that bought it for value in good faith and published, exhibited or cataloged it as 12.104h(b)(1) requires; within the United States at least 10 consecutive years and exhibited at least 5 of them in a public institution; within the United States at least 10 consecutive years with fair notice of its location to the State Party; within the United States at least 20 consecutive years and bought for value without knowledge of an unlawful import; or none?

cultural_export_evidence.description: What can be presented at entry for the designated material: the State Party's certificate or other documentation that the export did not violate its laws; declarations under oath and the seller's statement that it left the State Party at least 10 years before entry, with no interest acquired by the importer or a related person more than 1 year before entry; declarations under oath and the seller's statement that it left on or before its designation date; or none at entry?

explosive_material.description: Is the product explosive material under 27 CFR 555.11 (explosives, blasting agents, water gels or detonators, including every item on ATF's List of Explosive Materials, 27 CFR 555.23): a plastic explosive (flexible or elastic sheet explosive with a binder, 27 CFR 555.180(d)(4)); blasting caps; commercially manufactured black powder of no more than 50 pounds intended solely for sporting, recreational or cultural use in antique firearms or antique devices; other explosive material; or none?

explosive_exemption.description: Does an exemption of 27 CFR 555.141(a) apply to the import: imported for delivery to a Federal agency or a State or its political subdivision; small arms ammunition or its components; consumer fireworks classified UN0336, UN0337, UN0431 or UN0432; gasoline, fertilizers, or propellant actuated devices or industrial tools imported for their intended purposes; industrial or laboratory reagent chemicals shipped under DOT rules without an explosives hazard label; model rocket motors with no more than 62.5 grams of propellant (single-use or reload kits) of ammonium perchlorate composite, black powder or similar low explosives; explosive materials in medicines in USP or NF forms; or none?

explosive_importer_status.description: Does the person importing the explosive materials hold an ATF importer's license (engaged in the business of importing for sale or distribution, 27 CFR 555.11), a user permit (acquiring explosive materials from a foreign country for its own use, 27 CFR 555.41(b)(1)(iii)), or neither?

plastic_explosive_detection_agent.description: Does the plastic explosive contain a detection agent (EGDN, DMNB, p-MNT or o-MNT at the minimum concentration 27 CFR 555.180(d)(3) states, distributed homogeneously during manufacture); is it a small amount intended for and used solely in lawful research, development or testing of explosives, explosives detection training or detection equipment testing, or forensic science (27 CFR 555.182(a)); is it incorporated in a military device (27 CFR 555.182(b)); or none of these?

ttb_alcohol_class.description: Is the beverage distilled spirits, wine of not less than 7 and not more than 24 percent alcohol by volume, or a malt beverage, as the Federal Alcohol Administration Act defines them (27 CFR 1.10), or another product (including wine under 7 or over 24 percent alcohol by volume)?

ttb_alcohol_purpose.description: Is the beverage imported for sale or any other commercial purpose; as commercial samples for soliciting orders under 27 CFR 27.49; as quality-control samples under 27 CFR 27.75; or for personal or other noncommercial use?

ttb_alcohol_packaging.description: Is the beverage imported in containers (bottled or packed for sale at retail) or in bulk?

ttb_malt_state_requires_part7_labeling.description: Do the laws or regulations of the State where the malt beverages are withdrawn from customs custody require all malt beverages sold there to be labeled in conformity with 27 CFR part 7, subparts D through I (27 CFR 7.24(g))?

ttb_alcohol_cola_holder.description: Was the certificate of label approval (COLA) issued to the importer removing the beverage from customs custody, or to another person who has authorized the importer to use it?

ttb_alcohol_entry_filing.description: Is the customs entry filed electronically or on paper?

ttb_wine_natural.description: Is the wine natural wine (27 CFR 27.11), for which 27 CFR 27.140 requires a proper cellar treatment certification?

dea_import_item.description: What is imported: a List I chemical of 21 CFR 1310.02(a) that is ephedrine, pseudoephedrine or phenylpropanolamine (including their salts, optical isomers and salts of optical isomers); another List I chemical; acetone, 2-butanone (MEK) or toluene (List II); another List II chemical of 21 CFR 1310.02(b); a tableting or encapsulating machine; an import transaction DEA excludes in 21 CFR 1310.08 or a chemical mixture exempt under 21 CFR 1310.12; or none of these?

dea_quantity.description: Does the import meet or exceed the threshold quantity of 21 CFR 1310.04(f) for the chemical (counting the cumulative amount of multiple transactions within a calendar month), or is it a chemical for which no threshold is established (21 CFR 1310.04(g)); or is it below the threshold?

dea_import_purpose.description: Is the chemical imported for release for use in the United States, or imported for transshipment, or transferred or transshipped within the United States, for immediate export (21 CFR 1313.31)?

dea_regular_importer_to_regular_customer.description: Has the importer satisfied DEA's reporting requirements as a regular importer of the chemical (21 CFR 1313.15), and does it intend to transfer the chemical to a person who is a regular customer for it (21 CFR 1313.12(c)(1))?

nrc_import_item.description: What is imported: byproduct material; source material; special nuclear material (10 CFR 110.9a(b)–(d)); major components of a utilization facility (10 CFR 110.2); another production or utilization facility (10 CFR 110.9a(a)); a U.S. Munitions List nuclear item such as depleted uranium incorporated in a defense article (10 CFR 110.1(b)(1)); deuterium, nuclear grade graphite or other nuclear equipment that is not a production or utilization facility (10 CFR 110.1(b)(4)); or none of these?

nrc_shipment.description: Is the shipment imported into the United States, or only passing through the United States in bond (10 CFR 110.1(b)(5))?

nrc_consignee_authorized_to_possess.description: Is the U.S. consignee authorized to receive and possess the material under the relevant NRC or Agreement State regulations (10 CFR 110.27(a))?

nrc_radioactive_waste.description: Is the material radioactive waste as 10 CFR 110.2 defines it (10 CFR 110.27(c))?

nrc_irradiated_fuel_over_100_kg_per_ship.description: Is the source or special nuclear material in the form of irradiated fuel, more than 100 kilograms per shipment (10 CFR 110.27(b))?

nrc_end_use_at_nrc_licensed_utilization_.description: Are the major components for end use at a utilization facility the Commission licenses (10 CFR 110.27(e))?

nrc_appendix_p_material.description: Is the material radioactive material listed in appendix P to 10 CFR part 110 (Category 1 or 2 quantities), for which 10 CFR 110.27(f) and 110.50(c) require advance notification of each import shipment?

nrc_formula_quantity_strategic_special_n.description: Is the special nuclear material a formula quantity of strategic special nuclear material as 10 CFR 73.2 defines it (10 CFR 110.27(d))?

nrc_specific_license.description: Does the importer hold an NRC specific import license (NRC Form 7) covering this import, has the Commission granted an exemption from the licensing requirement for it (10 CFR 110.10), or neither?

simp_species_group.description: Which fish or fish product is imported: a species or species group of the Seafood Traceability Program in 50 CFR 300.324(a)(2) (Atlantic cod, Pacific cod, blue crab, red king crab, dolphinfish (mahi mahi), grouper, red snapper, sea cucumber, sharks, swordfish, or albacore, bigeye, skipjack, yellowfin or bluefin tuna); abalone or shrimp (50 CFR 300.324(a)(3)); another fish or fish product regulated under the AMLR trade program, the HMS International Trade Program or the Tuna Tracking and Verification Program (50 CFR 300.321); or none of these?

simp_species_identifiable.description: Is the product fresh, frozen, canned, pouched or otherwise prepared in a way that allows, including through a label or declaration, the species it contains and the harvesting event to be identified, rather than fish oil, slurry, sauces, sticks, balls, cakes, pudding or a similar product for which that is not technically or economically feasible (50 CFR 300.324(a)(1))?

simp_trade_permit.description: Does the importer hold a valid International Fisheries Trade Permit (IFTP) issued by NMFS under 50 CFR 300.322, or none?

tuna_fco_product.description: Is the shipment tuna or a tuna product other than fresh tuna (including the frozen, canned, loin and other products, such as pet food containing tuna, of 50 CFR 216.24(f)(2)(i)–(ii)); fish or shellfish listed in 216.24(f)(2)(iii) (such as salmon, swordfish, sharks or squid) that is not tuna; fresh tuna or other fish outside those lists; or no fish at all?

tuna_fco_driftnet.description: Was the fish harvested by a large-scale driftnet; exported from, or harvested on the high seas by, a nation the NMFS Assistant Administrator has determined to be engaged in large-scale driftnet fishing (50 CFR 216.24(f)(7)); or neither?

tuna_fco_yellowfin.description: Does the shipment contain yellowfin tuna or yellowfin tuna products (50 CFR 216.24(f)(2)(i))?

tuna_fco_etp_purse_seine.description: Was the yellowfin tuna harvested using a purse seine in the eastern tropical Pacific Ocean (50 CFR 216.24(f)(6)(i))?

tuna_fco_further_processing.description: Is the tuna destined for further processing in the United States, so that the FCO is endorsed at each change in ownership (50 CFR 216.24(f)(3)(iii))?

itar_ti_article.description: Is the article an unclassified defense article on the U.S. Munitions List (22 CFR 121.1), a classified defense article, technical data, or not a defense article?

itar_ti_import_type.description: Is the defense article imported temporarily, to be returned to the country from which it was shipped or to transit to a third country (22 CFR 123.3(a)), or imported permanently?

itar_ti_exemption_claim.description: Is no exemption claimed; is a 22 CFR 123.4(a) exemption claimed for servicing and return (a)(1), enhancement or incorporation into an item DDTC has authorized for permanent export (a)(2), exhibition, demonstration or marketing and return (a)(3), return after rejection for permanent import by the Department of Justice (a)(4), or import approved under a Foreign Military Sales Letter of Offer and Acceptance (a)(5); is the 123.4(b) exemption claimed for incorporation into another article or modification that changes its basic performance; or is another subchapter M exemption claimed?

itar_ti_canada_transit.description: Does the shipment transit the United States to or from Canada (22 CFR 123.4(a) note)?

itar_ti_us_origin.description: Is the item a U.S.-origin defense item, including an item manufactured abroad under U.S. Government approval (22 CFR 123.4(a))?

itar_ti_within_4_years.description: Will the temporary import last no more than 4 years before the subsequent export (22 CFR 123.4(a))?

itar_ti_importer_eligible_120_16.description: Does the importer meet the eligibility requirements of 22 CFR 120.16 (22 CFR 123.4(c)(1))?

itar_ti_proscribed_126_1.description: Is the temporary import from or on behalf of a country, area or person listed in 22 CFR 126.1: no; yes, with an exception granted under 126.3; or yes, without one (22 CFR 123.4(c)(3))?

itar_ti_foreign_exporter_requires_approv.description: Does the foreign exporter require documentation of U.S. Government approval of the temporary import (22 CFR 123.4(c)(4))?

hw_import_waste.description: Is the imported material hazardous waste under RCRA (40 CFR part 261), including a hazardous waste mixture (40 CFR 262.82(a)); universal waste (40 CFR part 273), spent lead-acid batteries reclaimed under 40 CFR part 266 subpart G or industrial ethyl alcohol reclaimed under 40 CFR 261.6(a)(3)(i); or not hazardous waste under RCRA?

hw_import_lab_sample.description: Is the import a hazardous waste sample destined for laboratory analysis of its characteristics or suitability for recovery or disposal, of no more than 25 kg, appropriately packaged and labeled and complying with 40 CFR 261.4(d) or (e) (40 CFR 262.82(d))?

hw_import_export_country_controls.description: Does the competent authority of the country of export regulate the waste as hazardous waste and require the foreign exporter to notify it and obtain consent before export (40 CFR 262.84(b))?

hw_import_interim_operation.description: Will the U.S. receiving facility perform an interim recovery operation R12, R13 or RC3 or an interim disposal operation D13 through D15 (40 CFR 262.81) before a final facility recovers or disposes of the waste?

doe_ec_product.description: Is the product a covered product or covered equipment under 10 CFR part 430 or 431 whose basic model is subject to an applicable energy conservation standard (including one whose compliance date has arrived); a covered product or equipment with no applicable standard; or not covered?

doe_ec_new.description: Is the imported unit new, rather than used (10 CFR 429.102(a)(6))?

doe_ec_meets_standard.description: Does the basic model meet its applicable energy conservation standard when tested under 10 CFR parts 429, 430 and 431?

doe_ec_certification.description: Has the importer (directly or through an authorized third-party submitter) certified the basic model to DOE under 10 CFR 429.12; has only another manufacturer of the basic model certified it; or has it not been certified?

cites_appendix.description: Is the specimen (live or dead, or a part, product or derivative) of a species listed in CITES Appendix I, II or III, or not listed (50 CFR 23.13)?

cites_exemption_claim.description: Is no exemption claimed; is the specimen claimed as personal or household effects (50 CFR 23.15); is a CITES exemption document under 50 CFR 23.20(d) claimed (artificially propagated, bred in captivity, pre-Convention, hybrid, in transit, scientific exchange, certificate of ownership, sample collection or traveling exhibition); or is the specimen claimed exempt under 50 CFR 23.92?

cites_effects_conditions_met.description: Do the personal or household effects meet every condition of 50 CFR 23.15(c)–(f): legally acquired, no live wildlife or plants, no Appendix-I specimen (except qualifying worked African elephant ivory), within the quantity limits for caviar, seahorses, crocodilians, queen conch, giant clams and rainsticks, owned for personal use and carried as personal baggage or moved as household effects within one year of changing residence, with no country requiring a CITES document?

cites_trade_from.description: Is the specimen exported from its country of origin or harvest, or re-exported from a country into which it was previously imported?

cites_app3_origin.description: Did the Appendix-III specimen originate in a country that listed the species in Appendix III, or in another country?

fl_uflpa_nexus.description: Were the goods mined, produced or manufactured wholly or in part in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region of China, or produced by an entity on the UFLPA Entity List (Pub. L. 117-78, sec. 3(a)), or neither?

fl_wro_or_finding.description: Are the goods of a class and source named in a published section 307 finding (19 CFR 12.42(f)), in a withhold release order (19 CFR 12.42(e)), or in neither?

fl_forced_labor_known.description: Were the goods, or any part of them, mined, produced or manufactured abroad by convict labor, forced labor or indentured labor under penal sanctions, including forced or indentured child labor (19 U.S.C. 1307)?

ofac_emb_program.description: Are the goods of Cuban origin, located in or transported from or through Cuba, or made or derived in whole or in part of Cuban articles (31 CFR 515.204); of Iranian origin or owned or controlled by the Government of Iran (560.201); from North Korea, directly or indirectly (510.205); or none of these?

ofac_emb_informational_materials.description: Are the goods information or informational materials (such as publications, films, recordings, artworks or news wire feeds) fully created and in existence, as defined in 31 CFR 515.332, 560.315 or 510.312?

ofac_emb_travel_baggage.description: Are the goods accompanied baggage for personal use imported incident to travel to or from any country (31 CFR 560.210(d), 510.213(d))?

ofac_emb_unpa_blocked.description: Does the transaction involve property or interests in property of a person blocked under the United Nations Participation Act, such as a person on both the SDN List and the UN Security Council Consolidated List (31 CFR 510.213(a))?

ofac_emb_license.description: Is the import claimed to be authorized by an OFAC general license or a specific license, or is no authorization claimed?

s337_order.description: Is the article covered by a U.S. International Trade Commission section 337 exclusion order (general or limited), by an ITC seizure and forfeiture order, or by neither (19 CFR 12.39(b)–(c))?

s337_us_government_patent.description: Is the order based on United States patents and the article imported by and for the use of the United States, or for the United States with the Government's authorization or consent (19 CFR 12.39(d))?

s337_ruling.description: Is no claim made that the article falls outside the order, or is a CBP ruling or ITC determination relied on to show that it does?

s337_status.description: Is the ITC determination still within the 60-day Presidential review period, or has it become final (19 CFR 12.39(a))?

tm_mark.description: Does the article bear a counterfeit of a trademark registered with the USPTO and recorded with CBP (19 CFR 133.21(a)); a mark or name copying or simulating a recorded mark or name (133.22(a)); a genuine recorded mark on restricted gray market goods imported without the U.S. owner's authorization (133.23(a)); or none of these?

tm_relief.description: Which relief is claimed, if any: none; removal or obliteration of the mark (not available for counterfeit marks); import by the recordant or its designate; the recordant's written consent; the one-item personal exemption for an arriving person (19 CFR 148.55); for gray market goods, a foreign owner that is the U.S. owner or affiliated with it, goods not physically and materially different, or the 133.23(b) label on physically and materially different goods?

dev_is_device.description: Is the product a device intended for human use within section 201(h) of the FD&C Act (including in vitro diagnostic products), or not a device?

dev_investigational.description: Is the device imported under the investigational device provisions of 21 CFR part 812 (21 CFR 807.40(c))?

dev_manufacturer.description: Was the device manufactured, prepared, propagated, compounded or processed at a foreign establishment, or at a U.S. establishment (for example, U.S. goods returned)?

dev_foreign_registered_listed.description: Is the foreign establishment registered and the device listed in FDA's electronic device registration and listing system (21 CFR 807.40(a), (c))?

dev_us_agent.description: Has the foreign establishment named a United States agent in its registration (21 CFR 807.40(b))?

dev_premarket.description: Is the device cleared (510(k)) or approved (PMA, De Novo) by FDA; exempt from premarket notification by its classification regulation or as a custom device, or covered by a pending PMA or reclassification petition (21 CFR 807.81(b), 807.85); or none of these?

dev_importer_role.description: Is the importer an initial importer that furthers the device's marketing without repackaging or relabeling (21 CFR 807.3(g)); a repackager, relabeler or specification developer; or only a wholesale distributor that does not manufacture, repackage, process or relabel (807.20(c))?

drug_product.description: Is the product a drug (human or animal, including an active pharmaceutical ingredient) or an animal feed bearing or containing a new animal drug, or not a drug (21 CFR 207.17)?

drug_establishment.description: Was the drug manufactured, repacked, relabeled or salvaged at a foreign establishment, or at a U.S. establishment?

drug_registration_exemption.description: Is a 21 CFR 207.13 registration and listing exemption claimed for the establishment, or none?

drug_establishment_registered.description: Is the foreign establishment registered with FDA (21 CFR 207.17, 207.21(b))?

drug_listed.description: Is the drug listed with FDA by the registrant (21 CFR 207.41)?

drug_us_agent.description: Has the foreign registrant designated a United States agent (21 CFR 207.69(b))?

cr_piratical.description: Is the article a copy or phonorecord of a copyrighted work recorded with CBP made without the copyright owner's authorization (19 CFR 133.42(a)), or not?

cr_personal_exemption.description: Does the article accompany a person arriving in the United States, for personal use, within the one-article-per-type and 30-day limits of 19 CFR 148.55?

cpscra_product.description: Is the article a consumer product within the Consumer Product Safety Act, or not?

cpscra_ground.description: Does a 15 U.S.C. 2066(a) ground apply: the product fails an applicable consumer product safety rule; lacks a required certificate, label or tracking label or carries a false certificate; has been determined imminently hazardous; has a defect that is a substantial product hazard; or was made by a manufacturer the Commission has reported for inspection or recordkeeping violations; or none?

cpscra_modification.description: Has the Commission permitted release under bond so the owner or consignee can modify the product, or not (15 U.S.C. 2066(c))?

fdar_product.description: Is the article a food, drug, device, tobacco product or cosmetic, or something else (21 U.S.C. 381(a))?

fdar_notice.description: Has FDA given the owner or consignee notice that the article may be refused admission (a notice of FDA action), or not (21 CFR 1.94(a))?

fdar_ground.description: Is the ground adulteration, misbranding or an unapproved new drug that relabeling or other action could correct or render the article other than a food, drug, device or cosmetic (21 U.S.C. 381(b)), or another ground?

fdar_low_value_drug_device.description: Is the article a drug, device or tobacco product valued at $2,500 or less (21 U.S.C. 381(a), as amended by Pub. L. 119-37)?

fdar_reconditioning.description: Will the owner or consignee apply for authorization to relabel or recondition the article (21 CFR 1.95)?

epa_fuel_product.description: Is the import gasoline; diesel fuel or another distillate fuel; another fuel, fuel additive or regulated blendstock subject to 40 CFR part 1090; or none of these?

epa_fuel_exemption.description: Is a 40 CFR part 1090 subpart G exemption claimed (national security or military use, research and testing, certain territories, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico and U.S. Virgin Islands summer gasoline, distillate global marine fuel or another), or none?

epa_fuel_importer_registered.description: Is the importer registered with EPA under 40 CFR 1090.800?

epa_fuel_import_mode.description: Is the product imported by marine vessel, by rail or truck, or by pipeline or another mode?

epa_fuel_marine_method.description: Will the importer certify the product on board the vessel (40 CFR 1090.1605(b)) or offload it into shore tanks holding the same product and certify there (1090.1605(d))?

epa_fuel_rail_truck_method.description: Will the importer test each railcar or truck compartment, rely on verified supplier test results (40 CFR 1090.1610(a)(1)), or certify in storage tanks holding the same product (1090.1610(a)(2))?

cbp_eb_entry_type.description: Is the merchandise entered on a formal entry, or on an informal or other entry?

cbp_eb_identity_on_file.description: Are CBP Form 5106 importer identity records on file, and used within the past year, for both the importer and the ultimate consignee (19 CFR 24.5)?

cbp_eb_bond.description: Is a continuous bond or a single entry bond on CBP Form 301 on file for the entry, or no bond (19 CFR 142.4(a))?

cbp_eb_summary_party.description: Is the entry summary filed by the same party that made entry, or by a different party (19 CFR 142.4(b)(2))?

cbp_eb_waiver_conditions.description: Is the merchandise worth $2,500 or less, with the entry summary filed and estimated duties deposited before release, by an importer never delinquent with CBP, and not quota merchandise, merchandise hard to appraise or classify, or merchandise with a redelivery concern (19 CFR 142.4(c))?

fccea_rf_device.description: Is the article a radio frequency device (47 CFR 2.801), or not?

fccea_entry_basis.description: Does the device enter on its equipment authorization (or because it needs none), or under one of the other 47 CFR 2.1204(a) entry conditions such as testing, trade shows, export, government use, personal use or repair?

fccea_procedure.description: Which equipment authorization procedure applies to the device: certification, Supplier's Declaration of Conformity, or none required?

fccea_authorized.description: Has the device received a valid grant of certification not limited under 47 CFR 2.939(e), or, for SDoC equipment, been tested and declared under 47 CFR 2.906?

fccea_sdoc_responsible_party.description: For SDoC equipment, is the importer the responsible party, or has a U.S.-located manufacturer, assembler, retailer or OEM agreed to be the responsible party (47 CFR 2.909(b))?

haccp_imp_product.description: Is the import a fish or fishery product (21 CFR part 123), juice (21 CFR part 120), or something else?

haccp_imp_mou.description: Is the product obtained from a country with an active, functioning FDA memorandum of understanding or similar agreement that covers it (21 CFR 123.12(a)(1), 120.14(a)(1)), or not?

haccp_imp_procedures.description: Does the importer have and implement written verification procedures with product specifications and affirmative steps (21 CFR 123.12(a)(2), 120.14(a)(2)), or not?

afood_article.description: Is the import animal food or feed without a new animal drug (including pet food and feed ingredients), a Type B or Type C medicated feed bearing or containing a new animal drug, a Type A medicated article or other new animal drug, or not animal food?

afood_registration.description: Must the facility that manufactures, processes, packs or holds the animal food register with FDA as a food facility under section 415 of the act (21 CFR part 1, subpart H), or not (for example a farm) (21 CFR 507.5(a))?

afood_pc_status.description: Is the facility subject to the full preventive controls and supply-chain program (21 CFR part 507 subparts C and E), a qualified facility (507.5(d), 507.7), solely engaged in storing unexposed packaged animal food (507.10), a human food facility holding and distributing human food by-products for animal food (507.12), or partly exempt under 507.5(b), (c), (e) or (f)?

afood_drug_approval.description: Is each new animal drug in the feed used under an approval, conditional approval or index listing for that use in the feed, with the feed's labeling, distribution, holding and use conforming to it (21 U.S.C. 360b(a)(2)), or not?

afood_category_ii_type_a.description: Is the Type B or Type C medicated feed manufactured from a Category II Type A medicated article (21 CFR 558.3(b)(1), 558.4(a))?

afood_vfd.description: Does the feed contain a veterinary feed directive (VFD) drug (21 CFR 558.3(b)(6), 558.6)?

flab_product.description: Is the import a conventional human food, a dietary supplement, infant formula or a medical food, a meat, poultry or egg product under USDA inspection, or not food for human consumption?

flab_form.description: Is the food imported in package form (labeled packages, whether for retail or not), or shipped in bulk to be processed, labeled or repacked in substantial quantity at another establishment (21 CFR 101.100(d))?

flab_bulk_route.description: Does the importer that introduces the bulk shipment operate the establishment that will process, label or repack it (21 CFR 101.100(d)(1)), is it shipped there under a signed written agreement with processing or labeling specifications (101.100(d)(2)), or neither?

flab_allergen.description: Is the food, or does it contain an ingredient (including a flavoring, coloring or incidental additive) that is or contains, a major food allergen (milk, egg, fish, Crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, wheat, peanuts, soybeans or sesame, 21 U.S.C. 321(qq)); does it contain none; or is it a raw agricultural commodity?

flab_foreign_language.description: Does the label carry any representation in a language other than English (21 CFR 101.15(c)(2))?

flab_nutrition.description: Must the food bear Nutrition Facts labeling (21 CFR 101.9(a)), or does an exemption in 21 CFR 101.9(j) apply with its conditions met (for example small business, insignificant nutrients, small packages, or low-volume products with an FDA exemption notice)?

flab_claims.description: Does the label or labeling bear a nutrient content claim or a health claim (21 CFR 101.13, 101.14)?

flab_structure_function.description: Does the dietary supplement's label or labeling bear a structure/function or other statement under section 403(r)(6) of the act (21 CFR 101.93)?

flab_ds_activity.description: In the United States, does the importer only hold and distribute the dietary supplement, also manufacture, package or label it, or hold it only at a retail establishment for direct sale to individual consumers (21 CFR 111.1)?

fadd_article.description: Is the import food for humans or animals (including pet food and animal feed, 21 CFR 170.3(m)), a color additive for use in food, a substance or ingredient for use in food, a food-contact article or substance (packaging or food-processing equipment), a color additive only for drugs, devices or cosmetics, or none of these?

fadd_color.description: Does the food or color additive contain no added color additive, a color additive listed for this use in food as exempt from certification (21 CFR part 73), a color additive listed for this use that is subject to batch certification (21 CFR part 74, or provisionally listed in parts 81 and 82), or a color additive not listed for this use (21 U.S.C. 379e(a))? If colors differ, answer not_listed_for_the_use if any one is, otherwise listed_subject_to_certification if any one is.

fadd_color_batch.description: Is every certifiable color additive from a batch FDA has certified for the use, with an unexpired certificate and the FDA lot number (21 CFR 80.31, 80.32), or not?

fadd_substance.description: For each added substance other than color additives: is there none, is every one used under a food additive regulation (21 CFR parts 172–180, or part 573 for animal food), generally recognized as safe for the use (21 CFR 170.30) or prior-sanctioned for the use (21 CFR part 181), is one a pesticide chemical, a new animal drug or a dietary ingredient in a dietary supplement (21 U.S.C. 321(s)), or is one a food additive with none of these authorizations?

fadd_contact.description: For the food-contact article or substance: is each migrating substance used under a food additive regulation (21 CFR parts 174–178, 179.45), an effective food contact notification (FCN, 21 CFR 170.100), a threshold of regulation exemption (21 CFR 170.39), or general recognition of safety or a prior sanction; does nothing migrate to food (21 CFR 170.3(e)(1)); or does a migrating substance have none of these?

fadd_fcn_supplier.description: Is the food contact substance made or prepared by the manufacturer or supplier identified in the effective FCN (21 CFR 170.100(a)), or by another manufacturer or supplier?

snur_substance.description: Is the chemical substance identified in a significant new use rule in 40 CFR part 721 subpart E, or not?

snur_form.description: Is the substance imported as a substance or in a mixture, or as part of an article (40 CFR 721.45(f))?

snur_article_exemption_overridden.description: Does the specific SNUR section provide that the article exemption does not apply (40 CFR 721.45)?

snur_exemption.description: Is another 40 CFR 721.45 exemption claimed (test marketing, research and development in small quantities, section 5(h)(5), impurity, byproduct, export only, prior notice with EPA compliance notification, or a section 5(e) consent order), or none?
