wildlife_live_or_perishable.description: Is the shipment live wild mammals or birds, other live or perishable wildlife, or neither?

wildlife_container_marking.description: How is each container or package marked: with the shipper's and consignee's names and addresses and accompanied by a contents list by scientific name, number and venomous status; marked "fish" or "wildlife" (or the species common name) with an accompanying invoice, packing list or bill of lading stating the parties and species; with the shipper's FWS import/export license number; captive-bred furbearers with a signed statement; fish or shellfish in FDA-labeled retail packages; or not marked?

cultural_designated_material.description: Is the object archaeological or ethnological material of a State Party (an object of archaeological interest at least 250 years old, or of ethnological interest from a tribal or nonindustrial society, or a fragment of one) that falls within the Designated List in a CBP or Treasury decision 19 CFR 12.104g names for that State Party, or within the Designated List for Iraq (CBP Dec. 08-17) or Syria (CBP Dec. 16-10)?

cultural_stolen_from_institution.description: Is the object cultural property documented as appertaining to the inventory of a museum, religious or secular public monument or similar institution in a State Party to the 1970 UNESCO Convention (19 CFR 12.104b) and stolen from it: after April 12, 1983 or after the Convention entered into force for that State Party, whichever is later; on or before that date; or not documented as stolen?

cultural_exemption.description: Does an exemption of 19 CFR 12.104h apply: immunity from seizure for temporary exhibition under 22 U.S.C. 2459; held in the United States at least 3 consecutive years by a recognized museum or similar institution that bought it for value in good faith and published, exhibited or cataloged it as 12.104h(b)(1) requires; within the United States at least 10 consecutive years and exhibited at least 5 of them in a public institution; within the United States at least 10 consecutive years with fair notice of its location to the State Party; within the United States at least 20 consecutive years and bought for value without knowledge of an unlawful import; or none?

cultural_export_evidence.description: What can be presented at entry for the designated material: the State Party's certificate or other documentation that the export did not violate its laws; declarations under oath and the seller's statement that it left the State Party at least 10 years before entry, with no interest acquired by the importer or a related person more than 1 year before entry; declarations under oath and the seller's statement that it left on or before its designation date; or none at entry?

explosive_material.description: Is the product explosive material under 27 CFR 555.11 (explosives, blasting agents, water gels or detonators, including every item on ATF's List of Explosive Materials, 27 CFR 555.23): a plastic explosive (flexible or elastic sheet explosive with a binder, 27 CFR 555.180(d)(4)); blasting caps; commercially manufactured black powder of no more than 50 pounds intended solely for sporting, recreational or cultural use in antique firearms or antique devices; other explosive material; or none?

explosive_exemption.description: Does an exemption of 27 CFR 555.141(a) apply to the import: imported for delivery to a Federal agency or a State or its political subdivision; small arms ammunition or its components; consumer fireworks classified UN0336, UN0337, UN0431 or UN0432; gasoline, fertilizers, or propellant actuated devices or industrial tools imported for their intended purposes; industrial or laboratory reagent chemicals shipped under DOT rules without an explosives hazard label; model rocket motors with no more than 62.5 grams of propellant (single-use or reload kits) of ammonium perchlorate composite, black powder or similar low explosives; explosive materials in medicines in USP or NF forms; or none?

explosive_importer_status.description: Does the person importing the explosive materials hold an ATF importer's license (engaged in the business of importing for sale or distribution, 27 CFR 555.11), a user permit (acquiring explosive materials from a foreign country for its own use, 27 CFR 555.41(b)(1)(iii)), or neither?

plastic_explosive_detection_agent.description: Does the plastic explosive contain a detection agent (EGDN, DMNB, p-MNT or o-MNT at the minimum concentration 27 CFR 555.180(d)(3) states, distributed homogeneously during manufacture); is it a small amount intended for and used solely in lawful research, development or testing of explosives, explosives detection training or detection equipment testing, or forensic science (27 CFR 555.182(a)); is it incorporated in a military device (27 CFR 555.182(b)); or none of these?

ttb_alcohol_class.description: Is the beverage distilled spirits, wine of not less than 7 and not more than 24 percent alcohol by volume, or a malt beverage, as the Federal Alcohol Administration Act defines them (27 CFR 1.10), or another product (including wine under 7 or over 24 percent alcohol by volume)?

ttb_alcohol_purpose.description: Is the beverage imported for sale or any other commercial purpose; as commercial samples for soliciting orders under 27 CFR 27.49; as quality-control samples under 27 CFR 27.75; or for personal or other noncommercial use?

ttb_alcohol_packaging.description: Is the beverage imported in containers (bottled or packed for sale at retail) or in bulk?

ttb_malt_state_requires_part7_labeling.description: Do the laws or regulations of the State where the malt beverages are withdrawn from customs custody require all malt beverages sold there to be labeled in conformity with 27 CFR part 7, subparts D through I (27 CFR 7.24(g))?

ttb_alcohol_cola_holder.description: Was the certificate of label approval (COLA) issued to the importer removing the beverage from customs custody, or to another person who has authorized the importer to use it?

ttb_alcohol_entry_filing.description: Is the customs entry filed electronically or on paper?

ttb_wine_natural.description: Is the wine natural wine (27 CFR 27.11), for which 27 CFR 27.140 requires a proper cellar treatment certification?

dea_import_item.description: What is imported: a List I chemical of 21 CFR 1310.02(a) that is ephedrine, pseudoephedrine or phenylpropanolamine (including their salts, optical isomers and salts of optical isomers); another List I chemical; acetone, 2-butanone (MEK) or toluene (List II); another List II chemical of 21 CFR 1310.02(b); a tableting or encapsulating machine; an import transaction DEA excludes in 21 CFR 1310.08 or a chemical mixture exempt under 21 CFR 1310.12; or none of these?

dea_quantity.description: Does the import meet or exceed the threshold quantity of 21 CFR 1310.04(f) for the chemical (counting the cumulative amount of multiple transactions within a calendar month), or is it a chemical for which no threshold is established (21 CFR 1310.04(g)); or is it below the threshold?

dea_import_purpose.description: Is the chemical imported for release for use in the United States, or imported for transshipment, or transferred or transshipped within the United States, for immediate export (21 CFR 1313.31)?

dea_regular_importer_to_regular_customer.description: Has the importer satisfied DEA's reporting requirements as a regular importer of the chemical (21 CFR 1313.15), and does it intend to transfer the chemical to a person who is a regular customer for it (21 CFR 1313.12(c)(1))?

nrc_import_item.description: What is imported: byproduct material; source material; special nuclear material (10 CFR 110.9a(b)–(d)); major components of a utilization facility (10 CFR 110.2); another production or utilization facility (10 CFR 110.9a(a)); a U.S. Munitions List nuclear item such as depleted uranium incorporated in a defense article (10 CFR 110.1(b)(1)); deuterium, nuclear grade graphite or other nuclear equipment that is not a production or utilization facility (10 CFR 110.1(b)(4)); or none of these?

nrc_shipment.description: Is the shipment imported into the United States, or only passing through the United States in bond (10 CFR 110.1(b)(5))?

nrc_consignee_authorized_to_possess.description: Is the U.S. consignee authorized to receive and possess the material under the relevant NRC or Agreement State regulations (10 CFR 110.27(a))?

nrc_radioactive_waste.description: Is the material radioactive waste as 10 CFR 110.2 defines it (10 CFR 110.27(c))?

nrc_irradiated_fuel_over_100_kg_per_ship.description: Is the source or special nuclear material in the form of irradiated fuel, more than 100 kilograms per shipment (10 CFR 110.27(b))?

nrc_end_use_at_nrc_licensed_utilization_.description: Are the major components for end use at a utilization facility the Commission licenses (10 CFR 110.27(e))?

nrc_appendix_p_material.description: Is the material radioactive material listed in appendix P to 10 CFR part 110 (Category 1 or 2 quantities), for which 10 CFR 110.27(f) and 110.50(c) require advance notification of each import shipment?

nrc_formula_quantity_strategic_special_n.description: Is the special nuclear material a formula quantity of strategic special nuclear material as 10 CFR 73.2 defines it (10 CFR 110.27(d))?

nrc_specific_license.description: Does the importer hold an NRC specific import license (NRC Form 7) covering this import, has the Commission granted an exemption from the licensing requirement for it (10 CFR 110.10), or neither?

simp_species_group.description: Which fish or fish product is imported: a species or species group of the Seafood Traceability Program in 50 CFR 300.324(a)(2) (Atlantic cod, Pacific cod, blue crab, red king crab, dolphinfish (mahi mahi), grouper, red snapper, sea cucumber, sharks, swordfish, or albacore, bigeye, skipjack, yellowfin or bluefin tuna); abalone or shrimp (50 CFR 300.324(a)(3)); another fish or fish product regulated under the AMLR trade program, the HMS International Trade Program or the Tuna Tracking and Verification Program (50 CFR 300.321); or none of these?

simp_species_identifiable.description: Is the product fresh, frozen, canned, pouched or otherwise prepared in a way that allows, including through a label or declaration, the species it contains and the harvesting event to be identified, rather than fish oil, slurry, sauces, sticks, balls, cakes, pudding or a similar product for which that is not technically or economically feasible (50 CFR 300.324(a)(1))?

simp_trade_permit.description: Does the importer hold a valid International Fisheries Trade Permit (IFTP) issued by NMFS under 50 CFR 300.322, or none?

tuna_fco_product.description: Is the shipment tuna or a tuna product other than fresh tuna (including the frozen, canned, loin and other products, such as pet food containing tuna, of 50 CFR 216.24(f)(2)(i)–(ii)); fish or shellfish listed in 216.24(f)(2)(iii) (such as salmon, swordfish, sharks or squid) that is not tuna; fresh tuna or other fish outside those lists; or no fish at all?

tuna_fco_driftnet.description: Was the fish harvested by a large-scale driftnet; exported from, or harvested on the high seas by, a nation the NMFS Assistant Administrator has determined to be engaged in large-scale driftnet fishing (50 CFR 216.24(f)(7)); or neither?

tuna_fco_yellowfin.description: Does the shipment contain yellowfin tuna or yellowfin tuna products (50 CFR 216.24(f)(2)(i))?

tuna_fco_etp_purse_seine.description: Was the yellowfin tuna harvested using a purse seine in the eastern tropical Pacific Ocean (50 CFR 216.24(f)(6)(i))?

tuna_fco_further_processing.description: Is the tuna destined for further processing in the United States, so that the FCO is endorsed at each change in ownership (50 CFR 216.24(f)(3)(iii))?

itar_ti_article.description: Is the article an unclassified defense article on the U.S. Munitions List (22 CFR 121.1), a classified defense article, technical data, or not a defense article?

itar_ti_import_type.description: Is the defense article imported temporarily, to be returned to the country from which it was shipped or to transit to a third country (22 CFR 123.3(a)), or imported permanently?

itar_ti_exemption_claim.description: Is no exemption claimed; is a 22 CFR 123.4(a) exemption claimed for servicing and return (a)(1), enhancement or incorporation into an item DDTC has authorized for permanent export (a)(2), exhibition, demonstration or marketing and return (a)(3), return after rejection for permanent import by the Department of Justice (a)(4), or import approved under a Foreign Military Sales Letter of Offer and Acceptance (a)(5); is the 123.4(b) exemption claimed for incorporation into another article or modification that changes its basic performance; or is another subchapter M exemption claimed?

itar_ti_canada_transit.description: Does the shipment transit the United States to or from Canada (22 CFR 123.4(a) note)?

itar_ti_us_origin.description: Is the item a U.S.-origin defense item, including an item manufactured abroad under U.S. Government approval (22 CFR 123.4(a))?

itar_ti_within_4_years.description: Will the temporary import last no more than 4 years before the subsequent export (22 CFR 123.4(a))?

itar_ti_importer_eligible_120_16.description: Does the importer meet the eligibility requirements of 22 CFR 120.16 (22 CFR 123.4(c)(1))?

itar_ti_proscribed_126_1.description: Is the temporary import from or on behalf of a country, area or person listed in 22 CFR 126.1: no; yes, with an exception granted under 126.3; or yes, without one (22 CFR 123.4(c)(3))?

itar_ti_foreign_exporter_requires_approv.description: Does the foreign exporter require documentation of U.S. Government approval of the temporary import (22 CFR 123.4(c)(4))?

hw_import_waste.description: Is the imported material hazardous waste under RCRA (40 CFR part 261), including a hazardous waste mixture (40 CFR 262.82(a)); universal waste (40 CFR part 273), spent lead-acid batteries reclaimed under 40 CFR part 266 subpart G or industrial ethyl alcohol reclaimed under 40 CFR 261.6(a)(3)(i); or not hazardous waste under RCRA?

hw_import_lab_sample.description: Is the import a hazardous waste sample destined for laboratory analysis of its characteristics or suitability for recovery or disposal, of no more than 25 kg, appropriately packaged and labeled and complying with 40 CFR 261.4(d) or (e) (40 CFR 262.82(d))?

hw_import_export_country_controls.description: Does the competent authority of the country of export regulate the waste as hazardous waste and require the foreign exporter to notify it and obtain consent before export (40 CFR 262.84(b))?

hw_import_interim_operation.description: Will the U.S. receiving facility perform an interim recovery operation R12, R13 or RC3 or an interim disposal operation D13 through D15 (40 CFR 262.81) before a final facility recovers or disposes of the waste?

doe_ec_product.description: Is the product a covered product or covered equipment under 10 CFR part 430 or 431 whose basic model is subject to an applicable energy conservation standard (including one whose compliance date has arrived); a covered product or equipment with no applicable standard; or not covered?

doe_ec_new.description: Is the imported unit new, rather than used (10 CFR 429.102(a)(6))?

doe_ec_meets_standard.description: Does the basic model meet its applicable energy conservation standard when tested under 10 CFR parts 429, 430 and 431?

doe_ec_certification.description: Has the importer (directly or through an authorized third-party submitter) certified the basic model to DOE under 10 CFR 429.12; has only another manufacturer of the basic model certified it; or has it not been certified?

cites_appendix.description: Is the specimen (live or dead, or a part, product or derivative) of a species listed in CITES Appendix I, II or III, or not listed (50 CFR 23.13)?

cites_exemption_claim.description: Is no exemption claimed; is the specimen claimed as personal or household effects (50 CFR 23.15); is a CITES exemption document under 50 CFR 23.20(d) claimed (artificially propagated, bred in captivity, pre-Convention, hybrid, in transit, scientific exchange, certificate of ownership, sample collection or traveling exhibition); or is the specimen claimed exempt under 50 CFR 23.92?

cites_effects_conditions_met.description: Do the personal or household effects meet every condition of 50 CFR 23.15(c)–(f): legally acquired, no live wildlife or plants, no Appendix-I specimen (except qualifying worked African elephant ivory), within the quantity limits for caviar, seahorses, crocodilians, queen conch, giant clams and rainsticks, owned for personal use and carried as personal baggage or moved as household effects within one year of changing residence, with no country requiring a CITES document?

cites_trade_from.description: Is the specimen exported from its country of origin or harvest, or re-exported from a country into which it was previously imported?

cites_app3_origin.description: Did the Appendix-III specimen originate in a country that listed the species in Appendix III, or in another country?

fl_uflpa_nexus.description: Were the goods mined, produced or manufactured wholly or in part in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region of China, or produced by an entity on the UFLPA Entity List (Pub. L. 117-78, sec. 3(a)), or neither?

fl_wro_or_finding.description: Are the goods of a class and source named in a published section 307 finding (19 CFR 12.42(f)), in a withhold release order (19 CFR 12.42(e)), or in neither?

fl_forced_labor_known.description: Were the goods, or any part of them, mined, produced or manufactured abroad by convict labor, forced labor or indentured labor under penal sanctions, including forced or indentured child labor (19 U.S.C. 1307)?

ofac_emb_program.description: Are the goods of Cuban origin, located in or transported from or through Cuba, or made or derived in whole or in part of Cuban articles (31 CFR 515.204); of Iranian origin or owned or controlled by the Government of Iran (560.201); from North Korea, directly or indirectly (510.205); or none of these?

ofac_emb_informational_materials.description: Are the goods information or informational materials (such as publications, films, recordings, artworks or news wire feeds) fully created and in existence, as defined in 31 CFR 515.332, 560.315 or 510.312?

ofac_emb_travel_baggage.description: Are the goods accompanied baggage for personal use imported incident to travel to or from any country (31 CFR 560.210(d), 510.213(d))?

ofac_emb_unpa_blocked.description: Does the transaction involve property or interests in property of a person blocked under the United Nations Participation Act, such as a person on both the SDN List and the UN Security Council Consolidated List (31 CFR 510.213(a))?

ofac_emb_license.description: Is the import claimed to be authorized by an OFAC general license or a specific license, or is no authorization claimed?

s337_order.description: Is the article covered by a U.S. International Trade Commission section 337 exclusion order (general or limited), by an ITC seizure and forfeiture order, or by neither (19 CFR 12.39(b)–(c))?

s337_us_government_patent.description: Is the order based on United States patents and the article imported by and for the use of the United States, or for the United States with the Government's authorization or consent (19 CFR 12.39(d))?

s337_ruling.description: Is no claim made that the article falls outside the order, or is a CBP ruling or ITC determination relied on to show that it does?

s337_status.description: Is the ITC determination still within the 60-day Presidential review period, or has it become final (19 CFR 12.39(a))?

tm_mark.description: Does the article bear a counterfeit of a trademark registered with the USPTO and recorded with CBP (19 CFR 133.21(a)); a mark or name copying or simulating a recorded mark or name (133.22(a)); a genuine recorded mark on restricted gray market goods imported without the U.S. owner's authorization (133.23(a)); or none of these?

tm_relief.description: Which relief is claimed, if any: none; removal or obliteration of the mark (not available for counterfeit marks); import by the recordant or its designate; the recordant's written consent; the one-item personal exemption for an arriving person (19 CFR 148.55); for gray market goods, a foreign owner that is the U.S. owner or affiliated with it, goods not physically and materially different, or the 133.23(b) label on physically and materially different goods?

dev_is_device.description: Is the product a device intended for human use within section 201(h) of the FD&C Act (including in vitro diagnostic products), or not a device?

dev_investigational.description: Is the device imported under the investigational device provisions of 21 CFR part 812 (21 CFR 807.40(c))?

dev_manufacturer.description: Was the device manufactured, prepared, propagated, compounded or processed at a foreign establishment, or at a U.S. establishment (for example, U.S. goods returned)?

dev_foreign_registered_listed.description: Is the foreign establishment registered and the device listed in FDA's electronic device registration and listing system (21 CFR 807.40(a), (c))?

dev_us_agent.description: Has the foreign establishment named a United States agent in its registration (21 CFR 807.40(b))?

dev_premarket.description: Is the device cleared (510(k)) or approved (PMA, De Novo) by FDA; exempt from premarket notification by its classification regulation or as a custom device, or covered by a pending PMA or reclassification petition (21 CFR 807.81(b), 807.85); or none of these?

dev_importer_role.description: Is the importer an initial importer that furthers the device's marketing without repackaging or relabeling (21 CFR 807.3(g)); a repackager, relabeler or specification developer; or only a wholesale distributor that does not manufacture, repackage, process or relabel (807.20(c))?

drug_product.description: Is the product a drug (human or animal, including an active pharmaceutical ingredient) or an animal feed bearing or containing a new animal drug, or not a drug (21 CFR 207.17)?

drug_establishment.description: Was the drug manufactured, repacked, relabeled or salvaged at a foreign establishment, or at a U.S. establishment?

drug_registration_exemption.description: Is a 21 CFR 207.13 registration and listing exemption claimed for the establishment, or none?

drug_establishment_registered.description: Is the foreign establishment registered with FDA (21 CFR 207.17, 207.21(b))?

drug_listed.description: Is the drug listed with FDA by the registrant (21 CFR 207.41)?

drug_us_agent.description: Has the foreign registrant designated a United States agent (21 CFR 207.69(b))?

cr_piratical.description: Is the article a copy or phonorecord of a copyrighted work recorded with CBP made without the copyright owner's authorization (19 CFR 133.42(a)), or not?

cr_personal_exemption.description: Does the article accompany a person arriving in the United States, for personal use, within the one-article-per-type and 30-day limits of 19 CFR 148.55?

cpscra_product.description: Is the article a consumer product within the Consumer Product Safety Act, or not?

cpscra_ground.description: Does a 15 U.S.C. 2066(a) ground apply: the product fails an applicable consumer product safety rule; lacks a required certificate, label or tracking label or carries a false certificate; has been determined imminently hazardous; has a defect that is a substantial product hazard; or was made by a manufacturer the Commission has reported for inspection or recordkeeping violations; or none?

cpscra_modification.description: Has the Commission permitted release under bond so the owner or consignee can modify the product, or not (15 U.S.C. 2066(c))?

fdar_product.description: Is the article a food, drug, device, tobacco product or cosmetic, or something else (21 U.S.C. 381(a))?

fdar_notice.description: Has FDA given the owner or consignee notice that the article may be refused admission (a notice of FDA action), or not (21 CFR 1.94(a))?

fdar_ground.description: Is the ground adulteration, misbranding or an unapproved new drug that relabeling or other action could correct or render the article other than a food, drug, device or cosmetic (21 U.S.C. 381(b)), or another ground?

fdar_low_value_drug_device.description: Is the article a drug, device or tobacco product valued at $2,500 or less (21 U.S.C. 381(a), as amended by Pub. L. 119-37)?

fdar_reconditioning.description: Will the owner or consignee apply for authorization to relabel or recondition the article (21 CFR 1.95)?

epa_fuel_product.description: Is the import gasoline; diesel fuel or another distillate fuel; another fuel, fuel additive or regulated blendstock subject to 40 CFR part 1090; or none of these?

epa_fuel_exemption.description: Is a 40 CFR part 1090 subpart G exemption claimed (national security or military use, research and testing, certain territories, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico and U.S. Virgin Islands summer gasoline, distillate global marine fuel or another), or none?

epa_fuel_importer_registered.description: Is the importer registered with EPA under 40 CFR 1090.800?

epa_fuel_import_mode.description: Is the product imported by marine vessel, by rail or truck, or by pipeline or another mode?

epa_fuel_marine_method.description: Will the importer certify the product on board the vessel (40 CFR 1090.1605(b)) or offload it into shore tanks holding the same product and certify there (1090.1605(d))?

epa_fuel_rail_truck_method.description: Will the importer test each railcar or truck compartment, rely on verified supplier test results (40 CFR 1090.1610(a)(1)), or certify in storage tanks holding the same product (1090.1610(a)(2))?

cbp_eb_entry_type.description: Is the merchandise entered on a formal entry, or on an informal or other entry?

cbp_eb_identity_on_file.description: Are CBP Form 5106 importer identity records on file, and used within the past year, for both the importer and the ultimate consignee (19 CFR 24.5)?

cbp_eb_bond.description: Is a continuous bond or a single entry bond on CBP Form 301 on file for the entry, or no bond (19 CFR 142.4(a))?

cbp_eb_summary_party.description: Is the entry summary filed by the same party that made entry, or by a different party (19 CFR 142.4(b)(2))?

cbp_eb_waiver_conditions.description: Is the merchandise worth $2,500 or less, with the entry summary filed and estimated duties deposited before release, by an importer never delinquent with CBP, and not quota merchandise, merchandise hard to appraise or classify, or merchandise with a redelivery concern (19 CFR 142.4(c))?

fccea_rf_device.description: Is the article a radio frequency device (47 CFR 2.801), or not?

fccea_entry_basis.description: Does the device enter on its equipment authorization (or because it needs none), or under one of the other 47 CFR 2.1204(a) entry conditions such as testing, trade shows, export, government use, personal use or repair?

fccea_procedure.description: Which equipment authorization procedure applies to the device: certification, Supplier's Declaration of Conformity, or none required?

fccea_authorized.description: Has the device received a valid grant of certification not limited under 47 CFR 2.939(e), or, for SDoC equipment, been tested and declared under 47 CFR 2.906?

fccea_sdoc_responsible_party.description: For SDoC equipment, is the importer the responsible party, or has a U.S.-located manufacturer, assembler, retailer or OEM agreed to be the responsible party (47 CFR 2.909(b))?

haccp_imp_product.description: Is the import a fish or fishery product (21 CFR part 123), juice (21 CFR part 120), or something else?

haccp_imp_mou.description: Is the product obtained from a country with an active, functioning FDA memorandum of understanding or similar agreement that covers it (21 CFR 123.12(a)(1), 120.14(a)(1)), or not?

haccp_imp_procedures.description: Does the importer have and implement written verification procedures with product specifications and affirmative steps (21 CFR 123.12(a)(2), 120.14(a)(2)), or not?

afood_article.description: Is the import animal food or feed without a new animal drug (including pet food and feed ingredients), a Type B or Type C medicated feed bearing or containing a new animal drug, a Type A medicated article or other new animal drug, or not animal food?

afood_registration.description: Must the facility that manufactures, processes, packs or holds the animal food register with FDA as a food facility under section 415 of the act (21 CFR part 1, subpart H), or not (for example a farm) (21 CFR 507.5(a))?

afood_pc_status.description: Is the facility subject to the full preventive controls and supply-chain program (21 CFR part 507 subparts C and E), a qualified facility (507.5(d), 507.7), solely engaged in storing unexposed packaged animal food (507.10), a human food facility holding and distributing human food by-products for animal food (507.12), or partly exempt under 507.5(b), (c), (e) or (f)?

afood_drug_approval.description: Is each new animal drug in the feed used under an approval, conditional approval or index listing for that use in the feed, with the feed's labeling, distribution, holding and use conforming to it (21 U.S.C. 360b(a)(2)), or not?

afood_category_ii_type_a.description: Is the Type B or Type C medicated feed manufactured from a Category II Type A medicated article (21 CFR 558.3(b)(1), 558.4(a))?

afood_vfd.description: Does the feed contain a veterinary feed directive (VFD) drug (21 CFR 558.3(b)(6), 558.6)?

flab_product.description: Is the import a conventional human food, a dietary supplement, infant formula or a medical food, a meat, poultry or egg product under USDA inspection, or not food for human consumption?

flab_form.description: Is the food imported in package form (labeled packages, whether for retail or not), or shipped in bulk to be processed, labeled or repacked in substantial quantity at another establishment (21 CFR 101.100(d))?

flab_bulk_route.description: Does the importer that introduces the bulk shipment operate the establishment that will process, label or repack it (21 CFR 101.100(d)(1)), is it shipped there under a signed written agreement with processing or labeling specifications (101.100(d)(2)), or neither?

flab_allergen.description: Is the food, or does it contain an ingredient (including a flavoring, coloring or incidental additive) that is or contains, a major food allergen (milk, egg, fish, Crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, wheat, peanuts, soybeans or sesame, 21 U.S.C. 321(qq)); does it contain none; or is it a raw agricultural commodity?

flab_foreign_language.description: Does the label carry any representation in a language other than English (21 CFR 101.15(c)(2))?

flab_nutrition.description: Must the food bear Nutrition Facts labeling (21 CFR 101.9(a)), or does an exemption in 21 CFR 101.9(j) apply with its conditions met (for example small business, insignificant nutrients, small packages, or low-volume products with an FDA exemption notice)?

flab_claims.description: Does the label or labeling bear a nutrient content claim or a health claim (21 CFR 101.13, 101.14)?

flab_structure_function.description: Does the dietary supplement's label or labeling bear a structure/function or other statement under section 403(r)(6) of the act (21 CFR 101.93)?

flab_ds_activity.description: In the United States, does the importer only hold and distribute the dietary supplement, also manufacture, package or label it, or hold it only at a retail establishment for direct sale to individual consumers (21 CFR 111.1)?

fadd_article.description: Is the import food for humans or animals (including pet food and animal feed, 21 CFR 170.3(m)), a color additive for use in food, a substance or ingredient for use in food, a food-contact article or substance (packaging or food-processing equipment), a color additive only for drugs, devices or cosmetics, or none of these?

fadd_color.description: Does the food or color additive contain no added color additive, a color additive listed for this use in food as exempt from certification (21 CFR part 73), a color additive listed for this use that is subject to batch certification (21 CFR part 74, or provisionally listed in parts 81 and 82), or a color additive not listed for this use (21 U.S.C. 379e(a))? If colors differ, answer not_listed_for_the_use if any one is, otherwise listed_subject_to_certification if any one is.

fadd_color_batch.description: Is every certifiable color additive from a batch FDA has certified for the use, with an unexpired certificate and the FDA lot number (21 CFR 80.31, 80.32), or not?

fadd_substance.description: For each added substance other than color additives: is there none, is every one used under a food additive regulation (21 CFR parts 172–180, or part 573 for animal food), generally recognized as safe for the use (21 CFR 170.30) or prior-sanctioned for the use (21 CFR part 181), is one a pesticide chemical, a new animal drug or a dietary ingredient in a dietary supplement (21 U.S.C. 321(s)), or is one a food additive with none of these authorizations?

fadd_contact.description: For the food-contact article or substance: is each migrating substance used under a food additive regulation (21 CFR parts 174–178, 179.45), an effective food contact notification (FCN, 21 CFR 170.100), a threshold of regulation exemption (21 CFR 170.39), or general recognition of safety or a prior sanction; does nothing migrate to food (21 CFR 170.3(e)(1)); or does a migrating substance have none of these?

fadd_fcn_supplier.description: Is the food contact substance made or prepared by the manufacturer or supplier identified in the effective FCN (21 CFR 170.100(a)), or by another manufacturer or supplier?

snur_substance.description: Is the chemical substance identified in a significant new use rule in 40 CFR part 721 subpart E, or not?

snur_form.description: Is the substance imported as a substance or in a mixture, or as part of an article (40 CFR 721.45(f))?

snur_article_exemption_overridden.description: Does the specific SNUR section provide that the article exemption does not apply (40 CFR 721.45)?

snur_exemption.description: Is another 40 CFR 721.45 exemption claimed (test marketing, research and development in small quantities, section 5(h)(5), impurity, byproduct, export only, prior notice with EPA compliance notification, or a section 5(e) consent order), or none?

snur_intended_use.description: Does the importer intend a significant new use designated in the SNUR section (40 CFR 721.5(a)(1)), or not?

snur_distribution.description: Will the importer distribute the substance in commerce (40 CFR 721.5(a)(2))?

snur_recipient_documentation.description: Can the importer document, for each recipient, written notice of the SNUR section, the recipient's knowledge of it, or that the recipient cannot undertake the significant new use (40 CFR 721.5(a)(2)(i)–(iii))?

cbp_quota_class.description: Is the merchandise subject to an absolute quota, a tariff-rate quota administered by CBP under 19 CFR part 132, or neither?

cbp_quota_status.description: Is the quantity entered within the quantity still admissible under the quota, or is the quota filled or the quantity in excess of it?

cbp_quota_trq_product.description: For an in-quota tariff-rate claim, is the merchandise beef of a participating country (19 CFR 132.15), a USMCA sugar-containing product of a participating country (132.17), worsted wool fabric under HTSUS 9902.51.11 or 9902.51.12 (132.18), or another product?

cbp_quota_certificate.description: Does the importer hold the valid export certificate or license (or licensee's written authorization) required for the in-quota claim, or not?

fv_product.description: Is the import a fresh or frozen fruit or vegetable for consumption or processing (not for planting) (7 CFR 319.56-2); a dried, cured or processed fruit or vegetable (not frozen); or not a fruit or vegetable?

fv_acorn_or_chestnut.description: Is the dried product an acorn or chestnut of a kind subject to 7 CFR 319.56-11?

fv_origin.description: Were the fruits or vegetables grown in Canada; grown in the British Virgin Islands and imported into the U.S. Virgin Islands; or grown elsewhere?

fv_restricted_canadian_potato.description: Are they potatoes from Newfoundland or from the part of the Municipality of Central Saanich, British Columbia, east of West Saanich Road (7 CFR 319.56-3(b)(1)(ii))?

fv_mango.description: Are the British Virgin Islands fruits mangoes (7 CFR 319.56-3(b)(1)(iii))?

fv_authorized.description: Is the commodity from this origin listed by APHIS as authorized for importation under 7 CFR 319.56-4 (the fruits and vegetables import requirements), or not?

fv_permit.description: Does the importer hold an APHIS import permit issued under 7 CFR 319.7 through 319.7-5 for the commodity, or not?

esa_listing.description: Is the specimen (live or dead, or a part or product) of a species listed in 50 CFR 17.11 or 17.12 as endangered wildlife, threatened wildlife, an endangered plant or a threatened plant, or not listed?

esa_threatened_rule.description: For the threatened species: was it added to the list on or before August 20, 2026 and covered by the general prohibitions; does a species-specific rule govern it; or was it added after August 20, 2026 without a species-specific rule?

esa_cultivated_seed.description: Are the threatened-plant specimens seeds of cultivated specimens accompanied by a statement that they are of "cultivated origin" (50 CFR 17.71(a))?

esa_appendix_ii_noncommercial.description: Is the threatened wildlife species listed in CITES Appendix II and the specimen neither acquired in foreign commerce nor imported in the course of a commercial activity (50 CFR 17.8(b))?

esa_subpart_a_exemption.description: Is a 50 CFR part 17 subpart A exemption (such as pre-Act wildlife or Alaska Native handicrafts) claimed, or none?

esa_permit.description: Does the importer hold an ESA permit for the import (50 CFR 17.22, 17.23, 17.32, 17.62, 17.63 or 17.72), or not?

cdc_animal_kind.description: Is the item a domestic dog or cat (42 CFR 71.51), a turtle, tortoise or terrapin or its egg (71.52), a live nonhuman primate or a nonhuman primate product (71.53), a rodent from Africa or native to Africa or another animal the CDC Director has prohibited by order, or a product from one (71.56), or none of these?

cdc_animal_in_transit.description: Is the dog, cat or nonhuman primate only transiting the United States between foreign countries, not to be released or imported here (42 CFR 71.51(cc), 71.53(r))?

cdc_animal_purpose.description: What is the purpose of the import: bona fide scientific, educational or exhibition purposes, a breeding colony for those purposes (nonhuman primates only), or other (42 CFR 71.52(c)(2), 71.53(d)(2), (t)(2)(ii), 71.56(a)(2)(ii))?

cdc_animal_permit.description: Has CDC issued the permit or written permission this import requires (the CDC dog import permit for a DMRVV-restricted country, the turtle permit, the nonhuman primate product permit or the 71.56 written permission), or none (42 CFR 71.51(ff)(5), 71.52(c)(2), 71.53(t)(2), 71.56(a)(2))?

cdc_animal_dog_age.description: Will the dog be at least six months old when it arrives in the United States (42 CFR 71.51(f))?

cdc_animal_dog_restricted_country.description: Is the dog being imported from a country CDC has designated DMRVV-restricted (42 CFR 71.51(ff))?

cdc_animal_dog_rabies_risk.description: In the six months before arrival, has the dog been only in DMRVV-free or DMRVV low-risk countries, or in a DMRVV high-risk country on CDC's list (42 CFR 71.51(a), (u))?

cdc_animal_dog_vaccination_certificate.description: Which valid rabies certification will the dog have: a certification of U.S.-issued rabies vaccination completed and endorsed before it left the United States, a certification of foreign rabies vaccination and microchip, or none (42 CFR 71.51(s)–(t))?

cdc_animal_dog_arrival.description: How will the dog arrive: by air at a U.S. airport with a CDC quarantine station and CDC-registered animal care facility, by air at another airport, by sea, or by land (42 CFR 71.51(b)–(d))?

cdc_animal_dog_seaport_service_animal.description: Is the dog a service animal (14 CFR 382.3) accompanying an individual with a disability, with a valid certification of foreign rabies vaccination and microchip and a valid serologic titer from a CDC-approved laboratory, or no (42 CFR 71.51(d)(5))?

cdc_animal_dog_rabies_serology.description: Will the dog arrive with an adequate rabies serologic titer from a CDC-approved laboratory on a sample drawn within CDC's timeframe, or none or inadequate (42 CFR 71.51(k)(7)(v))?

cdc_animal_turtle_item.description: Are the turtles live with a carapace length of less than 4 inches or viable turtle eggs, live with a carapace of 4 inches or more, or marine species (families Dermochelidae and Cheloniidae) (42 CFR 71.52(a)–(b))?

cdc_animal_turtle_count.description: How many live turtles and viable turtle eggs are in the entry: fewer than seven or seven or more (42 CFR 71.52(c))?

cdc_animal_turtle_business.description: Is the import in connection with a business (42 CFR 71.52(c)(1))?

cdc_animal_nhp_importer_registration.description: Is the importer registered with CDC as a nonhuman primate importer, or not registered (42 CFR 71.53(d)(1), (g))?

cdc_animal_nhp_port.description: Will the nonhuman primates enter through a port with a CDC quarantine station, another port with the CDC Director's advance written approval, or another port without it (42 CFR 71.53(f))?

cdc_animal_nhp_import_type.description: Is the import a zoo-to-zoo transfer, a laboratory-to-laboratory transfer on an established research protocol, an animal act, or another import (42 CFR 71.53(o)–(q))?

cdc_animal_nhp_transfer_records.description: For the zoo or laboratory transfer, will the recipient submit for CDC approval before the transfer the veterinary records, 14-day health certificate with a negative tuberculosis test and itinerary (and, for a laboratory, the research protocol), or can it not meet them (42 CFR 71.53(p)(2)–(3), (q)(2)–(3))?

cdc_animal_nhp_product_treatment.description: Is the nonhuman primate product fully taxidermied, rendered noninfectious by a 71.53(t)(1) method with documentation, or not rendered noninfectious (42 CFR 71.53(t))?

cdc_animal_rodent_product_noninfectious.description: Has the product been properly processed to render it noninfectious, such as a fully taxidermied animal or completely finished trophy (42 CFR 71.56(a)(3))?

icts_import_item.description: What is imported: a completed connected vehicle (15 CFR 791.301: a vehicle manufactured primarily for public roads with networked hardware communicating over cellular, satellite, dedicated short-range or other wireless connectivity, with a gross vehicle weight rating of 10,000 pounds or less, needing no further manufacturing); VCS hardware for a connected vehicle (communication modules, telematics units, cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or satellite modules, external antennas and similar components that directly enable a Vehicle Connectivity System); a connected vehicle or subassembly with VCS hardware already installed, to be sold as part of a completed connected vehicle; another vehicle outside the connected vehicle definition (over 10,000 pounds GVWR, rail only, or without such connectivity); or none of these?

icts_import_entry.description: Is the article entered into the U.S. customs territory, or only admitted into a foreign-trade zone for storage pending further assembly in the zone or shipment to a foreign country, which 15 CFR 791.301 does not treat as an import?

icts_us_person_for_us_vehicles.description: Is the importer a U.S. person importing completed connected vehicles for sale in the United States, or VCS hardware for a completed connected vehicle to be sold or operated in the United States (the connected vehicle manufacturer and VCS hardware importer of 15 CFR 791.301)?

icts_model_year.description: What model year is the import associated with (15 CFR 791.308): the vehicle's model year, or for VCS hardware the vehicle model year it is associated with, imported in, or imported to repair or service under warranty; before 2027; 2027 through 2029; 2030 or later; or, for VCS hardware only, not associated with a vehicle model year?

icts_vcs_hardware_source.description: Is the VCS hardware (installed in the vehicle, or imported) designed, developed, manufactured or supplied by persons owned by, controlled by, or subject to the jurisdiction or direction of the People's Republic of China or Russia (15 CFR 791.302; the nationality of individual employees alone does not count), is it not, or is there no VCS hardware in the vehicle?

icts_covered_software_source.description: Does the completed connected vehicle incorporate covered software (15 CFR 791.301: software with a foreign interest, run by the primary processing unit of an item that directly enables the Vehicle Connectivity System or Automated Driving System, excluding firmware, unmodified open-source software and subcomponents made before March 17, 2026 and not altered since by a foreign adversary entity), and if so is it designed, developed, manufactured or supplied by persons owned by, controlled by, or subject to the jurisdiction or direction of the People's Republic of China or Russia (15 CFR 791.303)?

icts_importer_prc_or_russia_controlled.description: Is the importer (the connected vehicle manufacturer or VCS hardware importer) itself owned by, controlled by, or subject to the jurisdiction or direction of the People's Republic of China or Russia (15 CFR 791.301, 791.304, 791.306(g)(2))?

icts_authorization.description: Does BIS authorize this otherwise prohibited transaction: a specific authorization BIS granted to the importer (15 CFR 791.307); a general authorization BIS published whose conditions the importer meets and from which BIS has not excluded it (15 CFR 791.306); or none?

icts_only_foreign_interest_is_equity.description: Is the only foreign interest in the transaction a foreign person's equity ownership of the U.S. importer, with no foreign design, development, manufacture or supply of the VCS hardware or covered software and no control of the importer through that equity (15 CFR 791.305(l))?

lacf_product.description: Is this a candidate acidified food, thermally processed low-acid food in a hermetically sealed container, or another food? Classification is checked against the further facts.

lacf_processor.description: Is the manufacturer/processor offering this food for U.S. import a foreign commercial processor, a domestic processor, or is the caller only the importer?

lacf_exclusion.description: Does the food fall under continuous USDA FSIS meat/poultry inspection, refrigeration, the enumerated acidified-food exclusions, alcoholic beverages or the qualifying tomato exception?

lacf_base_food.description: Before acid is added, is the food low-acid or naturally acid?

lacf_equilibrium_ph.description: Is the finished equilibrium pH at or below 4.6 or above 4.6?

lacf_water_activity.description: Is finished water activity above 0.85 or at/below 0.85?

lacf_processing.description: Was acid added to the low-acid food, was a low-acid food thermally processed in a hermetically sealed container, or neither?

lacf_registration_2541.description: Has the foreign processor declared a current Form FDA 2541 establishment registration? This answer does not verify FDA records.

lacf_process_filing.description: Has the foreign processor declared a scheduled-process filing for this food and container size? This answer does not verify process adequacy or FDA approval.

lacf_thermal_method.description: For the LACF scheduled process, is the method retort, water-activity/formulation control, aseptic, or another/unknown method?

lacf_process_change.description: For LACF, was a previously filed scheduled process intentionally changed in a safety-relevant way, only made more conservative by temperature/time, or unchanged?

isf_arrival.description: Will the cargo arrive in the United States by vessel? Other modes have separate advance-data rules.

isf_disposition_at_filing.description: At the time the ISF was filed, was this an entered/FTZ, FROB, IE/T&E, or IT shipment later converted to IE/T&E? Do not use the eventual disposition as the original route.

isf_cargo.description: Is this containerized/other, bulk, or break-bulk cargo for the carrier declaration?

isf_bulk_carrier_exemption.description: Does this bulk cargo meet the carrier cargo-declaration exemption in 19 CFR 4.7(b)(4)(i)?

isf_break_bulk_grant.description: Did CBP grant a written, matching carrier exemption for this break-bulk cargo under 19 CFR 4.7(b)(4)(ii)? An application alone is not a grant.

isf_voyage.description: Is the voyage from foreign lading to first U.S. arrival under 24 hours?

isf_filing_capacity.description: Is the filer the ISF importer itself or an authorized agent for another identified ISF importer?

isf_agent_principal.description: If filing as an agent, is the responsible ISF importer/principal identified?

nrtl_equipment.description: Is the product electrical equipment or conductors (material, fittings, devices, appliances, fixtures or apparatus used as part of or in connection with an electrical installation, including utilization equipment that uses electric energy) (29 CFR 1910.302(a), 1910.399)?

nrtl_use.description: Where will the equipment be installed or used: in a U.S. workplace by an employer's employees under OSHA's general industry standards; only by consumers in a household; in an installation the electrical standards exclude (ships, watercraft, railway rolling stock, aircraft or motor vehicles other than mobile homes and recreational vehicles, underground mines, railway power or signaling, or utility-controlled installations); in working conditions another Federal agency regulates for occupational safety; or in construction work (29 CFR 1910.5, 1910.302(a))?

nrtl_layer.description: Is the question the federal OSHA workplace approval of the equipment (29 CFR 1910.303(a)), or approval under a state or locally adopted electrical code by an authority having jurisdiction, an OSHA-approved State Plan, or a private or voluntary certification scheme (for example a retailer, insurer or industry listing requirement)?

nrtl_approval_route.description: Is the equipment of a kind that a nationally recognized testing laboratory accepts, certifies, lists, labels or determines to be safe; of a kind that no such laboratory covers; or custom-made equipment designed, fabricated for and intended for use by a particular customer (29 CFR 1910.399 “Acceptable”)?

hazmat_material.description: Is the imported material a hazardous material under the HMR (listed in the 49 CFR 172.101 table or meeting a hazard class definition of part 173): lithium cells or batteries (UN3090, UN3091, UN3480 or UN3481, including cells or batteries packed with or contained in equipment), another hazardous material, or not a hazardous material?

hazmat_transport_basis.description: How does the shipment move into and within the United States: by vessel prepared under the IMDG Code (with any rail or highway leg to or from the port, 49 CFR 171.25); prepared and transported under the HMR by highway, rail or vessel; with any leg by aircraft; or from Canada under the Transport Canada TDG Regulations (49 CFR 171.12)?

hazmat_exception.description: Is the shipment offered under a 49 CFR part 173 exception other than the 173.185(c) exception for smaller lithium cells and batteries (for example limited quantity, excepted quantity or materials of trade), or under a special permit or approval; or under none of these?

hazmat_lithium_condition.description: Are the lithium cells or batteries new or otherwise undamaged production cells or batteries; moved by motor vehicle for disposal or recycling; a low production run (no more than 100 a year) or prototypes moved for testing; or damaged, defective or recalled for safety reasons (49 CFR 173.185(d)–(f))?

hazmat_lithium_configuration.description: Are the lithium cells or batteries shipped by themselves, packed with equipment they power, or contained in that equipment (49 CFR 173.185)?

hazmat_lithium_size.description: Is every cell and battery within the 49 CFR 173.185(c)(1) limits (lithium ion: 20 Wh per cell, 100 Wh per battery; lithium metal: 1 g lithium per cell, 2 g per battery); within only the highway-and-rail limits (lithium ion: 60 Wh per cell, 300 Wh per battery; lithium metal: 5 g per cell, 25 g per battery) for a shipment moving only by highway or rail; or over those limits?

cpscsr_product.description: Is the product a consumer product (an article or component part produced or distributed for sale to, or the personal use of, a consumer in or around a household, school, recreation or otherwise), or an article the definition excludes: one not customarily produced or distributed for consumers, tobacco, motor vehicles or motor vehicle equipment, pesticides, articles subject to the 26 U.S.C. 4181 firearms tax, aircraft, boats and vessel equipment, drugs, devices, cosmetics or food (15 U.S.C. 2052(a)(5))?

cpscsr_childrens_product.description: Is the product designed or intended primarily for children 12 years of age or younger, considering the manufacturer's reasonable statement or label, how it is represented in packaging, display, promotion or advertising, whether consumers commonly recognize it as for that age, and CPSC's Age Determination Guidelines (15 U.S.C. 2052(a)(2))?

cpscsr_toy_or_child_care.description: Is the children's product a children's toy (designed or intended by the manufacturer for a child 12 or younger to use when the child plays), a child care article (designed or intended to facilitate sleep or feeding of children 3 and younger, or to help them with sucking or teething), or neither (16 CFR 1307.2)?

cpscsr_lead_paint_category.description: Is the product itself paint or a similar surface-coating material for consumer use; a toy or other article intended to be entrusted to or for use by children that bears paint or a similar surface coating; a furniture article (a movable article used to support people or things, or other functional or decorative furniture, but not appliances, fixtures or household items such as shades or draperies) that bears paint or a similar surface coating; or none of these? Printing inks and materials that become part of or are bonded to the substrate (pigment in plastic, electroplating, ceramic glazing) are not paint (16 CFR 1303.2).

cpscsr_lead_paint_exemption.description: Does a 16 CFR 1303.3 exemption from the lead paint ban apply: an agricultural or industrial equipment refinish coating, industrial or commercial building and equipment maintenance coating, graphic art coating, touchup coating for agricultural, lawn and garden equipment or appliances, or catalyzed coating for radio-controlled model aircraft (exempt only with the cautionary label); a lead-containing mirror backing on furniture, artists' paints and related materials, or a metal furniture article (not children's furniture) with factory-applied coatings (exempt without a label); or none?

cpscsr_product_specific_rules.description: Beyond the lead content, lead paint, phthalate and toy standard categories asked here, which is true: no other consumer product safety rule, ban, standard or regulation applies to the product; one or more identified product-specific rules or standards apply and the product is designed to meet them; the product is a banned hazardous substance (16 CFR 1500.17) or a banned toy or children's article (16 CFR 1500.18) with no exemption under 16 CFR 1500.85 or 1500.86; or the applicable rules have not been determined?

pre_columbian_monumental_art.description: Is the object pre-Columbian monumental or architectural sculpture or mural (19 CFR 12.105): a stone monument, architectural structure, architectural mask, decorated capstone, fresco, frieze, glyph, mosaic or other carving or decoration that was part of or affixed to a monument or structure (including cave paintings), or a fragment of one, that is the product of a pre-Columbian Indian culture of Belize, Bolivia, Colombia, Costa Rica, the Dominican Republic, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Mexico, Panama, Peru or Venezuela?

pre_columbian_entry_evidence.description: What can be filed or presented to the port director at entry: a certificate (or its electronic equivalent) from the government of the country of origin (where the object was first discovered) that the export did not violate its laws (19 CFR 12.107(a)); satisfactory evidence that it was exported from the country of origin on or before June 1, 1973 (19 CFR 12.107(b)); satisfactory evidence that it is not an article listed in 19 CFR 12.105 (19 CFR 12.107(c)); or none at entry?

pesticide_import_item.description: What is imported: a pesticide (a substance or mixture intended for preventing, destroying, repelling or mitigating any pest or for use as a plant regulator, defoliant or desiccant, including an active ingredient intended for pesticide manufacture, 40 CFR 152.15); a device (an instrument or contrivance, other than a firearm, for trapping, destroying, repelling or mitigating pests, not application equipment sold separately, 40 CFR 152.500(a)); an article or substance treated with a pesticide only to protect itself, such as treated paint or wood (40 CFR 152.25(a)); a chemical that can be used as a pesticide but is not imported for that use (19 CFR 12.112(b)); or none of these (for example a fertilizer without a pesticide, or a cleaning agent sold without pesticidal claims, 40 CFR 152.8, 152.10)?

pesticide_treated_article_pesticide_regi.description: Is the pesticide in the treated article registered for use in protecting that article or substance (40 CFR 152.25(a))?

pesticide_chemical_on_pesticide_index.description: Is the chemical shown on the Index of Pesticide Products in EPA's Recognition and Management of Pesticide Poisonings (19 CFR 12.112(b))?

pesticide_fifra_exemption.description: Does a FIFRA exemption cover the pesticide as intended for use and used: a biological control agent that is not a microorganism or virus, or a living plant used as one (40 CFR 152.20(a)); a non-liquid chemical sterilant other than ethylene oxide (152.20(b)); a pheromone or pheromone trap (152.25(b)); a preservative for biological specimens (152.25(c)); a food with no active ingredient used to attract pests (152.25(d)); a qualifying natural cedar product (152.25(e)); a minimum risk pesticide meeting every condition of 152.25(f); or none?

pesticide_registration.description: Is the pesticide registered under FIFRA section 3 (40 CFR part 152), unregistered but moved on a basis 40 CFR 152.30 allows, or unregistered with no such basis?

pesticide_unregistered_basis.description: Which 40 CFR 152.30 basis applies to the unregistered pesticide: transfer between registered establishments of the same producer (a); transfer to another producer's registered establishment solely for further formulation, packaging or labeling into a registered product (b); an experimental use permit (c)(1); a use needing no experimental use permit under 40 CFR 172.3 (c)(2); transfer solely for export (d); a FIFRA section 18 emergency exemption (e); disposal (f); or an existing stocks order (g)?

pesticide_producing_establishment_regist.description: Is the establishment that produced the pesticide or device registered with EPA with an assigned establishment registration number (40 CFR 167.20(a)(3), (c))?

pesticide_notice_of_arrival.description: How is the Notice of Arrival of Pesticides and Devices provided: EPA Form 3540-1 submitted to EPA before the shipment arrives, the electronic alternative filed with the entry through a CBP-authorized electronic data interchange system, or none (19 CFR 12.112(a), 12.113)?

dea_cs_schedule.description: In which schedule of the Controlled Substances Act (21 CFR part 1308) is the substance listed: Schedule I, II, III, IV or V, or is it not a controlled substance?

dea_cs_narcotic.description: Is the Schedule III, IV or V substance a narcotic drug as defined in 21 U.S.C. 802 (21 CFR 1312.11(a))?

dea_cs_permit_designation.description: Is the non-narcotic Schedule III, IV or V substance designated by DEA in 21 CFR 1312.30 as requiring an import permit, a Schedule IV or V substance also listed in Schedule I or II of the 1971 Convention on Psychotropic Substances, or neither (21 CFR 1312.11(a)–(b))?

dea_cs_purpose.description: Is the substance imported for the United States, or imported for transshipment or transferred or transshipped within the United States for immediate exportation (21 CFR 1312.31–1312.32)?

dea_cs_importer_registration.description: Is the importer registered with DEA to import the substance (including as a coincident activity of another registration), exempt from registration under 21 CFR part 1301, or neither (21 CFR 1312.11)?

dea_cs_mail_shipment.description: Will the shipment be imported by mail (21 CFR 1312.12(b)(6))?

dea_cs_import_permit.description: Has DEA issued an import permit for this shipment on the importer's DEA Form 357 application, or none (21 CFR 1312.12–1312.13)?

dea_cs_import_declaration.description: Has the importer filed the import declaration on DEA Form 236 for this shipment and received DEA's transaction identification number, or none (21 CFR 1312.18(b))?

atf_import_article.description: What is imported: a firearm, a firearm barrel or ammunition as defined in 18 U.S.C. 921(a) (27 CFR part 478); another defense article on the U.S. Munitions Import List of 27 CFR 447.21 (for example firearm parts and components, artillery, rockets, bombs or military vessels); a muzzle loading firearm or a Category I(a) firearm manufactured in or before 1898 (27 CFR 447.11); or none of these?

atf_import_importer_status.description: Who imports it: the United States or a federal agency, a State or a department, agency or political subdivision of a State, a licensed importer under 27 CFR part 478 (or, for other Import List articles, an importer engaged in that business), another Federal firearms licensee, or a person without a Federal firearms license?

atf_import_usmil_listed.description: Is the firearm, firearm barrel or ammunition also a defense article on the U.S. Munitions Import List (27 CFR 447.21; for example a Category I(a) firearm to caliber .50 or Category III ammunition for it)?

atf_import_basis.description: On what basis is it brought in: a permanent import; by a member of the U.S. Armed Forces on (or within 60 days after) active duty abroad for personal use (27 CFR 478.114); by the person who took it out of the United States (478.115(a)); temporarily by a nonresident for hunting or sporting (478.115(d)(1), 478.120); temporarily by foreign military personnel, officials or law enforcement officers (478.115(d)(2)–(5)); conditionally for examination and testing (478.116); as components for items made under a Department of Defense contract (447.53(a)(2)); as articles made abroad with Department of State or Commerce approval (447.53(a)(3)); or in transit or temporarily (447.46)?

atf_import_nfa_firearm.description: Is the firearm a firearm within 26 U.S.C. 5845(a) (National Firearms Act: for example a machinegun, short-barreled rifle or shotgun, silencer or destructive device) (27 CFR 447.2(a))?

atf_import_usmil_registration.description: Is the importer registered with ATF on Form 4587 as engaged in the business of importing U.S. Munitions Import List articles, not registered, or not engaged in that business (27 CFR 447.31)?

atf_import_permit_exception.description: Is the Import List article from Canada and outside Categories I, II, III, IV, VI(e), VIII(a), XVI and XX, or minor components and parts (not barrels, cylinders, receivers or complete breech mechanisms) for Category I(a) or I(b) firearms worth no more than $100 wholesale in the transaction, or neither (27 CFR 447.41(c))?

atf_import_origin_restriction.description: Does the article originate in a proscribed country or area of 27 CFR 447.52(a) (with or without meeting the 447.52(e) curio or relic criteria), is it a firearm located or manufactured in Georgia, Kazakstan, Kyrgyzstan, Moldova, the Russian Federation, Turkmenistan, Ukraine, Uzbekistan or the former Soviet Union (a model listed in 447.52(b)(1) or another model), is it 7.62 × 25mm ammunition from those places, or none of these?

atf_import_us_military_article.description: Is it a military defense article of U.S. manufacture furnished to a foreign government under a U.S. foreign assistance or foreign military sales program; if so, does the application include written Department of State authorization and, for firearms, are they curios or relics with the foreign government's certification (27 CFR 447.57)?

atf_import_permit.description: Has ATF approved the import permit application (ATF Form 6—Part I, 6—Part II or the Form 6 conditional importation) for this import, or none?

organic_import_product.description: Is the imported agricultural product to be sold, labeled or represented as "100 percent organic," "organic" or "made with organic (specified ingredients or food group(s))" (7 CFR 205.100(a), 205.273)?

organic_import_exporter_certification.description: Is the shipment certified under subpart E of 7 CFR part 205 by a USDA-accredited certifying agent, by a foreign certifying agent authorized under an organic trade arrangement or agreement, or not certified (7 CFR 205.273)?

organic_import_certificate.description: Has the exporter's certifying agent issued the NOP Import Certificate for this shipment through the Organic Integrity Database before export, or not (7 CFR 205.273(a)–(c))?

organic_import_importer_operation.description: Is the importing operation certified under subpart E, exempt as a customs broker only conducting customs business, exempt as only arranging shipping, storage or transport, exempt as only receiving, storing or preparing for shipment products in sealed, tamper-evident packages, or not certified (7 CFR 205.100(a), 205.101(e)–(h))?

cdc_import_material.description: Is the item an infectious biological agent (a microorganism or prion, or a component of one, capable of causing communicable disease in a human), an infectious substance (material known or reasonably expected to contain one), a vector (an animal, animal product or noninfectious self-replicating system known or capable of transferring one to a human), or none of these (42 CFR 71.54(a))?

cdc_import_permit_exclusion.description: Which 42 CFR 71.54(f) exclusion applies, if any: a select agent whose import is authorized under 42 CFR 73.16 or 9 CFR 121.16; a diagnostic specimen not known or suspected to contain an infectious biological agent; an animal or animal product for educational, exhibition or scientific purposes not known or suspected to contain one; nucleic acids that cannot produce infectious forms; a product authorized under the FD&C Act, PHS Act section 351 or the Virus-Serum-Toxin Act; an animal or animal product whose import is authorized under 42 CFR 71.52, 71.53 or 71.56; or none?

cdc_import_bat_or_nonhuman_primate.description: Is the diagnostic specimen a bat or nonhuman primate specimen, or the animal or animal product a live bat or a bat or nonhuman primate product (42 CFR 71.54(f)(2)–(3))?

cdc_import_permit.description: Has CDC issued an import permit for this item, or none (42 CFR 71.54(b)(1))?

cosmetic_article.description: Is the article a cosmetic (an article intended to be rubbed, poured, sprinkled or sprayed on, introduced into or otherwise applied to the human body for cleansing, beautifying, promoting attractiveness or altering the appearance, or a component of one; 21 U.S.C. 321(i)), a cosmetic that is also a drug or device subject to 21 U.S.C. chapter 9, subchapter V (21 U.S.C. 364i), soap, which the cosmetic definition excludes, or none of these?

cosmetic_facility_small_business.description: Does the owner or operator of each facility that manufactures or processes the cosmetic qualify as a small business: average gross annual U.S. sales of cosmetic products under $1,000,000 (adjusted for inflation) over the previous 3 years, and no manufacturing or processing of cosmetics that regularly contact the mucous membrane of the eye, are injected, are intended for internal use, or are intended to alter appearance for more than 24 hours (21 U.S.C. 364h)?

cosmetic_facility_registration.description: Is each facility that manufactures or processes the cosmetic, including a foreign facility, registered with FDA, first engaged in that manufacturing or processing within the last 60 days, not registered, or registered but suspended by FDA (21 U.S.C. 364c(a), (f))?

cosmetic_responsible_person_small_busine.description: Does the responsible person (the manufacturer, packer or distributor named on the label) qualify as a small business: average gross annual U.S. sales of cosmetic products under $1,000,000 (adjusted for inflation) over the previous 3 years, and no manufacturing or processing of cosmetics that regularly contact the mucous membrane of the eye, are injected, are intended for internal use, or are intended to alter appearance for more than 24 hours (21 U.S.C. 364(4), 364h)?

cosmetic_product_listing.description: Has the responsible person listed the cosmetic product with FDA, was the product first marketed in the United States within the last 120 days, or is it not listed (21 U.S.C. 364c(c))?

cosmetic_label_adverse_event_contact.description: Does the cosmetic's label include a domestic address, domestic phone number or electronic contact information (such as a website) through which the responsible person can receive adverse event reports (21 U.S.C. 364e(a))?

cosmetic_package_form.description: Is the cosmetic imported in package form, that is, in the package it will be sold in (21 U.S.C. 362(b))?

fda_tobacco_article.description: What is the article: cigarettes; cigarette tobacco; roll-your-own tobacco; smokeless tobacco; a product containing nicotine not made or derived from tobacco (such as synthetic nicotine pouches or e-liquids); a cigar other than a premium cigar; a premium cigar; another tobacco product FDA deemed subject to its authority (e-cigarettes and other electronic nicotine delivery systems, e-liquids, pipe tobacco, hookah tobacco, nicotine gels, dissolvables, and components or parts of these); an accessory of such a deemed product (for example an ashtray, a lighter or a humidor, which contains no tobacco); a drug, device or combination product (for example a smoking cessation product); tobacco leaf held by a tobacco product manufacturer; tobacco leaf not held by a manufacturer; or none of these (21 U.S.C. 321(rr), 387a(b)–(c); 21 CFR 1100.2)?

fda_tobacco_marketing_authorization.description: What is the product's FDA marketing status: commercially marketed in the United States as of February 15, 2007 and not modified since; authorized by an FDA order finding it substantially equivalent; a minor modification FDA exempted from substantial equivalence, with the abbreviated report filed; authorized by a marketing granted order on a premarket tobacco product application; first introduced between February 15, 2007 and March 22, 2011 with a substantial equivalence report filed in that period and still pending; or no marketing order in effect (never authorized, or the order was denied, withdrawn, rescinded or suspended) (21 U.S.C. 387j(a), 387e(j))?

fda_tobacco_cigarette_characterizing_fla.description: Does the cigarette or any of its component parts (tobacco, filter or paper) contain an artificial or natural flavor other than tobacco or menthol, or an herb or spice, that is a characterizing flavor of the product or its smoke (21 U.S.C. 387g(a)(1)(A))?

fda_tobacco_modified_risk_representation.description: Does the label, labeling or advertising represent the product as presenting a lower risk of disease, being less harmful, containing a reduced level of or being free of a substance, or use the descriptors "light", "mild", "low" or similar; and if so, is an FDA modified risk order in effect for it (21 U.S.C. 387k)?

fda_tobacco_user_fee.description: Has the manufacturer or importer paid every FDA tobacco user fee assessed to it by its due date, or has none been assessed, or is an assessed fee past due and unpaid (21 U.S.C. 387s, 387b(4))?

fda_tobacco_us_establishment.description: Will the product be manufactured, prepared, compounded or processed, including repackaged or relabeled, at an establishment in a State; and if so, is that establishment registered with FDA with the product listed, first engaging in that activity now, or not registered or not listing the product (21 U.S.C. 387e(a)–(c), (i))?

fda_tobacco_package_form.description: Is the tobacco product imported in package form, that is, in the pack, box, carton or container in which it will be sold to consumers (21 U.S.C. 387c(a)(2); 21 CFR 1100.3)?

fda_tobacco_package_label.description: Does the package label bear the name and place of business of the manufacturer, packer or distributor, an accurate quantity statement, the percentages of domestically and foreign grown tobacco, the statement "sale only allowed in the United States" (for tobacco products other than cigarettes) and the required warning statement (21 U.S.C. 387c(a)(2), 387t(a); 21 CFR part 1143)?

epa_vehicle_import_item.description: What is imported: a light-duty vehicle or highway motorcycle; a heavy-duty highway vehicle or engine (installed or loose); a nonroad or stationary engine or equipment containing one; or none of these (19 CFR 12.73(a), 12.74(a); 40 CFR 85.1501(a), 1068.301(a))?

epa_vehicle_entry_circumstance.description: Is this an ordinary import, a vehicle of a resident returning from Canada, Mexico or another EPA-designated country, or a Canadian or Mexican commuter or tourist vehicle for which the port director issued the 19 CFR 12.73(c)(2) waiver identification?

epa_vehicle_manufacturer_import.description: Is the importer the company that manufactured the vehicle or engine, does it hold the valid EPA certificate of conformity covering it, and does the imported article bear the conformity label (19 CFR 12.73(i)(1), 12.74(b)(1))?

epa_vehicle_certification.description: What is the EPA emission-certification status on import: covered by a certificate and properly labeled; manufactured for compliance with certification pending; previously certified or admitted, catalyst/O2-sensor equipped, labeled and driven abroad; built before standards applied; or nonconforming (19 CFR 12.73(b); 40 CFR 85.1502(a)(9), 85.1512, 1068.301(b))?

epa_vehicle_catalyst_program.description: Is the previously certified/admitted vehicle included in a catalyst and oxygen-sensor control program EPA approved for the model year (40 CFR 85.1512(a)–(b))?

epa_vehicle_nonconforming_basis.description: Which route applies to this nonconforming light-duty vehicle or highway motorcycle: an ICI certificate route, an ICI modification-and-test route, a manufacture-date exclusion, the over-20-original-production-year ICI exemption, racing, a temporary repair/testing/prototype/display/export route, national security, hardship, diplomatic or foreign military use, nonresident personal use, or none (40 CFR 85.1503, 85.1511; 19 CFR 12.73(e)–(h))?

epa_vehicle_modification_test_eligibilit.description: For the ICI modification-and-test route, is the vehicle at least six original-production years old, a qualifying vehicle owned, purchased and used overseas by U.S. Government military or civilian personnel, or neither (40 CFR 85.1509(a))?

epa_vehicle_engine_exemption.description: Which 40 CFR part 1068 route applies to the nonconforming heavy-duty engine/vehicle or nonroad/stationary engine/equipment: competition, stationary, hobby or another standard-setting exclusion; a national-security, manufacturer-owned, replacement-engine, hardship or identical-configuration permanent exemption; a temporary repair, testing, display, export, diplomatic/military, delegated-assembly or partially-complete route; or none (40 CFR 1068.310, 1068.315, 1068.325)?

epa_vehicle_declaration.description: Was the required EPA declaration filed with CBP at entry (or at the weekly FTZ entry summary): Form 3520-1 for light-duty vehicles and highway motorcycles, or Form 3520-21 for heavy-duty and nonroad/stationary engines and equipment (19 CFR 12.73(i)(3)–(4), 12.74(b)(3)–(4))?

faa_uscg_product.description: What is imported: an aircraft engine or propeller; an aviation article (material, part, appliance or TSO article); an aircraft; a recreational boat (a vessel manufactured or used primarily for noncommercial use, 33 CFR 181.3); associated equipment for such boats; equipment or material that 46 CFR chapter I requires to be Coast Guard approved (such as lifesaving or fire protection equipment); or none of these?

faa_uscg_bilateral_agreement.description: Is the country or jurisdiction of manufacture subject to an agreement with the United States for the acceptance of this aviation product or article (14 CFR 21.500(a), 21.502(a), 21.29(a))?

faa_uscg_aircraft_category.description: Which airworthiness certificate is sought for the aircraft: standard category (normal, utility, acrobatic, commuter, transport, manned free balloon or special class), restricted category, or another category (primary, limited, light-sport, experimental and others)?

faa_uscg_aircraft_condition.description: Is the aircraft newly produced under the authority of its State of Manufacture, which certifies under the export provisions of its agreement with the United States that it conforms to its type design and is in condition for safe operation; or is it a used aircraft or otherwise not so certified (14 CFR 21.183(c), (d))?

faa_uscg_us_type_certificate.description: Does the aircraft, engine or propeller already hold a U.S. type certificate (14 CFR 21.21, 21.25 or 21.29), or not?

faa_uscg_export_only.description: Is the boat or equipment intended solely for export, and so labeled, tagged or marked on the item and on the outside of any container (33 CFR 181.11(a))?

faa_uscg_outboard_183_710.description: Is the equipment an outboard motor or starting control to which 33 CFR 183.710 applies (33 CFR 181.11(c))?

faa_uscg_part183_standard.description: Does a Coast Guard safety standard in 33 CFR part 183 apply to the boat or equipment (33 CFR 181.5)?

faa_uscg_boat_purpose.description: Is the boat imported for sale, or for the importer's own use and not for sale (33 CFR 181.23)?

faa_uscg_cg_approval.description: Does the equipment hold a Coast Guard certificate of approval, a Coast Guard approval issued by a foreign authority under an effective Mutual Recognition Agreement, or no approval yet (46 CFR 159.003-3, 159.005-13)?

nhtsa_ri_route.description: Is the vehicle entered under 49 CFR 591.5(f) because it does not conform to all applicable Federal motor vehicle safety and bumper standards (but conforms to the theft prevention standards) and will be conformed by a Registered Importer, or on another 591.5 basis (certified conforming, 25 years or older, temporary, special purpose, export only and others)?
