nhtsa_ri_registered_importer.description: Is the importer a Registered Importer with NHTSA (49 CFR part 592), has it contracted with one, is the Registered Importer's registration suspended or revoked, or is no Registered Importer involved?

nhtsa_ri_suspension_timing.description: Had the Registered Importer already entered the vehicle when its registration was suspended or revoked, or is the vehicle not yet entered (49 CFR 592.7(d))?

nhtsa_ri_eligibility.description: Has NHTSA decided under 49 CFR part 593 that the vehicle's model and model year is eligible for importation (a vehicle eligibility number on NHTSA's list, or a granted petition), or not?

nhtsa_ri_petition_basis.description: On which basis could the vehicle be found eligible: substantially similar to a model certified for sale in the United States and capable of being readily modified to conform; safety features that comply with, or can be modified to comply with, all applicable standards; or neither (49 CFR 593.5(a))?

nhtsa_ri_first_certification.description: Is this the Registered Importer's first certification to NHTSA of this make, model and model year, or a subsequent one (49 CFR 592.6(d)(6)–(7))?

aphis_ani_article.description: What is imported: a live ruminant (cattle, other bovines, sheep, goats, camelids, cervids or other ruminants), live swine, live poultry other than hatching eggs (chickens, doves, ducks, geese, grouse, guinea fowl, partridges, pea fowl, pheasants, pigeons, quail, swans or turkeys), another live animal (horses, other birds, hatching eggs, dogs, elephants, aquatic animals and others), meat of ruminants or swine, another animal product (poultry meat or eggs, milk, organs, gelatin and others, 9 CFR part 94), an animal byproduct or hay or straw (9 CFR part 95), a veterinary biological product (9 CFR part 104), an organism or vector of animal disease (9 CFR part 122), or none of these?

aphis_ani_origin.description: Where are the live animals shipped from: Canada or Mexico, Central America or the West Indies, or another region (9 CFR part 93)?

aphis_ani_ruminant_species.description: Is the ruminant a bovine, camelid, cervid, sheep or goat, or another ruminant (9 CFR 93.401(a))?

aphis_ani_fmd_region.description: Was the animal or meat raised (and, for meat, slaughtered) in a region on the APHIS list of regions declared free of foot-and-mouth disease, and does the shipment enter a port in or transit a region where the disease exists on the way; or is it from a region not on that list (9 CFR 94.1)?

aphis_ani_wild.description: Are the ruminants or swine wild animals, such as giraffes, deer, antelopes or wild swine for exhibition (9 CFR 93.404(c), 93.504(c))?

aphis_ani_poultry_disease_status.description: Did the poultry originate in or transit a region APHIS lists under 9 CFR 94.6(a) where highly pathogenic avian influenza or Newcastle disease exists in commercial poultry, or were they vaccinated for the H5 or H7 subtype of avian influenza (9 CFR 93.201(a))?

aphis_ani_meat_species.description: Is the meat from ruminants (beef, veal, lamb, mutton, goat and other ruminants) or from swine (pork)?

aphis_ani_meat_form.description: Is the meat fresh (chilled or frozen); cured and fully dried so it keeps without refrigeration; cooked; or canned meat as defined in 9 CFR part 431 (9 CFR 94.1, 94.4)?

aphis_ani_beef_ovine_94_29.description: Is the fresh meat beef or ovine meat from a region 9 CFR 94.29 specifies, exported under the conditions of that section (9 CFR 94.1(b)(4))?

aphis_ani_asf_region.description: Is the region of origin on the APHIS list of regions where African swine fever exists or is reasonably believed to exist (9 CFR 94.8(a))?

aphis_ani_byproduct_diseased.description: Was the byproduct taken or removed from an animal affected with anthrax, foot-and-mouth disease, highly pathogenic avian influenza or Newcastle disease (9 CFR 95.3)?

aphis_ani_byproduct_entry.description: Does the byproduct meet the requirements for entry its own 9 CFR part 95 section states (for example untanned hides from foot-and-mouth disease free regions, 95.16), or will it enter under that section's restrictions or the BSE conditions for bovine-derived materials (95.4–95.14, 95.17–95.39)?

aphis_ani_biologic_permit.description: Which U.S. Veterinary Biological Product Permit does the import need: for research and evaluation, for distribution and sale, or for transit shipment only through the United States (9 CFR 104.2)?

aphis_ani_organism_part102_permit.description: Has an import permit already been issued for these organisms under 9 CFR part 102 (9 CFR 122.2)?

lacey_plant_content.description: Does the imported article contain plant material? Select none only when there is zero plant material.

lacey_material_class.description: Does the plant satisfy the 7 CFR 357.2 qualified common-cultivar, common-food-crop, research-specimen, or planting exclusion, or is it wild material or a tree? A tree is never a common cultivar.

lacey_protected_listing.description: Is any plant material CITES-listed, ESA-listed, or protected by a qualifying State conservation law? Unknown status must not be treated as unlisted.

lacey_packaging_role.description: Is the plant used exclusively as packaging to support, protect or carry another imported item, or is the plant packaging itself merchandise?

lacey_plant_unit_weight.description: Does the plant material represent no more than 5 percent of the total weight of each individual product unit?

lacey_plant_entry_line_weight.description: Does the total plant material in this entry of products under the same 10-digit HTS provision weigh no more than 2.9 kg?

lacey_schedule_heading.description: Which exact APHIS Lacey Act implementation-schedule heading matches the declared 10-digit HTS classification? Select not_on_published_schedule only after checking the official schedule; classification is declared, not verified.

lacey_species_details.description: Does the declaration name genus and species, or every possible species when a plant product uses varying unknown species?

lacey_harvest_details.description: Does the declaration name the harvest country, or every possible country when a multi-country species has unknown harvest origin?

lacey_value_quantity_unit.description: Does the declaration provide import value, plant quantity and the unit of measure?

lacey_recycled_paper.description: Does this paper or paperboard product include recycled plant content?

lacey_recycled_percent.description: Is the average recycled-content percentage supplied in addition to non-recycled plant information?

lacey_filing_channel.description: Was the declaration submitted through CBP ACE, APHIS LAWGS, or paper/not submitted? Paper is no longer accepted after 2026-01-01.

aphis_soil_material.description: Is the material unsterilized soil, sterilized soil, or not soil as defined in 7 CFR 330.100?

aphis_soil_other_rule.description: Is this soil regulated under another APHIS chapter rule or the 7 CFR 319.37-10 planting-medium rule?

aphis_soil_origin.description: Is this soil from an area of Canada that Canada's national plant protection organization does not regulate for a soil-borne plant pest, or from another or regulated area?

aphis_soil_permit.description: Has APHIS issued a currently valid import permit covering this shipment and its conditions, is it expired or revoked, or is there only an application or no permit?

aphis_soil_purpose.description: Is the soil imported for ordinary use, extraction of plant pests, or disposal of contaminating plant pests?

aphis_soil_facility.description: For pest extraction or contaminated-soil disposal, is the direct destination an APHIS-approved facility for that purpose?

aphis_soil_hand_carry.description: Will the soil be hand-carried into the United States?

aphis_soil_hand_carry_authorization.description: Does the issued permit name the authorized hand carrier and did the permittee give APHIS that carrier's name at least 20 days before movement?

aphis_pest_identity.description: Is the organism a plant pest under 7 CFR 330.100 or an APHIS 330.200(b) determination, not a plant pest, or an unknown-risk organism without an APHIS determination?

aphis_pest_other_route.description: Is the import authorized by another APHIS chapter regulation, an APHIS general permit, or a claimed explicit exception, or is none of those asserted?

aphis_pest_permit.description: Has APHIS issued a currently valid import permit covering this plant pest and shipment conditions, is it expired or revoked, is there only an application or no permit, or only a continued-curation permit?

aphis_pest_hand_carry.description: Will the plant pest be hand-carried into the United States?

aphis_pest_hand_carry_authorization.description: Does the issued permit name an authorized hand carrier with notice to APHIS at least 20 days before movement, is either condition missing or late, or has APHIS cancelled authorization?

fas_dairy_license_intent.description: Do you intend to enter this article under a FAS dairy import license? This does not determine whether a license is required or valid.

fas_dairy_entry_kind.description: Is this a consumption entry, a warehouse withdrawal for consumption, or another entry kind?

fas_dairy_purchase_route.description: Was the licensee's purchase a direct sale from a foreign supplier, a sale in transit, or a purchase in warehouse?

fas_dairy_supplier_warehoused.description: For the direct foreign sale, did the foreign supplier enter the article into warehouse?

fsis_article_class.description: Is this a meat product, poultry product, human-food egg product, shell egg or another article?

fsis_meat_route.description: Is this an ordinary meat import, or is an exception under 9 CFR 327.16 or 327.17 claimed? An exception claim is not verified.

avocado_use.description: Are the avocados for ordinary use, charitable consumption, relief distribution, seed, or commercial processing into products?

avocado_weight_band.description: Is the avocado shipment at most 55 pounds or above 55 pounds? This is a declared band, not a measured weight.

avocado_maturity_group.description: Are all avocados Hass, Fuerte, Zutano or Edranol, or are other, mixed or unknown varieties present?

fee_entry.description: Is the merchandise formally entered or released (including release under immediate delivery and withdrawal from warehouse for consumption, 19 CFR 24.23(a)(2)), informally entered or released, or only admitted to a foreign-trade zone?

fee_conveyance.description: On what conveyance does the merchandise arrive: a commercial vessel, a commercial truck, a commercial railroad car, a commercial aircraft, or another way (such as mail, pipeline or a non-commercial vehicle)?

fee_excise_product.description: Is the merchandise subject to a federal excise tax collected at entry: distilled spirits, wine or beer; tobacco products or cigarette papers or tubes; taxable fuel (gasoline, diesel fuel or kerosene, 26 U.S.C. 4081); alcohol beverages or tobacco products brought from Puerto Rico or the Virgin Islands; or none of these?

fee_aqi_treatment.description: Does the consignment require treatment on arrival, as a preassigned condition of entry or as a remedial measure ordered after APHIS or CBP inspection (7 CFR 354.3(h))?

fee_mpf_exemption.description: Does a 19 CFR 24.23(c) merchandise processing fee exemption apply: none; an article of HTSUS chapter 98 other than 9802.00.60 or 9802.00.80; an article of 9802.00.60 or 9802.00.80; a product of a U.S. insular possession, a CBERA beneficiary country or a least-developed beneficiary developing country; merchandise of General Note 19, released under 19 U.S.C. 1321 or imported by mail (other than formally entered Inbound EMS); USMCA-originating goods or products of Israel; or goods originating under the Singapore, Chile, Australia, Bahrain, CAFTA-DR, Oman, Peru, Korea, Colombia or Panama agreements?

fee_hmf_port.description: Is the cargo unloaded from the commercial vessel at a port listed in 19 CFR 24.24(b)(1) as subject to the harbor maintenance fee?

fee_hmf_exemption.description: Is the cargo exempt from the harbor maintenance fee under 19 CFR 24.24(c) (bunker fuel and ship's stores, fish not previously landed, ferry passengers and vehicles, listed Alaska, Hawaii and possession movements, vessels paying the Inland Waterway Fuel Tax, in-bond cargo for direct exportation, U.S. Government cargo, or certified humanitarian cargo)?

fee_fuel_bulk_transfer.description: Is the taxable fuel entered into the United States by bulk transfer (pipeline or vessel, 26 CFR 48.4081-1)?

fee_fuel_enterer_registrant.description: Is the enterer of the taxable fuel a taxable fuel registrant (registered under 26 U.S.C. 4101)?

p65_california_consumers.description: Will the imported product be sold or otherwise made available to consumers in California, so that individuals in California may be exposed to it (Cal. Health & Safety Code 25249.6)?

p65_business.description: Does the business responsible for the product employ 10 or more employees, fewer than 10 employees, or is it a city, county, district, the state, the federal government or one of their agencies, or an entity operating a public water system (Cal. Health & Safety Code 25249.11(b))?

p65_listed_chemical.description: Can the product expose individuals to a chemical on the Proposition 65 list of chemicals known to the state to cause cancer or reproductive toxicity (Cal. Health & Safety Code 25249.8): a listed carcinogen; a listed reproductive toxicant; both a listed carcinogen and a different listed reproductive toxicant; a chemical listed for both cancer and reproductive toxicity; or no listed chemical? The listing status is declared.

p65_exemption.description: Does a Health & Safety Code 25249.10 exemption apply to the exposure: none; the exposure takes place less than twelve months after the chemical was listed; the business can show the exposure poses no significant risk (carcinogens) and no observable effect at 1,000 times the level (reproductive toxicants); or federal law governs the warning in a manner that preempts state authority?

p65_product.description: Is the product a consumer product under the general safe-harbor warning methods and content (27 CCR 25602, 25603); a food or dietary supplement (27 CCR 25607.1, 25607.2); or a product or exposure for which another section of 27 CCR 25607 et seq. states its own warning method and content?

p65_sales_channel.description: Does the importer sell or transfer the product to another business (a distributor or retail seller) that sells it to consumers in California, or sell it directly to consumers itself, including over the internet or by catalog?

p65_written_agreement.description: Has the importer entered into a written agreement with the business it sells or transfers the product to that allocates legal responsibility for providing the warning between them (27 CCR 25600.2(i))?

abc_origin.description: Are the alcoholic beverages brought into California from outside the United States, or from another state?

abc_destination.description: Are the beverages brought into California for delivery or use within California (beverages consigned to a California destination are presumed to be, Cal. Business and Professions Code 23663), or only in transit through the state?

abc_exemption.description: Does an exception apply: none; a reasonable amount brought by an adult from outside the United States for personal or household use (23661(c)); a personal or household shipment by an adult member of the U.S. Armed Forces serving abroad (23661(e)); or a passenger carrier bringing beverages only for sale on board (23664)?

abc_carrier.description: Are the beverages brought into California by a common carrier?

abc_consignee.description: To whom are the beverages consigned in California: a licensed importer at its licensed premises; a licensed importer or customs broker at the premises of a licensed public warehouse; a licensed customs broker at its own premises; or another person?

abc_beverage.description: Are the beverages distilled spirits, wine or beer?

rule_ids.description: Omit to screen all catalog families. An empty array selects none and never means clearance. Duplicate identifiers are evaluated once in catalog order; unknown identifiers are rejected.

items.description: One U.S. state, as an ISO 3166-2 code.

destination_states.description: U.S. states the goods will be sold or distributed in. Each named state's requirements are returned in state_requirements; an unsupported code is rejected. Omit to assess no state; the federal results do not change either way.

200.description: Per-family outcomes; unavailable and outside_coverage never mean cleared.

inventory_program_id.description: Program-level discovery identifier, not an atomic obligation or proof of complete coverage.

requirement_types.description: Kinds of obligations evaluated within this bounded family, not proof of fulfillment.

items.description: One obligation kind in this family.

regulated_subject.description: Subject of the obligation; responsible_party separately names who must act.

exception_handling.description: Limits on exception evaluation, including acceptance of legal declarations without independent verification.

jurisdiction.description: Federal U.S. scope only; state and local requirements are not assessed by these families.

obligation_basis.description: Legal obligation if applicable, not a voluntary certification scheme.

implementation_coverage.description: This is a bounded part of the program, independent of whether its sources are available for the requested date.

product_fact_discovery_complete.description: Product-fact-only discovery is incomplete; some questions still require legal declarations.

supported_from.description: Inclusive start of reviewed snapshot coverage, not the legal effective date.

source_current_through.description: Inclusive end of reviewed source coverage, not a guarantee of source availability; inspect status.

source_currency_basis.description: Whether the supported date comes directly from eCFR or from verified intervening official Federal Register issues. Absent for a family whose text is the U.S. Code, which states statute_currency_basis instead.

statute_currency_basis.description: Present only for a family whose text is the U.S. Code: its supported date comes from a review of every law enacted since the annual edition it cites. Such a family has no source_currency_basis and no ecfr_current_through.

ecfr_current_through.description: eCFR date underlying the reviewed text; distinct from any later official-issue continuity date. Absent for a family whose text is the U.S. Code.

status.description: unavailable means the requested date or source verification does not support a determination; outside_coverage means the compilation pipeline holds no accepted source-backed adjudication for the branches named in undetermined_branches, so the reviewed text does not decide them here. Neither means not applicable or cleared. needs_information requests unanswered facts; legal declarations remain unverified.

actions.description: Actions or documents required by this bounded rule, not evidence they have been completed.

items.description: One action required under the cited rule.
One existing requirement question and its declaration boundaries.

fact.description: Stable accepted fact key shared by catalog and screening.

question.description: Question text for this fact; consult input_kind before treating it as a product-factual answer.

allowed_values.description: Accepted declared answers for this fact; omit an unknown answer.

input_kind.description: Distinguishes factual answers from customer-supplied legal conclusions and exception claims; no legal discovery is implied.

answer_provenance.description: Answers are customer declarations, not independently verified evidence.

unknown_answer.description: Omit an unknown answer. Never substitute a negative choice for unknown.

undetermined_branches.description: Branches this result does not decide, each naming the deciding fact and the governing provision. Present even alongside an identified requirement; an absent determination is never clearance.

items.description: One branch the reviewed source does not decide.

fact.description: The declared fact whose branch is undecided.

reason.description: Why the source does not decide this branch.

obligations.description: The distinct legal obligations bundled inside this family and whether each carries an accepted source-backed adjudication. One family verdict can cover several separately violable duties.

items.description: One distinct legal obligation inside this family.

adjudication.description: unadjudicated means no accepted source-backed adjudication exists for this obligation.

numerator.description: Obligations whose determination is complete. Null while the denominator is unknown.

denominator.description: Obligations adjudicated operative. Null while any enumerated obligation is unadjudicated.

unadjudicated_identities.description: Enumerated obligations with no accepted adjudication. Any non-zero value keeps the denominator unknown.

unknown_reason.description: Why the denominator cannot be counted, or null when it can.

caveats.description: Permanent limits of the obligation count; they do not become satisfied by any number reported here.

post.description: Stateless Streamable HTTP endpoint for search, lookup, calculation, historical replay, nomenclature concordance, monitored changes, and entry audit. Customer-owned tools require OAuth or an API key. When the Base Sepolia x402 rail is configured, accountless tariff tools may instead return an MCP-envelope payment challenge and accept payment at _meta["x402/payment"]. Tool calls with an API key inherit the key's plan limits and usage metering. The server uses @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.29 and negotiates the SDK's supported official MCP protocol versions, currently led by 2025-11-25. Its request-isolated architecture follows the July 28, 2026 stateless direction without claiming that date as a published protocol version. Optional X-Mcp-Client-Name and X-Mcp-Client-Version headers improve observable client attribution.

get.summary: Look up the current rate stack for an HTS code
get.description: Returns the HTS row, bounded CBP CROSS ruling evidence that cites it, and, when `country` is supplied, the per-country rate stack (base MFN + Section 122 + 232 + 301) with FR cites for every applied overlay. Use `as_of` to resolve the rate stack as it stood on a past date — useful for entry audits and refund work.

parameters.description: Opt-in compact projection; legacy is the unchanged default. Compact changes presentation only, not tariff calculation, screening or usage charging.

parameters.description: Compact-only comma-separated detail: predicates, calculation, evidence, legacy. predicates adds every resolved treatment with its condition tree and relationships, and which programs expose trees. Full legacy detail preserves the complete original response. include=compliance remains independent.

TariffCatalogResponse.description: A bounded Section 201, 232, 301, or 338 coverage page bound to a monotonic catalog revision.

snapshot.description: Compatibility field containing the monotonic catalog revision used to reject stale cursors; it is not an archived database copy.

action_status.description: Lifecycle state of the underlying legal action.

assessment_status.description: Whether the selected program rate is exact for this catalog row or still depends on entry facts.

section_301.description: Deprecated compatibility mirror returned only for Section 301 rows; use program. Never add this mirror to program as another duty.

known_ad_valorem_components.description: Ad valorem components that are numerically known from the catalog row. Null means unresolved, not zero.

known_ad_valorem_subtotal_pct.description: Sum of only the non-null known ad valorem components. This is a subtotal, never the complete entry duty rate.

complete_duty_total_pct.description: Always null for this catalog endpoint: it does not resolve all duty layers. Use a separate lookup or calculation with the necessary entry facts; adding facts to this catalog request does not produce a complete total.

generated_at.description: When this copy of the feed was built (UTC).

not_listed.description: Programs decided by rules this feed does not list, so their absence is not read as no change.

entries.description: Certified rule versions the API answers with, newest first by the latest retrieval of their sources.

id.description: Entry identifier, `<ruleset>@<version>`; a new version is a new entry.

ruleset.description: Identifier of the rule set, as in the `x-ustr-ruleset` response header.

version.description: Version of the rule set that is answering.

ruleset_hash.description: SHA-256 of the version, as in the `x-ustr-ruleset` response header.

program.description: Tariff program or requirement family the rules decide.

effective.description: Legal effective window of the rules (YYYY-MM-DD).

through.description: Last day the rules apply (YYYY-MM-DD); null when no end is stated.

certification.description: `release`: reviewed and reproduced before release. `source_change`: recompiled from a verified source change and validated against every source it depends on.

source_event.description: Identifier of the verified source change that produced a `source_change` version; null for a release version.

sources.description: Sources the version cites.

document.description: Source document identifier, such as `fr:2026-03824` for a Federal Register document.

url.description: Address the source was retrieved from.

retrieved_at.description: When the source bytes behind this version were retrieved.

federal_register.description: Federal Register citation, for Federal Register sources; null otherwise.

published_on.description: Publication date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the source address states it; null otherwise.

latest_federal_register_publication.description: Latest Federal Register publication date among the cited sources (YYYY-MM-DD); null when none states one.

latest_source_retrieval.description: Most recent retrieval of the source bytes behind this version; the feed is ordered by it, newest first.

ProvenanceEntry.description: Federal Register / Executive Order cite for an applied tariff overlay. `kind` identifies which overlay this provenance row applies to.

assessment.description: Present on a `section_232` layer that is a Section 232 specific duty (an amount per unit of quantity, U.S. note 42(a)) stacking on the ad valorem `section_232` layer. On a rate-only surface it is always `needs_facts`, because it is sized from the entry's quantity; `heading`, `rate_usd_per_unit`, `unit`, `specific_basis` and `missing_facts` state its basis.

heading.description: With `assessment: specific_per_unit`: the chapter 99 heading the specific duty is assessed under.

unit.description: With `assessment: specific_per_unit`: the unit the amount is stated per.

specific_basis.description: With `assessment: specific_per_unit`: how the specific duty is sized; null while the documentation that decides it is undeclared.

missing_facts.description: With `assessment: specific_per_unit`: the facts or inputs the specific duty still needs.

status.description: Present when a layer could not be reduced to a percentage. `needs_facts` entries carry `rate_pct: null` and are excluded from totals.

target_rate_pct.description: For a `needs_facts` measure assessed on top of the standard rate: the combined rate the measure brings the line to. The add-on is that target minus the resolved standard rate.

OrdinaryRate.description: On `base_mfn`, present only when the ordinary duty is not the column 1 rate: goods of a country HTSUS general note 3(b) lists (Belarus, Cuba, North Korea, Russia) take the column 2 rate, or for enumerated subheadings of the Russian Federation the U.S. note 30 rate under heading 9903.90.08 (35%) or 9903.90.09 (70%) in lieu of column 2, and no Special-column rate. `unresolved` means no rate could be decided (no published column 2 rate, a classification shorter than eight digits, or an entry date outside the reviewed coverage); the base duty is then excluded from totals and named in `unresolved_facts` as `ordinary_rate_column`.

column.description: The rate-of-duty column the goods take: column_2, or null when no column could be decided.

status.description: selected: the ordinary duty is calculated on `expression`. unresolved: no rate could be decided and the base duty is excluded from totals.

heading.description: The Chapter 99 heading whose rate applies in lieu of column 2.

rate_pct.description: The U.S. note 30 ad valorem rate in lieu of column 2; null when the line's own column 2 rate applies.

expression.description: The rate text the ordinary duty is calculated on.

column_2_expression.description: The line's own column 2 text, as published.

effective_from.description: The date from which the authority applies this column or rate to the origin (YYYY-MM-DD).

authority.description: The legal authority for the column or rate: general note 3(b), Pub. L. 117-110 or the proclamation and U.S. note 30.

source_url.description: The pinned source the column or rate is read from.

detail.description: Why this column or rate applies, or why it could not be decided.

SpecialHeading.description: Returned when the requested code is a Chapter 98 or 99 heading. These are provisions claimed against a Chapter 1 to 97 classification, not classifications of their own, so no rate stack is produced for them.

reference.example: U.S. note 33(e) to subchapter III of Chapter 99

Section301EntryOption.description: Source-backed Section 301 entry treatment. Heading 9903.88.69 covers the 29 reviewed exact statistical-code exclusions and 137 product descriptions in note 20(vvv); 9903.88.70 covers the 14 solar-machinery descriptions in note 20(www). Both require China origin, a declared claim and September 2–8, 2026 source coverage. Description clauses require chapter99.exclusion with a selected clause and each required product attribute. Parent codes, unreviewed descriptions and other dates are not inferred. Applied affects only the named list, not unrelated additional duties or fees. The forced-labor exception headings of U.S. note 52 are decided against the list the note gives for each heading: 9903.05.86 and 9903.05.96–9903.05.99, 9903.06.02, 9903.06.04, 9903.06.07, 9903.06.10, 9903.06.12, 9903.06.14, 9903.06.16, 9903.06.18 and 9903.06.20 apply when the merchandise and origin are on that list. The particular-article headings (9903.05.87, 9903.06.01, 9903.06.03, 9903.06.05, 9903.06.08, 9903.06.11, 9903.06.13, 9903.06.15, 9903.06.17, 9903.06.19, 9903.06.21), 9903.05.89 (pharmaceutical use) and 9903.06.06/9903.06.09 (DR-CAFTA claim) are needs_facts when the subheading is listed, because the description, use or agreement claim is not assessed; the duty stays charged. 9903.05.85 (in transit) is rejected for entries outside July 24–27, 2026. 9903.05.91–9903.05.95 are needs_facts with a named coverage gap once origin scope is met. A heading whose list does not cover the merchandise or origin is rejected. The Brazil digital-trade action (heading 9903.05.01, U.S. note 50) is decided the same way: 9903.05.03 applies on its list; 9903.05.04 (particular articles) and 9903.05.06 (pharmaceutical use) are needs_facts on a listed line; 9903.05.05 needs general_note_6_eligible; 9903.05.07 follows a declared note 50(a)(vi) Section 232 heading; 9903.05.02 is rejected outside July 22–28, 2026; 9903.05.08–9903.05.09 are needs_facts with a named coverage gap.

ImportCompliance.description: Optional current catalog screening, not a scope ruling or complete certification clearance.

EntryDecision.description: Entry eligibility is separate from arithmetic completeness. Totals reflect selected treatments, not customs clearance.

EntryCondition.description: One eligibility predicate; compare the declared fact using the operator and typed condition value.

value.description: Required predicate operand in the fact's own type and units, which may be boolean, text, number or a set. This is not a customs value in USD.

Section301Contract.description: Canonical origin-scoped Section 301 resolution. The nested section_301_china value is a deprecated China-only compatibility mirror; clients should use total_rate_pct and actions.

canonical.description: True only when normalized Section 301 data resolved successfully.

chapter99_headings.description: Source-supported ordinary headings; multiple headings require the applicable net-of-MFN treatment choice.

exemption_heading.description: The exemption heading applied to this action, when resolved: a declared entry exemption, or the U.S. note 52 heading of the forced-labor exemption list the merchandise is on.

rate_pct.description: Null when a `net_of_mfn` action cannot be assessed because the standard rate is not a single percentage (`status: needs_facts`).

effective_periods.description: Action, HTS-coverage, and exclusion periods are separate and must not be conflated.

status.description: `compatibility_only` when the mirror is still emitted; `omitted` when the caller sent `compat=none`.

LookupDecisionSummary.description: Additive decision summary separating returned-component arithmetic, evidence coverage, code matching and actual AD/CVD catalog screening. It is not an entry-liability determination.

calculation.description: Meaning of the existing calculation status.

status.description: Existing calculation status, unchanged.

scope.description: Only the returned calculation components are assessed.

coverage.description: Evidence coverage, independent of arithmetic completeness.

status.description: Existing assurance coverage status.

missing_layers.description: Layers whose required evidence remains incomplete.

known_ad_valorem_subtotal_pct.description: Sum of applied returned ad valorem components, not complete entry liability. Zero remains a computed zero subtotal.

complete_entry_total_pct.description: Always null: this lookup does not establish complete entry liability.

total_scope.description: Explains that absent evidence is not zero duty.

classification.description: Code matching is not verification of merchandise classification.

adcvd.description: Reports whether catalog screening actually ran; never implies scope or rate clearance.

screening_status.description: not_performed when screening was not requested; otherwise the actual catalog screening status, including unavailable.

screening_scope.description: Current catalog only when performed; null when not requested.

final_liability.description: not_determined; catalog screening cannot establish final liability.

scope_screen.description: Present when an order of the origin has a CBP scope HTS list reaching this line (directly, across an HTS revision's Change Record, or in the same eight-digit rate line). Each such order is decided by its written-scope ruleset with the supplied adcvd_facts; an unsupplied fact is unknown, never false. Orders that do not list the line are not thereby excluded, so this never makes AD/CVD complete.

status.description: unavailable when the written-scope rulesets could not be loaded; nothing is decided.

basis.description: cbp_scope_hts_listing: orders are screened when their CBP scope HTS list reaches the line.

all_candidates_decided.description: True only when every listed order is applicable or not_applicable.

status.description: The order's written scope for the supplied product, in the terms POST /v1/adcvd/resolve uses. applicable: the written scope applies to the product. not_applicable: the product is outside the order's written scope. needs_facts: missing_facts names the product facts the scope asks for next. scope_not_yet_screened: we have not yet screened this order's written scope, so nothing is decided about the product (never not_applicable); review the order's scope. undetermined: the written scope could not be decided for this entry (see reason).

reason.description: The reason code POST /v1/adcvd/resolve gives for the same decision, for example reviewed_scope_applicable (applicable), outside_reviewed_written_scope or reviewed_exclusion (not_applicable), scope_facts_required (needs_facts). Null when the order is scope_not_yet_screened.

missing_facts.description: adcvd_facts the written scope asks for next.

ruleset.description: The written-scope ruleset that answered, id@version.

basis.description: listed: within a stated provision; listed_successor: a revision transferred a stated line's goods to this line; listed_predecessor: this line, before a revision deleted it, had goods transferred to a stated line; same_8_digit: a stated line shares this eight-digit rate line.

matched_provisions.description: The stated provisions that reach the line, as the source writes them.

release.description: HTS release whose Change Record states the transfer.

effective_from.description: Date the transfer takes effect (YYYY-MM-DD).

revision.description: For a revision basis: the HTS release, the deleted line and its effective date; otherwise null.

hts_listing.description: Why the order is screened: how its CBP scope HTS list reaches the line. It never places merchandise in scope.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source bytes read.

locator.description: Where in the source the evidence is.

sources.description: The CBP message stating the order's HTS list, then the written-scope evidence.

orders.description: The listed orders, by case number, each decided by its written scope.

orders_without_hts_statement.description: The origin's orders whose CBP history states no HTS list: not screened either way.

CompactLookupResponse.description: Compact projection of one already calculated lookup. Errors and countryless lookups keep their original contract. No recalculation or extra credit.

computed_subtotal.description: Unchanged legacy total_estimated, scoped to returned components; not complete entry liability.

subtotal_scope.description: Subtotal scope, independent of evidence coverage.

components.description: Original rate stack with detailed base calculation omitted; rates, nulls, zeros and unresolved statuses preserved.

items.description: One unchanged duty component, without repeated calculation detail.

claims.description: Declared claim outcomes and missing facts, tagged with program. Applied Section 301 predicate enumerations are available via detail=predicates.

items.description: One declared claim outcome with program identity and any unresolved required facts.

section_232.description: Additive. The Section 232 heading the line is entered under, the facts assumed to reach it, and each alternative treatment one more declared fact would reach. Omitted when the line has no Section 232 resolution. The complete resolution is available via detail=predicates.

alternatives.description: The reachable measures, once each: heading, rate, treatment and the conditions (required_facts) that reach it.

items.description: One alternative Section 232 treatment and the declared facts that would reach it.

heading.description: Chapter 99 heading the entry would be made under.

title.description: The measure as its source states it.

rate_pct.description: Section 232 rate on full customs value under this alternative; 0 for an excluded treatment.

treatment_type.description: How the alternative is assessed (for example full_value_rate or excluded).

required_facts.description: The conditions that reach this alternative.

missing_facts.description: Declarable facts not yet supplied.

data.description: Original data version, update and verification times, source edition and hash.

compliance.description: Unchanged actual screening result only when include=compliance was requested.

decision_summary.description: Additive decision summary, when available on the deployed service.

predicates.description: Optional complete Section 232 resolution and Section 301 entry predicates, unchanged, plus every treatment the engine resolved for the line with its condition tree and relationships.

section_301.description: The Section 301 entry options and claims, unchanged.

treatments.description: Every treatment and exemption the engine resolved for the programs listed as exposed in treatment_coverage. Alternatives share a group_id and at most one of a group is owed; never sum them. The engine never selects the lowest-cost path.

treatment_coverage.description: One row per program of the rate stack: whether its treatments and condition trees are exposed. Programs without trees are listed as outside_supported_scope, never omitted.

legacy.description: Complete unchanged default response, included only with detail=legacy.

ProgramTreatment.description: One treatment or exemption the engine resolved for the line (USTR-1820), generated from engine output only.

id.description: Stable treatment id for the same line, date and program data.

program.description: The program, for example section_232 or section_301.

heading.description: The Chapter 99 heading the entry is made under for this treatment, where one is stated.

effect.description: relief takes the duty of applies_to away under its heading; duty imposes one.

applies_to.description: The rate-stack component the treatment changes. A relief never reaches past it: the entry is not exempt.

rate.description: The rate expression the treatment states, as the engine reads it.

basis.description: How the rate is assessed.

rate_pct.description: Rate on the value it is assessed on; null where it is not a single percentage or is not yet known.

target_rate_pct.description: combined_to_target: the combined rate the duty tops the line up to.

portion.description: content_value: the slice of value the rate is assessed on.

per_unit.description: specific: the unit the amount is stated per.

sizing.description: specific: how the amount is sized against the entry.

provision.description: The provision, annex or heading the treatment is stated in.

effective.description: The treatment's effective window, where established; an open end is null.

status.description: applies: its conditions hold on the declared facts. unresolved: it turns on a fact nobody declared. displaced: a treatment that applies exempts the entry from it.

selected.description: The engine's own answer on the declared facts, by legal precedence, never by lowest cost.

relationship.description: alternative: one of group_id, of which at most one is owed. additive: owed beside the other components and groups. replaces: when it applies, the treatments in replaces are not owed.

replaces.description: Treatment ids not owed when this one applies.

conditions.description: The conditions as the engine read them; null where the program states none for the treatment.

missing_facts.description: Declarable facts the unknown leaves wait on.

TreatmentConditionNode.description: A condition tree node with the engine's three-valued state. unknown means a fact nobody supplied; evidence_unavailable and outside_supported_scope are never folded into unknown.

node.description: all-of, any-of, negation, or a comparison leaf.

state.description: The node's state on the declared facts.

items.description: A child node of the same shape (node, state and, for a leaf, its comparison).

children.description: all, any and not nodes: the child nodes, combined on the engine's three-valued logic.

fact.description: Leaf: the canonical fact key.

value.description: Leaf: the stated value or threshold (a list for in and not_in).

inclusive.description: Leaf threshold: true when the threshold itself satisfies it (lte, gte), false when strict (lt, gt); null otherwise.

unit.description: Leaf: the unit of a numeric value where the fact registry states one (fraction, usd, calendar_year, years).

declarable_facts.description: Leaf: the facts a caller declares to decide it.

absent_reading.description: Leaf: how the ruleset reads the fact while it is missing; the leaf itself stays unknown.

ProgramTreatmentCoverage.description: Whether one program of the rate stack exposes its treatments with condition trees.

program.description: The program, as the rate stack names it.

condition_trees.description: exposed: the program's treatments are listed with condition trees. evidence_unavailable: its source could not be read for this answer. outside_supported_scope: no condition trees are generated for it.

entry_claim_decisions.description: Present with `entry_calculation`: each folded claim's decision (status `applied`).

entry_calculation.description: The same folded calculation /v1/calculate returns for this line (its `entry_treatment`, totals and `calculation_status`): present when a claimed Chapter 98 treatment or 9904 safeguard is finished and folds into the entry total (ruleset entry-total.assembly). Sent only when `value` is.

last_verified_at.description: When the data was last verified against the official USITC source. Unlike data_updated_at, this advances even on days when the source is checked and found unchanged.

source_hash.description: Hash of the verified official USITC source artifact.

description.example: Portable automatic data processing machines, weighing not more than 10 kg...

hierarchy.example: Machinery > Automatic data processing machines > Portable machines
hierarchy.description: Source schedule hierarchy for the matched classification. Use this context when the matched row description is generic, such as `Other`.

ancestors.description: Ordered hierarchy segments from the schedule, exposed as a convenience for clients that should not parse the display string.

calculation_status.description: `not_a_classification` is returned for Chapter 98 and 99 headings; see `heading`. `incomplete_requires_facts` means a dependent measure could not be reduced to a percentage, or a component's treatment is not established for the entry date (for example IEEPA); see `unresolved_facts`. `total_estimated` then covers the known components only, and a component without an established rate is not zero.

total_estimated.description: Deterministic rate stack only; fact-dependent AD/CVD, quota/TRQ, exclusions, and special programs are reported in risk_layers. Null for Chapter 98 and 99 headings.

classification.description: Official statistical reporting units of the matched line. Not returned by /v1/replay.

rulings.description: Up to five CBP CROSS rulings that cite the matched HTS code, with corpus coverage. Classification evidence only: a ruling binds only its own merchandise and party, and none_listed does not establish that it remains in force. unavailable is not a no-match result.

status.description: Whether the rulings corpus could be read. unavailable does not mean no matching rulings exist.

query_hts.description: Matched HTS code used to search cited-code evidence, digits only.

total.description: Held rulings that cite the code; null when evidence is unavailable.

returned.description: Rulings included in this bounded lookup response.

items.description: Newest held rulings that cite the matched HTS code.
One CBP ruling with cited codes and later-ruling relations.

coverage.description: The CROSS corpus basis, freshness and publisher census at lookup time.

status_note.description: How to interpret ruling relations and unavailable evidence.

section_301.description: When 9903.88.69 or 9903.88.70 is claimed, retain the full Section 301 action and product-scope evidence for both replay dates. Historical archive coverage is reported separately.

change.description: Typed difference between the historical and current snapshots.

coverage.description: Historical archive coverage for the requested replay.

HtsReportingUnits.description: Official statistical reporting units for the line, in the order the current USITC schedule states them (first, second, third), or as the statistical note or footnote that governs the line states them when its own unit column is empty. These are the quantities reported for statistics on the entry, separate from the unit a specific or compound duty rate is computed on. No unit conversion is applied.

hts.description: The schedule line these units belong to.

schedule_edition.description: Schedule edition the units were read from; null when it cannot be attributed.

items.description: One official unit code, exactly as the schedule states it.

reporting_units.description: Ordered official unit codes; empty unless `reporting_units_status` is `available`.

reporting_units_status.description: `available`: units are listed, as the line states them or, for a ten-digit number a statistical note defines that the schedule does not list as a line (chapter 91 statistical note 1), as the note prints them for its suffix; `reporting_units_source` then cites the note. `no_reporting_unit`: no quantity is reported, because the schedule's unit column reads X or a statistical note says no statistical data are furnished for the line (chapter 98 statistical note 1). `statistical_suffix_required`: the line is reported under ten-digit statistical suffixes, listed in `statistical_suffixes` with their units (the suffixes below it in the schedule, or those a chapter statistical note prints for it, such as chapter 91 statistical note 1). `companion_provision_units`: a statistical note or footnote directs that the quantity be reported in the unit of the chapters 1-97 provision that would otherwise apply, so this line names no unit itself (chapters 98 and 99). `data_unavailable`: see `reporting_units_reason`. An empty list never means the line has no unit.

reporting_units_source.description: The statistical note or footnote the status rests on, when the units are not stated in the line's own unit column; null otherwise.

authority.example: HTSUS chapter 98 subchapter XVII statistical note 1(b)

source_url.description: The USITC publication it is printed in.

text.description: The sentence of the note or footnote that states the rule, verbatim.
text.example: The quantities reported should be in the units provided in chapters 1-97.

reporting_units_reason.description: Why the units are `data_unavailable`; null for every other status. `not_in_schedule`: the line is not in the current schedule. `edition_unattributed`: the schedule edition cannot be attributed. `unit_not_stated`: the line's unit column is empty and no statistical note or footnote states its units. `conflicting_notes`: the notes that govern the line state different rules.

statistical_suffixes.description: The ten-digit statistical reporting numbers the line is reported under, with their units; empty unless `reporting_units_status` is `statistical_suffix_required` for an eight-digit line.

items.description: One statistical reporting number of the line and its units.
One official unit code, exactly as the schedule or note states it.

reporting_units_status.description: The status of its own units, as for the line.

HTSMatch.description: How the requested code was resolved. `confidence` is a deterministic resolution-quality heuristic (1.0 exact, 0.9 prefix, 0.6 truncated_prefix, 0.4 parent), not a statistical probability.

SearchRelevance.description: Ranking metadata for a search result. `fts_bm25` results are ranked by SQLite FTS5 BM25 (`bm25_score`, lower is more relevant); `code_match` results come from direct/prefix code resolution and carry a match block instead of a BM25 score.

match.description: Present for code-style queries resolved against the schedule; null for text-query candidates, which carry `relevance` ranking instead.

calculation_status.description: Present when `country` is supplied. `not_a_classification` is returned for Chapter 98 and 99 headings; see `heading`. `incomplete_requires_facts` means a dependent measure could not be reduced to a percentage, or a component's treatment is not established for the entry date (for example IEEPA); see `unresolved_facts`. `total_estimated` then covers the known components only, and a component without an established rate is not zero.

last_verified_at.description: When the data was last verified against the official USITC source. Unlike data_updated_at, this advances even on days when the source is checked and found unchanged.

EntryQuantity.description: A quantity of the entry line, as /v1/calculate and /v1/audit/entry accept it: the TariffQuantity units, and rated power in `watt` or `kilowatt`, the quantity the Section 232 polysilicon minimum import prices for solar cells and modules are stated per (Proclamation 11052, Annex I).

ImportProhibition.description: The goods are excluded from importation into the United States. No duty or landed total is calculated for goods that cannot be entered.

status.description: Always `prohibited`: the goods may not be imported.

program.description: Legal program imposing the exclusion: section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930.

proclamation.description: Presidential proclamation number that excludes the goods.

annex_line.description: HTS provision listed in Annex I to the proclamation that covers the goods.

scope_limitation.description: `packaged` when the annex line covers only alcohol products in bottles, cans, boxes, kegs or other similar direct-to-consumption containers; otherwise null.

effective_at.description: Goods imported at or after this time are excluded.

importation_time.description: Declared date and time of importation used for the decision.

authority.description: Federal Register publication of the proclamation.

fr_citation.description: Federal Register volume and page citation.

url.description: Official PDF of the published proclamation.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the official PDF from which the annex was read.

detail.description: Plain-language explanation of the exclusion and its authority.

PreferenceDeclaration.description: The importer's declaration of a special tariff treatment claim under a program the HTS "Special" subcolumn lists (general note 3(c)(i)). The preferential rate applies only when the entry declares the claim, that the goods qualify under the program's rules and that the claim's evidence is on file; the answer is then based on the importer's declaration, not a verified origin determination. Declare `claimed: false` alone to calculate at the General rate.

claimed.description: Required. The entry claims special tariff treatment. False declares no claim; nothing else may then be declared.

program.description: The program symbol as the Special subcolumn prints it, for example KR, S, S+, P or AU.

heading.description: The Chapter 98 subchapter XXII or XXIII, or Chapter 99, subheading the entry is claimed under, for example 9823.01.02 or 9919.04.51, when the Special subcolumn refers the program to such subheadings ("See 9823.01.01-9823.01.07 (S+)", "See 9919.04.50, 9919.04.51, 9919.04.61 (PA)") that state different rates for the line: an in-quota and an over-quota subheading, or subheadings for different articles. Not needed when every referenced subheading states the same rate.

origin_qualified.description: The goods qualify as originating under the program's rules of origin.

evidence_on_file.description: The certification or other evidence the claim requires is in the importer's possession.

quota_available.description: Whether quota is available for the claim. Required as true for a Chapter 98 or 99 subheading whose U.S. note quantitative limitation applies on the entry date; false means the preferential rate of that subheading does not apply.

wholly_obtained_from_canadian_sugar_beet.description: Required for a 9823.09.02 claim: the goods are wholly obtained from sugar beets produced in Canada under U.S. note 9(b)(1). An importer declaration, not verified origin. A false declaration does not select an alternative heading.

PreferenceAnswer.description: Special tariff treatment for the line, decided on the HTS general notes (edition and citation in `citation`). Present when the Special subcolumn lists a program whose general note names the origin, or when the entry declares `facts.preference`. `applied`: the preferential rate replaced the General rate in the base duty, on the importer's declaration. `needs_facts`: `missing_facts` names what to declare under `facts.preference`; the total is withheld. `coverage_gap`: the claimed program or its referenced Chapter 98/99 provision is not yet covered; the total is withheld. When the Special subcolumn refers the program to a Chapter 99 subheading of subchapters XVIII (Colombia), XIX (Panama) or XXI (Japan), or to an Australia tariff-rate-quota subheading of Chapter 98 subchapter XXII (9822.04), or to a USMCA subheading of Chapter 98 subchapter XXIII note 1 (9823.01, fluid cream, sour cream, ice cream and milk beverages; the origin selects the note's Mexico or Canada subheadings), that subheading's rate is the preferential rate and `provision` names it. `not_claimed`, `not_qualified`, `not_available`, `not_in_force`: the General rate applies. `none_listed`: the Special subcolumn lists no program for this origin.

status.description: The special tariff treatment decision for the line; see the object description.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason for the status, for example program_not_listed_for_line, origin_not_named_by_general_note, excluded_by_general_note, general_note_exclusion_undetermined, program_not_in_force, program_ended, program_not_modeled, referenced_provision_not_modeled, referenced_heading_unreadable, referenced_provision_ended, referenced_rate_conflict, referenced_provision_conflict, referenced_provision_condition_not_modeled, line_not_in_referenced_provision, declared_heading_not_referenced or preference_heading_undeclared. Null when applied or not claimed.

program.description: The declared program, as general note 3(c)(i) names it. Null until a known program is declared.

symbol.description: Program symbol as the Special subcolumn prints it.

name.description: Program name as general note 3(c)(i) lists it.

general_note.description: The HTS general note governing the program.

rate_expression.description: The Special subcolumn rate text for the program.

basis.description: importer_declaration when the preferential rate was applied: it rests on the importer's declaration, not a verified origin determination.

candidates.description: Programs the Special subcolumn lists whose general note names this origin.

symbol.description: Program symbol as the Special subcolumn prints it.

name.description: Program name as general note 3(c)(i) lists it.

general_note.description: The HTS general note governing the program.

rate_expression.description: The Special subcolumn rate text for the program on this line.

reference.description: True when the Special subcolumn refers to a Chapter 98 or 99 provision for this program instead of stating a rate.

items.description: A program symbol the Special subcolumn lists whose eligibility is not yet modelled.

unmodeled_symbols.description: Listed programs whose eligibility is not yet modelled.

citation.description: The general note the decision rests on. Null until a known program is declared.

provision.description: Provision key in the preference ruleset, for example gn33.

source_url.description: USITC HTS General Notes file for the edition.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the reviewed General Notes file.

quote.description: Verbatim sentence of the general note the decision rests on.

provision.description: The Chapter 98 or 99 subheading whose rate replaced the Chapter 1-97 rate, when the program's rate is stated by one. Null when the Special subcolumn states the rate itself, or when several referenced subheadings state the same rate.

heading.description: The Chapter 98 or 99 subheading, for example 9823.04.02 or 9919.04.51.

rate_expression.description: Its rate, without the program symbol.

subchapter.description: The Chapter 98 or 99 subchapter, for example XIX.

description.description: The subheading's article description, as printed.

through.description: The U.S. notes delete the subheading at the close of this date; null when they set no end.

quota.description: The U.S. note whose quantitative limitation applies on the entry date. Null when none applies.

ceases_from.description: The first date the limitation no longer applies.

year.description: For a quota the note sets by agreement year (Chapter 98 XXIII: "Year 1" is July 1 to December 31, 2020, each later year a calendar year), the year in force on the entry date, for example 7, or 19+ for the quantity that applies from year 19 on.

quantity.description: The quantity the note prints for that year, as printed.

unit.description: The unit of that quantity, for example liters.

citation.description: The Chapter 99 release in force on the entry date and the subheading as printed.

provision.description: Provision key in the preference ruleset, for example ch99_xix.

source_url.description: USITC HTS Chapter 99 file for the release.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of that file.

quote.description: The subheading, its description and rate as printed.

provision_candidates.description: The referenced Chapter 98 or 99 subheadings in force for this line and entry date.

items.description: One referenced Chapter 98 or 99 subheading and its rate.

heading.description: The Chapter 98 or 99 subheading.

quota_note.description: The U.S. note whose quantitative limitation applies to it on the entry date, or null.

items.description: A fact to declare, as a path under facts.

missing_facts.description: Facts to declare, as paths under facts, for example preference.claimed or preference.heading.

code.description: Fact family, for example `quantity`, `alcohol_content`, `product_content`, `quota_status`, `ad_cvd_scope`, `base_rate` (a measure assessed on top of the standard rate could not be reduced to a percentage), `importation_time` / `direct_to_consumption_container` (the Section 338 Canadian import exclusion depends on when or how the goods were imported), or a U.S. note 51 fact the Canadian Section 338 duty depends on: `general_note_6_eligible` (civil aircraft, note 51(d)), `section_232_heading` (the dairy carve-out in note 51(c) turns on the Section 232 heading), `us_content_approved`, `usmca_parts_qualification` or `import_adjustment_offset` (note 51(c) conditions).

Chapter98Declaration.description: Structured Chapter 98 entry facts, component declarations and documentary references. No generic eligible flag is accepted; references are not independently verified. Requires a Chapter 98 claim.

statistical_quantities.description: Optional declared quantities using exact official merchandise unit labels, including units outside the duty calculator unit vocabulary. Cannot override the source-listed required units.

items.description: One exact statistical unit label and its declared amount.

unit.description: Exact official merchandise unit label; not a choice of which units are legally required.

amount.description: Positive finite quantity in the exact source-listed unit.

valuation.description: Declared Chapter 98 values. References and amounts are not CBP verification; omitted values remain unknown, not zero.

foreign_change_value_usd.description: Foreign repair, alteration or processing value in USD. For 9802.00.40/.50 this optional aggregate must equal the source-owned repair components.

foreign_repair_labor_and_operations_usd.description: Foreign labor and operations cost or value under 19 CFR 10.8(d), including no-charge work at declared value.

vessel_foreign_cost_usd.description: Foreign vessel repair expenditure in USD for Chapter 98 vessel-repair assessment.

articles_furnished_for_repair_value_usd.description: Value of all domestic and foreign articles furnished for the foreign repair or alteration under 19 CFR 10.8(d).

us_incurred_engineering_plans_tools_usd.description: U.S.-incurred engineering, plans, tools, or equipment cost reported for review but excluded from the 19 CFR 10.8(d) repair basis.

foreign_processing_labor_and_operations_.description: Cost or value of further processing actually performed abroad under 19 CFR 10.9, including no-charge processing at declared value.

articles_used_in_foreign_processing_valu.description: Value of all domestic and foreign articles used in the foreign processing under 19 CFR 10.9.

us_incurred_processing_support_costs_usd.description: U.S.-incurred engineering, plans, specifications, tools, equipment, or similar support costs reported for review but excluded from the 19 CFR 10.9 processing basis.

like_article_duty_usd.description: Duty on a like article not previously exported, used only for the 9801.00.70/.80 statutory cap.

like_article_internal_revenue_tax_usd.description: Internal-revenue tax on a like article not previously exported at entry.

drawback_allowed_usd.description: Customs drawback proven allowed on exportation of the returned article.

duty_on_9813_components_usd.description: Duty that would have applied to articles used in aircraft manufacture or production but for 9813.00.05.

estimated_drawback_and_tax_usd.description: Note 2(a) estimate used only when actual Customs records are impracticable to establish.

facts.description: Claim-specific factual conditions. Only relevant conditions are evaluated; unknown is not eligibility.

actual_use_import_date.description: Date of importation (YYYY-MM-DD); the request as_of date is the consumption entry or withdrawal date. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_review_date.description: Date on which the actual-use lifecycle is assessed (YYYY-MM-DD); defaults to the consumption date, not the current clock. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_intended_at_importation.description: The specific use stated by the claimed heading was intended at importation. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_declaration_filed.description: Written declaration of intended use was filed with entry under 19 CFR 10.134; merely claiming a heading does not establish this fact. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_completed.description: The specific statutory use has actually occurred in the United States. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_date.description: Date the specific statutory use actually occurred (YYYY-MM-DD). Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_proof_submitted_date.description: Date proof of actual use was furnished to Customs (YYYY-MM-DD), not the date a document reference was uploaded here. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_certificate_signer.description: Certificate signer: plant_manager, plant_superintendent, end_user or knowledgeable_person. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_certificate_scope.description: Certificate scope: individual or blanket. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_certificate_details.description: Certificate describes processing in sufficient detail to establish the statutory use. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_certificate_duplicate.description: Certificate was submitted in duplicate. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_blanket_entry_linkage.description: Importer supplied the detailed statement identifying blanket-certificate merchandise with each entry. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_detailed_records.description: Importer maintains accurate and detailed use or disposition records. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_records_inspectable.description: Use or disposition records are available for Customs examination and inspection. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_liquidation_date.description: Declared date of liquidation (YYYY-MM-DD); not verified Customs acceptance. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_net_or_part.description: Article is a net or a section or part of a net. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_monofilament_gill_net.description: Article is a monofilament gill net for the claimed fish-sampling use. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_fish_sampling.description: The claimed specific use is fish sampling. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_wild_birds.description: The claimed specific use is taking wild birds. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

actual_use_bird_license.description: Taking wild birds is under a license issued by the appropriate Federal or State governmental authority. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_methanol.description: Article is methanol (methyl alcohol). Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_methanol_natural_gas.description: Methanol was produced from natural gas. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_methanol_aboard_vessel.description: Methanol production occurred aboard a vessel. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_methanol_water_location.description: Location of vessel during production: high_seas, foreign_waters or us_waters (U.S. waters do not qualify). Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_needlecraft_display_model.description: Article is a needle-craft display model. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_primarily_hand_stitched.description: The display model is primarily hand stitched. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_completed_mass_produced_kit.description: The model is of a completed mass-produced kit. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_kit_exclusive_us_kit_form.description: The mass-produced kit is designed to be sold in the customs territory of the United States exclusively in kit form. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_ski_racing_apparel.description: Article is apparel for the sport of ski racing. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_ski_injury_protection_design.description: Padding, construction or other special features are specially designed to protect against ski-racing injuries, such as slalom-gate blows or falls. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_medical_footwear.description: Article is footwear of a kind supporting or holding the foot following illness, operation or injury. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_footwear_made_to_measure.description: Footwear is made to measure, not merely available in standard sizes. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_footwear_presented_singly.description: Footwear is presented singly and not in pairs. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_footwear_fits_either_foot.description: The single footwear article is designed to fit either foot equally. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_polycrystalline_diamond.description: The blank is of polycrystalline diamond. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_mounted_blank.description: Article is a mounted blank, not a completed tool or an unmounted diamond blank. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_blank_kind.description: Blank kind: tool or drill_bit. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_wheel_machine_kind.description: Article is a wheelbuilding, wheel-trueing, rimpunching, tire-fitting or similar machine. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

product_bicycle_wheel_suitability.description: Machine is suitable for manufacturing wheels for bicycles. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

holiday_utilitarian_article.description: The article has a utilitarian function, rather than being solely decorative. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

holiday_home_ritual_use.description: Article is of a kind used in the home to perform a specific religious or cultural ritual celebration. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

holiday_religious_or_cultural_occasion.description: That ritual celebrates a religious or cultural holiday or religious festive occasion. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

holiday_three_dimensional_symbol.description: The utilitarian article itself is in the form of a three-dimensional representation of a symbol or motif; a printed holiday design alone does not satisfy this. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

holiday_specific_us_holiday_association.description: The represented symbol or motif is clearly associated with a specific holiday in the United States. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

exhibition_importer.description: Importer: institution, society, state, municipal_corporation, or other. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

exhibition_institution_purpose.description: Institution or society established to encourage agriculture, arts, education, science, or other. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

exhibition_commercial_connection.description: Institution or society engaged in or connected with private or commercial business. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

exhibition_use.description: Intended use: exhibition, public_monument, or other. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

exhibition_intended_sale.description: Articles intended, offered or exposed for sale. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

exhibition_entry_event.description: Event: initial_entry, amendment, transfer, diversion, export, or destruction; later events require separate review. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

exhibition_released_from_customs.description: Articles have already been released from Customs custody. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

exhibition_officer_declaration_filed.description: Qualified officer declaration or electronic equivalent filed with sufficient detail to demonstrate the claimed entry. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

exhibition_form301_bond_filed.description: Customs Form 301 bond filed before release, containing 19 CFR 113.62 conditions and securing five-year duties under subchapter XII note 2. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

exhibition_cbp_document_request.description: CBP demanded a charter, original order or other proof; response and six-month deadline require review. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

edu_material_beirut_federal_determinatio.description: A Federal agency designated by the President has determined this article is visual or auditory material of an educational, scientific or cultural character within the Beirut Agreement (subchapter XVII U.S. note 1(a)(i)); applies only to heading 9817.00.40. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

edu_material_approved_institution_use.description: The article is imported by, or certified by the importer to be for the use of, a public or private institution or association approved as educational, scientific or cultural by a Federal agency designated by the President for duty-free admission under the Nairobi Protocol to the Florence Agreement (subchapter XVII U.S. note 1(a)(ii)(A)/(b)). Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

edu_material_certified_character.description: The importer certifies the article is visual or auditory material of an educational, scientific or cultural character, or that it was produced by the United Nations or any of its specialized agencies (subchapter XVII U.S. note 1(a)(ii)(B)/(b)). Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

ag_machinery_purpose.description: Use of the article: agricultural_or_horticultural_implement (machinery, equipment or implement used for agricultural or horticultural purposes, heading 9817.00.50, including an interchangeable implement mounted on a chapter 87 tractor), part_for_8432_8433_8434_8436 (a part used in an article of headings 8432, 8433, 8434 or 8436, whether or not principally used as a part of such an article, heading 9817.00.60), or other. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

ag_machinery_not_note2_excluded.description: The article is not one of the classes U.S. note 2 excludes from headings 9817.00.50 and 9817.00.60 (among others: chapters 25, 71–73, 76–89 subject to that note's listed exceptions, and specific textile, leather/fur, or section XIII articles); see subchapter XVII U.S. note 2 for the full exclusion list. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

stocking_animal_liberation.description: The animals or game are imported to be liberated in the United States for stocking purposes. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

metal_remanufacture_kind.description: Kind of metal article: defective_damaged_ingot_pig_billet (unwrought metal pigs, ingots or billets that are defective or damaged, or produced from melted-down metal waste and scrap for convenience in handling and transportation, without sweetening, alloying, fluxing or deliberate purifying, and cannot be commercially used without re-manufacture), relaying_rerolling_rail (relaying or rerolling rails), or remanufacture_or_recovery_metal_article (an article of metal, other than of lead, zinc or tungsten, and not a metal-bearing material of section VI, chapter 26 or subheading 8549.11–.19, and not unwrought metal of chapters 72–81, to be used in remanufacture by melting or to be processed by shredding, shearing, compacting or similar processing rendering it fit only for recovery of the metal content). Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

metal_remanufacture_material.description: Material of the article: copper (9817.00.80), lead_zinc_tungsten_excluded (excluded from this subheading group), or other (9817.00.90). Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

copper_price_at_or_above_threshold.description: The market price of electrolytic copper, as most recently reported by the U.S. International Trade Commission under subchapter XVII U.S. note 3, is not under $1.12 per kilogram; only relevant to heading 9817.00.80, which does not apply when the reported price is under that threshold. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

rum_classified_2208.description: The liqueur or spirituous beverage is classified in subheading 2208.40 or 2208.90. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

rum_source_cbera_or_usvi.description: The rum used to produce the liqueur or spirituous beverage is the growth, product or manufacture of a CBERA beneficiary country enumerated in general note 7(a), or of the U.S. Virgin Islands (subchapter XVII U.S. note 6(i)). rum_direct_to_canada_from_cbera_or_usvi.description: The rum was imported directly from that CBERA beneficiary country or the U.S. Virgin Islands into the territory of Canada (subchapter XVII U.S. note 6(ii)). Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.
