vessel_installation_abroad_or_at_sea.description: Installation occurred on the high seas, in foreign waters, or in a foreign port. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

vessel_foreign_shipyard_repairs_by_forei.description: Installation involved foreign shipyard repairs by foreign labor. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

vessel_other_relief_claimed.description: A statutory or regulatory remission, abatement, or other relief claim beyond Chapter 98 subchapter XVIII note 2 is asserted. Importer-declared; not verified Customs approval.

same_articles_returned.description: The imported articles are the same articles exported, without substitution; documentary references do not establish this fact automatically.

foreign_processing_performed.description: Further processing of the metal article was actually performed abroad, distinct from its intended export purpose.

exported_from_us.description: The claimed article was exported from the United States. Omitted or null means not established.

product_of_us.description: The returned article is a product of the United States; foreign products have a separate three-year condition and documentary pathway. Omitted or null means not established.

advanced_in_value_abroad.description: The returned article was advanced in value while abroad. Omitted or null means not established.

improved_in_condition_abroad.description: The returned article was improved in condition while abroad. Omitted or null means not established.

drawback_on_export.description: Drawback was obtained on export of the claimed article. Omitted or null means not established.

manufactured_under_9813_0005.description: Article was manufactured or produced in the United States under temporary-import heading 9813.00.05. Omitted or null means not established.

manufactured_in_us_bonded_warehouse.description: Article was manufactured or produced in a U.S. customs bonded warehouse. Omitted or null means not established.

internal_revenue_tax_due.description: An internal-revenue tax is imposed on this kind of article at entry. Omitted or null means not established.

internal_revenue_tax_imposed_before_expo.description: An internal-revenue tax was imposed on production or importation of the article before export. Omitted or null means not established.

internal_revenue_tax_paid_before_export.description: The applicable internal-revenue tax was paid before export. Omitted or null means not established.

internal_revenue_tax_refunded.description: The pre-export internal-revenue tax was refunded. Omitted or null means not established.

export_from_continuous_customs_custody_w.description: Export occurred from continuous customs custody with remission, abatement or refund of duty (subchapter II note 1(a)). Omitted or null means not established.

legally_required_export.description: Export was required by U.S. law or a federal agency regulation (subchapter II note 1(c)). Omitted or null means not established.

subject_to_usmca_drawback.description: The goods are subject to USMCA drawback under subchapter II note 1. This is not inferred from USMCA origin qualification. Omitted or null means not established.

exported_for_repairs_or_alterations.description: The article was exported specifically for repairs or alterations. Omitted or null means not established.

warranty_work.description: The foreign repair or alteration was pursuant to a warranty; distinguishes 9802.00.40 from 9802.00.50. Warranty does not imply zero value. Omitted or null means not established.

fungible_inventory_method_used.description: A fungible inventory-management pathway under subchapter II note 3(f) is claimed. This pathway currently requires additional review. Omitted or null means not established.

processing_country.description: Two-letter country where the repair or alteration took place. Canada/Mexico special documentary and preference pathways require separate review. Omitted or null means not established.

metal_within_note_3e.description: The metal article falls within the metals, listed elements or alloys specified by subchapter II note 3(e). Omitted or null means not established.

manufactured_or_manufacturing_processed_.description: The metal article was manufactured in the United States or subjected to a U.S. process of manufacture. Omitted or null means not established.

exported_for_further_processing.description: The metal article was exported for further processing. Omitted or null means not established.

returned_for_further_us_processing.description: The processed article is returned for further processing in the United States; overseas processing alone is insufficient. Omitted or null means not established.

assembled_abroad.description: The imported article was assembled abroad. Omitted or null means not established.

goods_of_9802_0091.description: The assembled article is goods of heading 9802.00.91, excluded from 9802.00.80. Omitted or null means not established.

entered_under_subchapter_xix_or_xx.description: The goods are entered under Chapter 98 subchapter XIX or XX, excluded from 9802.00.80. Omitted or null means not established.

container_entry_event.description: Container entry event. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

container_treatment.description: Container treatment. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

container_clearance.description: Container clearance procedure. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

imported_empty.description: Imported empty. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

other_specific_empty_container_exemption.description: Empty container has another specifically applicable duty exemption. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

normally_sold_with_contents.description: Container is of a kind normally sold with its contents. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

entered_separately_from_contents.description: Container is entered separately from its contents. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

previously_imported.description: Previously imported into the United States. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

initial_duty_if_any_paid.description: Duty, if any, on the previous importation was paid. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

iit_article.description: Instrument of international traffic category. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

international_merchandise_traffic_use.description: In use or to be used to ship merchandise in international traffic. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

iit_foreign_production_container.description: The associated container is of foreign production. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

repair_component_for_container.description: Component imported to repair the associated container. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

accessory_equipment_for_container.description: Accessory or equipment imported for the associated container. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

accessory_movement.description: Accessory or equipment movement. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

continuous_container_bond_filed.description: Continuous container bond filed with Customs. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

bond_conditions_113_66.description: Bond contains the applicable 19 CFR 113.66 conditions. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

container_owner_mark.description: Container marked with owner or operator identity. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

unique_consecutive_serial.description: Owner-assigned consecutive serial number is not duplicated. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

conspicuous_durable_markings.description: Required container markings are clear, conspicuous and durable. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

intermodal_without_reloading.description: Specially designed and equipped for carriage without intermediate reloading. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

gross_mass_rating_kg.description: Container gross mass rating (kg), not shipment weight. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

prior_entry_identification_mark.description: Marked with prior duty-paid port, entry number and fiscal year. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

tariff_heading_mark.description: Marked with the applicable tariff heading. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

container_status_records.description: Records show current service status and disposition and are open to Customs inspection. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

container_manifest_markings.description: Inward and outward manifests identify required container markings. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

markings_removed_on_disposal.description: Markings removed or appropriately changed on withdrawal from service or ownership transfer. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

cross_border_arrival_country.description: Shipping-device arrival country. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

always_within_transport_container.description: Shipping devices always transported on or within the specified transport containers. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

reporting_interval_months.description: Shipping-device reporting interval (months). Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

payment_delay_days.description: Days after reporting-period close for payment of duties and fees. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

records_retention_years.description: Years supporting shipping-device reports are retained. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

approved_program_manifest_notation.description: Manifest carries the 19 CFR 10.41b(b) program notation. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

solid_wood_shipping_device.description: Pallet or other solid-wood shipping device. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

plant_pest_document_required.description: USDA requires a plant-pest admissibility document for this device. Importer-declared, not verified Customs approval.

shipment_value_usd.description: Total shipment value in USD for the 19 CFR 10.1 documentary threshold. Do not substitute a line-item or repair value. Omitted or null means not established.

returned_after_temporary_use_abroad.description: For a 9801.00.10 statistical row: the articles were exported with intent to reimport them after temporary use abroad (row 9801.00.10.10). The other rows require it to be false.

returned_for_repair_to_be_reexported.description: For a 9801.00.10 statistical row: the articles are returned temporarily for repair, alteration, processing or the like, to be reexported (row 9801.00.10.12). The other rows require it to be false.

note_7_apparel_article.description: For 9802.00.80.42, .44 or .46 (subchapter II U.S. note 7): the imported article is an apparel article.

note_7_textile_luggage.description: For 9802.00.80.44 or .46: the imported article is textile luggage (U.S. note 7(b)(i)(B)).

note_7_us_fabric_and_yarn.description: For 9802.00.80.42, .44 or .46: assembled from fabrics wholly formed and cut, or components knit-to-shape, in the United States from yarns wholly formed in the United States.

note_7_knit_crocheted_or_woven_fabric.description: For 9802.00.80.44 or .46: the apparel is assembled from knitted or crocheted fabrics or from woven fabrics.

note_7_fabric_dyed_printed_finished_in_u.description: For 9802.00.80.44 or .46: all dyeing, printing and finishing of those fabrics was carried out in the United States.

note_7_imported_directly_from.description: For 9802.00.80.42, .44 or .46: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country the article was imported directly from. Give the assembly country in processing_country.

note_7_cbtpa_production_country.description: For 9802.00.80.46 (U.S. note 7(b)(ii)): ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the CBTPA beneficiary country in which the article, or a good used in its production, underwent production.

note_7_origin_country.description: For 9802.00.80.46: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country of which the article is a good under 19 U.S.C. 1304 or 19 U.S.C. 3592.

components.description: Individual components for an assembly claim; qualified value is derived, not supplied as a blanket U.S.-content percentage.

id.description: Unique component identifier within the declaration; retained in component decisions.

value_usd.description: Component cost or value in USD under Chapter 98 subchapter II note 4. Not the whole article value.

product_of_us.description: This particular component is a product of the United States.

fabricated.description: This component is fabricated, not merely unadjudicated raw material.

ready_for_assembly_without_further_fabri.description: Component was exported ready for assembly without further fabrication.

physical_identity_preserved.description: Component has not lost its physical identity in the imported article by a change in form, shape or otherwise.

foreign_operations_only_assembly_or_inci.description: Foreign advancement of this component is limited to assembly and operations incidental to assembly; not an assertion that all foreign processing qualifies.

fabric_component.description: Whether this is a fabric component for the 9802.00.91 assembly rule.

visible_lining_fabric.description: Whether the fabric is visible lining fabric, which the 9802.00.91 source permits from any origin.

wholly_formed_and_cut_in_us.description: Controlled fabric component was wholly formed and cut in the United States.

charge_made.description: Whether a charge was made for this U.S. component, selecting the source-defined value method.

last_purchase_cost_usd.description: Last purchase cost of a charged U.S. component.

shipment_value_at_export_usd.description: Value at time of shipment to Mexico for a no-charge U.S. component.

items.description: One individually identified component with its declared legal conditions and cost or value.

evidence.description: Documentary references retained in eligibility outcomes; no document fetch, verification or CBP approval is implied.

reference.description: Nonempty reference to the supporting document or claimed CBP action. Not an eligibility Boolean or authenticated approval.

items.description: One documentary reference and its kind; supplied information is not independently verified.

Chapter98Condition.description: A distinct legal condition evaluated against declared entry facts.

status.description: Unknown is missing evidence of a condition, never automatically false.

missing_facts.description: Relative Chapter 98 fact paths needed to evaluate this condition.

authority.description: Pinned governing HTS heading or note; documentary requirements carry their own regulatory source.

Chapter98EvidenceRequirement.description: Documentary requirement with its pinned regulatory authority. A supplied reference remains unverified.

status.description: Declared means a reference was supplied, not that the document or CBP decision was verified.

items.description: One caller-supplied documentary reference; not independently verified evidence or CBP approval.

references.description: Caller-supplied references for this requirement; empty when missing.

source_sha256.description: SHA256 of the retained extracted UTF-8 regulatory text, not the original HTML bytes.

note.description: Applicable regulation paragraph and any unimplemented alternative pathway.

Chapter98Eligibility.description: Source-backed eligibility stage, independent of valuation, tariff interactions and customs approval.

actual_use.description: General actual-use lifecycle for the scoped net claims. All facts and Customs acceptance remain unverified; this is not a final duty determination.

proof_deadline.description: Three-year consumption-entry/withdrawal anniversary; exceptional calendar deadlines require review.

records_retain_through.description: Three years after declared liquidation, not after entry.

final_ordinary_duty_usd.description: Always null: the lifecycle does not establish final ordinary duty or Customs liquidation.

customs_acceptance.description: Customs acceptance of declarations, proof and liquidation has not been verified.

items.description: Official eCFR URL for an actual-use regulatory authority.

authorities.description: Official regulatory sources governing the general actual-use lifecycle.

status.description: Eligibility-stage state only. Conditions satisfied on unverified declarations does not mean applied relief, CBP approval or a completed tariff stack.

reason.description: Specific factual, documentary, regulatory-date or integration limitation.

evidence_verification.description: This evaluator does not independently verify documentary references or CBP actions.

conditions.description: Individual conditions and their known/unknown outcomes.

missing_facts.description: Fact paths needed by the eligibility stage; documents are separate evidence requirements.

evidence_requirements.description: Declared or missing documents and their dated sources.

component_results.description: Per-component eligibility; a disqualified component does not erase relief potentially available for a different component.

id.description: Unique component identifier within the declaration; retained in component decisions.

status.description: Status of this component only, on unverified facts.

value_usd.description: Component cost or value in USD under Chapter 98 subchapter II note 4. Not the whole article value.

items.description: Eligibility outcome for one declared component; never an applied whole-entry duty deduction.

qualifying_components_value_usd.description: Sum of values of components satisfying the modeled conditions, in USD; null if any potentially qualifying component remains unresolved. Not an applied deduction.

source_window.description: Inclusive interval independently supported by the retained regulatory snapshots; may be narrower than the HTS inventory interval.

through.description: Last verified regulatory date; no forward projection implied.

EntryFacts.description: Facts the entry declares, keyed by fact name. Only the facts listed here are accepted; an unknown key is rejected with `invalid_field` naming it. A declared fact can rule a fact-conditioned Section 232 measure in or out; nothing here is verified, so declare only what the entry documentation supports. Facts not declared are treated as not established, never as true.

section_232.heading.description: Importer-declared Section 232 Chapter 99 heading used to evaluate cross-program eligibility such as U.S. note 52(f). Normalized by the API and not independently verified.

upland_cotton.description: The cotton is upland cotton, a variety of Gossypium hirsutum, and not Extra Long Staple (ELS) cotton

producing_country_certificate.description: Accompanied by an original certificate of an official of a government agency of the country in which the cotton was produced attesting that it is a variety of Gossypium hirsutum cotton

importer_purchase_certification.description: A certification by the importer that the cotton was purchased not later than 90 days after the effective date of the Secretary of Agriculture's announcement of the quota

within_announced_quantity.description: Entered within the quantity the Secretary of Agriculture's announcement specifies

within_note_7_quantity.description: Entered within the additional quantity and its quarterly (9903.54.01) or 30-day (9903.54.02) limit under U.S. note 7

psf_entered_under_tib.description: Admitted temporarily free of duty under bond and entered under statistical reporting number 9813.00.0520

within_note_32_quantity.description: Entered within the annual aggregate quantity U.S. note 32(a) specifies for the period

applied_rate_derived_from_covered_subhea.description: The entry's applied rate of duty under the enumerated subheading is derived from another subheading subject to the Section 301 additional duties the note names

admitted_to_ftz_privileged_foreign_statu.description: The goods were admitted into a U.S. foreign trade zone in privileged foreign status (19 CFR 146.41) before March 4, 2021 (United Kingdom) or March 11, 2021 (EU member States)

sts_gantry_crane.description: The cranes are ship-to-shore gantry cranes, configured as a high- or low-profile steel superstructure and designed to unload intermodal containers from vessels with coupling devices for containers, including spreaders or twist-locks

sts_crane_china_components.description: The cranes are manufactured, assembled or made using components, assemblies or subassemblies that are products of China, as U.S. note 31(l)(ii) specifies (the boom, trolley, spreader, cabin, legs, cable reel, power supply, bogie set and wheels, or information technology equipment used to operate or control the crane)

sts_crane_manufacturer_chinese_owned_or_.description: The cranes are manufactured by a company or other entity that is owned or controlled by a Chinese person or legal entity, as U.S. note 31(l)(v) defines it

sts_crane_contract_before_2024_05_14.description: The cranes are fulfilling in whole or in part an executed contract for sale dated prior to May 14, 2024

sts_crane_annex_d_certification_filed.description: The importer completed the certification in Annex D to 89 FR 76581 and provided it with the electronic entry summary by uploading it to the ACE Document Imaging System when declaring heading 9903.91.09

sts_crane_contract_before_2025_04_17.description: The importer attests that the cranes are fulfilling in whole or in part an executed contract for sale dated prior to April 17, 2025

section_338_canada.description: Facts for the Canadian Section 338 duty (HTS chapter 99, subchapter III, U.S. note 51) and for the import exclusion of listed products of Canada under Proclamations 11061, 11062 and 11063, effective for goods imported on or after 12:01 a.m. Eastern time on September 29, 2026. Importer-declared, not independently verified.

importation_time.description: Date and time of importation with a UTC offset, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00-04:00. Goods imported before the effective time remain subject to the 50% Section 338 duty even when entered later. Must not be later than the entry date.

direct_to_consumption_container.description: The alcohol product is packaged in bottles, cans, boxes, kegs or other similar direct-to-consumption containers. Needed only for annex lines with the Packaged scope limitation.

personal_use_accompanied_baggage.description: U.S. note 51(a): the goods are for personal use and included in the accompanied baggage of a person arriving in the United States. True removes the Section 338 duty. Not requested when absent.

us_content_approved.description: U.S. note 51(c)(2): the entry applies heading 9903.94.02 to the U.S. content of a passenger vehicle or light truck with approval from the Secretary of Commerce. Decides the dairy carve-out under that heading.

import_adjustment_offset.description: U.S. note 51(c)(3) and (6): the article is a vehicle part subject to an import adjustment offset under Proclamation 10925 (passenger vehicles and light trucks) or 10984 (medium- and heavy-duty vehicles). Decides the dairy carve-out for 9903.94 and 9903.74 entries not otherwise listed.

usmca_qualifying.description: The article qualifies for USMCA preferential treatment.

manufacture_year.description: Calendar year the vehicle was manufactured. Age is counted from this to the year of entry (`as_of`).

commerce_us_content_approved.description: Importer declaration that the Secretary of Commerce approved the MHDV U.S.-content determination under U.S. note 38(d)/(f). Not inferred from USMCA eligibility or the declared share; not independently verified approval.

us_content_share.description: Share (0 to 1) of the customs value that is U.S. content: for a USMCA medium- or heavy-duty vehicle, the separately Commerce-approved U.S.-content share (U.S. note 38(d), heading 9903.74.03); for a USMCA passenger vehicle or light truck, Commerce-approved U.S. content (U.S. note 33(c)-(d), heading 9903.94.03); for a USMCA derivative steel article of annex I-C, the value attributable to parts produced in the United States (U.S. note 16(j), headings 9903.82.20/9903.82.21, relieved up to 40 percent of value).

product_scope.description: Which product scope the article falls in, where a Section 232 heading covers only some articles of a subheading.

vehicle_knock_down_kit_or_parts_compilat.description: Whether the entry is a vehicle knock-down kit or parts compilation. Must be false for the USMCA parts exceptions under notes 33 and 38.

uk_passenger_vehicle_quota_allocated.description: Importer declares actual CBP entry allocation under the UK passenger vehicle tariff-rate quota (U.S. note 33(i)), including applicable quarterly and annual limits and permitted carryforward. Not a reservation or verified available balance. Unclaimed or false does not apply heading 9903.94.31.

general_note_6_eligible.description: Importer asserts all general note 6 use, airworthiness/certificate pathway, government-use and quantity restrictions are met and supporting documentation is maintained. Not verified by this API. End use alone is insufficient.

end_use.description: Declared end use, for use-conditioned measures.

metal_smelt_origin_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country where the metal was smelted and cast.

metal_smelt_origin_share.description: Share (0 to 1) of the metal smelted and cast in the declared country.

aluminum_smelted_or_cast_in_russia.description: Section 232 aluminum, U.S. note 19(m), headings 9903.85.67 and 9903.85.68: any amount of the primary aluminum used to manufacture the article was smelted in Russia, or the article was cast in Russia. True takes the 200 percent duty on the full value of an aluminum article of note 19(g) or a derivative aluminum article of note 19(i)-(k), whatever its country of origin. Undeclared, it is treated as false. Declared by the importer, not verified by the API.

no_listed_metal_content.description: The article contains none of the metals a content-conditioned measure names.

steel_content_weight_share.description: Steel content as a share (0 to 1) of the article's weight.

aluminum_content_weight_share.description: Aluminum content as a share (0 to 1) of the article's weight.

copper_content_weight_share.description: Copper content as a share (0 to 1) of the article's weight.

aggregate_listed_metal_content_weight_sh.description: All listed metals together as a share (0 to 1) of the article's weight.

pharmaceutical_article.description: Section 232 pharmaceuticals, U.S. note 40(c)(i): the article on the note 40(c) list is a finished pharmaceutical product or an active pharmaceutical ingredient (including key starting materials) used to make one. False for inactive ingredients, excipients and other articles. Required for any line on the list: without it the Section 232 component is unresolved, not zero.

pharmaceutical_patent_status.description: U.S. note 40(c)(ii)-(iii): `patented` (valid unexpired U.S. patent and listed in the FDA Orange Book or Purple Book, and ingredients for such articles), `generic` (FDA-approved and off patent and exclusivity under a qualifying application), or `neither`. Required for pharmaceutical articles on the note 40(c) list.

pharmaceutical_annex_iii_company.description: Proclamation 11020 clause (4): the goods are imported for a company listed in Annex III, whose duties apply from July 31, 2026. Other companies' patented articles enter under heading 9903.04.61 until September 29, 2026. Required for patented pharmaceutical articles entered before September 29, 2026.

pharmaceutical_company_program.description: Claims a company regime notified to CBP: a Commerce-approved onshoring plan (heading 9903.04.64) or an onshoring plan with a Most-Favored-Nation pricing agreement (9903.04.65). Not verified by the API.

pharmaceutical_specialty_designation.description: Claims heading 9903.04.66 (U.S. note 40(h)(iii)): orphan, nuclear, plasma-derived, fertility, cell and gene, antibody drug conjugate, countermeasure or other specialty product designated by the Secretary of Commerce. Not verified by the API.

pharmaceutical_non_commercial_use.description: Claims heading 9903.04.70 (from September 29, 2026): the pharmaceutical articles are solely for use in clinical trials, research and development, or other non-commercial applications. Not verified by the API.

uas_thermal_imaging.description: Section 232 unmanned aircraft, U.S. note 43(c)(3)-(4): the unmanned aircraft integrates a thermal imager (100 percent under heading 9903.08.21; without one, 25 percent under 9903.08.22). Required for unmanned aircraft of 25 kg or less: without it the Section 232 component is unresolved.

uas_allied_critical_components.description: U.S. note 43(d): the importer certifies that substantially all the critical components and technology are products of the United States, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Switzerland, Liechtenstein, the European Union or the United Kingdom (headings 9903.08.23 for the United Kingdom, 9903.08.24 for the others). Not verified by the API.

uas_onshoring_plan.description: Claims an unmanned aircraft onshoring plan: `dhs_or_dow` (approved by the Department of Homeland Security or the Department of War, heading 9903.08.25) or `commerce` (approved by the Secretary of Commerce, heading 9903.08.26). Not verified by the API.

semiconductor_technical_parameters.description: Section 232 semiconductors, U.S. note 39(b): the article of 8471.50, 8471.80 or 8473.30 is, or contains, a logic integrated circuit within the note's total processing performance and total DRAM bandwidth windows (25 percent under heading 9903.79.01; otherwise no change under 9903.79.02). Required for those provisions: without it the Section 232 component is unresolved.

semiconductor_end_use.description: Claims a U.S. note 39(d) end use for a semiconductor article (headings 9903.79.03-9903.79.09, no change): U.S. data centers, repairs or replacements, research and development, startups, non-data center consumer electronics, non-data center civil industrial, or public sector applications in the United States. Not verified by the API.

metals_equipment_end_use.description: Claims a U.S. note 16(k) exclusive end use for an annex I-B part of chapter 84, 85 or 87 (headings 9903.82.23-9903.82.26, from June 8, 2026): used exclusively in the manufacturing of agricultural or fixed industrial equipment (note 16(c)(ix)-(x)) or of mobile industrial equipment (note 16(c)(xi)). Not available to products of general note 3(b) countries. Not verified by the API.

motorcycle_manufacturing_end_use.description: Claims the heading 9903.82.13 exclusion through June 7, 2026 for an annex I-B part of chapter 84, 85 or 87 used exclusively in U.S. motorcycle manufacturing. Not verified by the API.

vehicle_parts_end_use_certification.description: Section 232 certified vehicle parts: the importer of record certifies that the parts will be used for automobile production or repair in the United States (`us_automobile_production_or_repair`: U.S. note 33(p), heading 9903.94.07, +25%; for products of the EU, Japan, Korea or Taiwan, note 33(r), headings 9903.94.44/.45, .54/.55, .64/.65 or .68/.69, 15 percent all-inclusive), in automobiles that are products of the United Kingdom (`uk_automobile`: note 33(q), heading 9903.94.33, 10 percent, products of the United Kingdom only), or for medium- or heavy-duty vehicle production or repair in the United States (`us_mhdv_production_or_repair`: note 38(j), heading 9903.74.09, +25%). Not available for articles of chapters 72, 73 or 76 or of the provisions listed in note 33(g), 33(j) (for 9903.94.33) or 38(i), which keep their own headings. Declared by the importer, not verified by the API.

metals_limited_quantity_authorization.description: Section 232 metals, U.S. note 16(h)-(i) (headings 9903.82.18 and 9903.82.19, from June 8, 2026): the article of steel (note 16(c)(iii)) or of aluminum (note 16(c)(i)) is within a limited quantity the Secretary of Commerce has authorized for a tariff reduction under clause 13 of Proclamation 10984. Applies with `usmca_qualifying` and a `metal_smelt_origin_country` of CA or MX (melted and poured, or smelted and cast): the duty is the Special rate + 25%. Declared by the importer, not verified by the API.

section122_in_transit.description: Section 122 surcharge (Proclamation 11012), heading 9903.03.02: the goods were loaded onto a vessel at the port of loading and in transit on the final mode of transit before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 24, 2026. Exempts an entry made before 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on February 28, 2026. Not verified by the API.

section122_particular_article.description: Section 122 surcharge (Proclamation 11012), heading 9903.03.04: the entered goods are one of the particular articles named for their listed subheading in U.S. note 2(aa)(iii). Required to decide that exemption; not verified by the API.

humanitarian_donation.description: Section 122 surcharge, heading 9903.03.10: donations, by persons subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, of articles such as food, clothing and medicine intended to relieve human suffering. Not verified by the API.

informational_materials.description: Section 122 surcharge, heading 9903.03.11: informational materials such as publications, films, posters, phonograph records, photographs, microfilms, tapes, compact disks, artworks and news wire feeds. Not verified by the API.

steel_content_value_usd.description: Section 232 steel duty through April 5, 2026: the declared value in USD of the steel content of the line. Headings 9903.81.91 and 9903.81.98 (U.S. note 16(n) and (u)) are assessed on it whatever the chapter, and from June 4, 2025 so are articles of chapter 73 under 9903.81.87, 9903.81.89, 9903.81.90 and 9903.81.94, 9903.81.96, 9903.81.97. Undeclared, that duty is assessed on the entire entered value, as CBP requires when the content value is unknown. Declare 0 for an article on a steel list that has no steel. It also sizes the Section 122 surcharge from February 24 through April 5, 2026 (U.S. note 2(aa)(v)(a)-(b), HTSUS 2026 Rev 4): heading 9903.03.06 exempts it for an article under Section 232 headings 9903.81.87-9903.81.99, and the surcharge (9903.03.01) applies to the rest of the customs value; undeclared, the surcharge on such an article is excluded from totals. Not verified by the API.

aluminum_content_value_usd.description: Section 232 aluminum duty through April 5, 2026: the declared value in USD of the aluminum content of the line. Headings 9903.85.08 and 9903.85.15 (U.S. note 19(k) and (s)) are assessed on it whatever the chapter, and from June 4, 2025 so are articles of chapter 76 under 9903.85.02, 9903.85.04, 9903.85.07 and 9903.85.12-9903.85.14. Undeclared, that duty is assessed on the entire entered value, as CBP requires when the content value is unknown. Declare 0 for an article on an aluminum list that has no aluminum. It also sizes the Section 122 surcharge from February 24 through April 5, 2026 (U.S. note 2(aa)(v)(c)-(d), HTSUS 2026 Rev 4): heading 9903.03.06 exempts it for an article under Section 232 headings 9903.85.02-9903.85.15 (as listed), and the surcharge (9903.03.01) applies to the rest of the customs value; undeclared, the surcharge on such an article is excluded from totals. Not verified by the API.

copper_content_value_usd.description: Section 232 copper duty, August 1, 2025 through April 5, 2026: the declared value in USD of the copper content of a line under heading 9903.78.01 (U.S. note 36), which the 50 percent duty is assessed on; the non-copper content enters under 9903.78.02. Undeclared, that duty is assessed on the entire entered value, as CBP requires when the content value is unknown. It also sizes the Section 122 surcharge from February 24 through April 5, 2026 (U.S. note 2(aa)(v)(g), HTSUS 2026 Rev 4): heading 9903.03.06 exempts it for an article under heading 9903.78.01, and the surcharge (9903.03.01) applies to the rest of the customs value; undeclared, the surcharge on such an article is excluded from totals. Not verified by the API.

polysilicon_mip_documentation.description: Section 232 polysilicon minimum import prices, U.S. note 42(a) and Proclamation 11052 clause (2) (headings 9903.45.33-9903.45.36, from December 4, 2026): the resale documentation submitted to CBP at entry. `not_resold_downstream_at_or_above_mip` (note 42(a)(1)), `resold_at_or_above_mip` ((a)(2)) or `pre_august_6_2026_fixed_contract` ((a)(3)): the specific duty is the shortfall of the entered value below the minimum import price, none when it meets it. `none`: the full minimum import price per kg or watt. Required for these lines: without it the specific duty is unresolved. Not verified by the API.

unmanned_aircraft_component.description: Section 232 civil aircraft components of Taiwan, U.S. note 35(c): the article is a component of an unmanned aircraft. Heading 9903.96.03 lifts the metals duties of 9903.82.02 and 9903.82.04-9903.82.19 only for components of civil aircraft other than unmanned aircraft that meet general note 6 (`general_note_6_eligible`); required once `general_note_6_eligible` is claimed on a listed line of Taiwan: without it the Section 232 component is unresolved. Declared by the importer, not verified by the API.

intermodal_chassis.description: Section 301 maritime action, U.S. note 31(k): the article of China of 8716.39.0090, 8716.90.30 or 8716.90.50 is an intermodal chassis, a subassembly or a part of one as note 31(k)(i) describes it (100 percent under heading 9903.91.12 on 2025-11-09 and from 2026-11-10). False takes heading 9903.91.13, no additional duty (note 31(k)(ii)). Undeclared, the 9903.91.12 duty is excluded from totals and reported as unresolved. Declared by the importer, not verified by the API.

sts_gantry_crane.description: Section 301, headings 9903.92.10 and 9903.91.14: the crane of China of subheading 8426.19.00 is a ship-to-shore gantry crane, configured as a high- or low-profile steel superstructure and designed to unload intermodal containers from vessels (25 percent under 9903.92.10 from 2024-09-27; 100 percent under 9903.91.14 on 2025-11-09 and from 2026-11-10). False takes heading 9903.92.80, no additional duty, and no 9903.91.14 duty. Undeclared, both duties are excluded from totals and reported as unresolved. Declared by the importer, not verified by the API.

sts_crane_china_components.description: Section 301, heading 9903.91.14, U.S. note 31(l)(ii): a ship-to-shore gantry crane of subheading 8426.19.00 of a country other than China contains one or more components, assemblies or subassemblies of China the note names (the boom, trolley, spreader, cabin, legs, cable reel, power supply, bogie set and wheels, or information technology equipment used to operate or control the crane). If so, it is a crane of China for heading 9903.91.14 (100 percent from 2026-11-10); with sts_gantry_crane true and this or sts_crane_manufacturer_chinese_owned_or_controlled true, the duty applies. Never presumed; declared by the importer, not verified by the API.

sts_crane_manufacturer_chinese_owned_or_.description: Section 301, heading 9903.91.14, U.S. note 31(l)(iii) and (v): a ship-to-shore gantry crane of subheading 8426.19.00 is manufactured by a company or other entity owned or controlled by a Chinese person or legal entity, as note 31(l)(v) defines it. If so, it is a crane of China for heading 9903.91.14 whatever its origin. Never presumed; declared by the importer, not verified by the API.

leather_dyed_colored_stamped_or_embossed.description: Section 301, heading 9903.41.05 (Proclamation 5448): the leather of Japan of heading 4104, 4105, 4106, 4107, 4112 or 4113 is dyed, colored, stamped or embossed (40 percent, in addition to the other duties). False: not subject to 9903.41.05. Undeclared, the duty is excluded from totals and reported as unresolved. Declared by the importer, not verified by the API.

leather_footwear_described_9903_41_10.description: Section 301, heading 9903.41.10 (Proclamation 5448): the footwear of Japan of chapter 64 has outer soles of leather and uppers wholly or in part of leather, or outer soles of rubber or plastics and uppers with an exterior surface predominantly of leather, and is not the slip-on or sports footwear the heading excepts (40 percent, in addition to the other duties). False: not subject to 9903.41.10. Undeclared, the duty is excluded from totals and reported as unresolved. Declared by the importer, not verified by the API.

quartz_surface_product.description: Section 201 safeguard, U.S. note 41(a): the article of 6810.99.0020, 6810.99.0040 or 7020.00.6000 is a quartz surface product (a mixture of predominately silica and a resin binder, with silica greater than any other single material by weight; not quarried stone such as granite, marble, soapstone or quartzite). False: not subject to headings 9903.45.30/.31. Undeclared, the safeguard duty is excluded from totals and reported as unresolved. Declared by the importer, not verified by the API.

quartz_safeguard_quota_position.description: Section 201 safeguard, U.S. note 41(d): whether the quartz surface product entry is within the quarterly aggregate quantity (heading 9903.45.30: 25 percent for entries from 2026-08-15 through 2027-08-14) or over it (9903.45.31: 50 percent), with the later years' rates of note 41(e). Undeclared, the safeguard duty is excluded from totals and reported as unresolved. Declared by the importer, not verified by the API.

EntryClaims.description: Chapter 98/99 legal headings or statistical reporting numbers, dotted or undotted. Existing 9903 claims resolve against declared facts. Other claims currently return entry_claim_review_required with structured coverage/edition decisions and no duty total; catalog presence never proves eligibility. Complete Chapter 98/99 calculation coverage is not available.

Chapter98Assessment.description: Partial monetary assessment based on unverified declarations and server-resolved rates. Does not upgrade the claim to applied or provide a payable total.

status.description: Partial assessment state.

merchandise_source.description: Server-side merchandise rate provenance, distinct from the Chapter 98 interaction authority. Null when source lookup was unavailable.

hts_code.description: Exact merchandise classification used for ordinary duty.

edition.description: Verified merchandise rate edition; a different edition cannot support this assessment.

checked_at.description: Recorded source verification timestamp, not the entry date.

ordinary_duty_expression.description: Unmodified merchandise ordinary duty expression, before Chapter 98 value apportionment.

basis_of_assessment.description: Importer declarations have not been independently verified.

ordinary.description: Ordinary duty valuation only; conditional on the separate eligibility assessment.

status.description: Valuation status.

eligibility.description: Valuation alone does not determine eligibility.

heading.description: Chapter 98 heading assessed.

ordinary_duty_usd.description: Ordinary duty in USD after Chapter 98 apportionment; null when unresolved.

full_article_ordinary_duty_usd.description: Ordinary duty in USD on the whole article before Chapter 98 apportionment.

dutiable_basis_usd.description: Foreign change value or full article value less qualifying U.S. components, in USD.

derived_full_article_rate_pct.description: Full ordinary duty divided by full article value, expressed as percentage points.

missing_facts.description: Facts needed to compute ordinary valuation.

excluded_assessments.description: Programs not assessed by the ordinary-duty primitive.

taxes.description: Source-specific import tax dispositions, not domestic tax advice or a payable total.

items.description: Internal-revenue import tax exemption following established whole-article duty relief under Chapter 98 note 3 or XI note 1; not an exemption inferred from a zero ordinary rate.

code.description: Only internal-revenue tax imposed upon or by reason of importation.

status.description: Source-backed exemption on qualifying declared facts.

amount_usd.description: Exempt import tax, never an unresolved amount coerced to zero.

reason.description: Exact statutory exemption and scope limits.

source_sha256.description: Reviewed official PDF checksum.

fees.description: Source-bounded Chapter 98 fee decisions, not a complete charge total.

code.description: Merchandise processing or harbor maintenance fee; each has its own scope.

status.description: Declared qualifying Chapter 98 scope or unresolved fee treatment.

amount_usd.description: Established fee amount; null is unknown, not zero.

rate_pct.description: Assessed fee percentage, e.g. 0.125 for HMF; absent if not assessed.

basis_usd.description: Declared fee valuation basis in USD, independent from Chapter98 dutiable value.

reason.description: Exact exemption, assessment or unresolved fee rule.

source_sha256.description: Reviewed regulation text checksum.

missing_facts.description: Individual entry facts needed to assess this fee.

supporting_sources.description: Additional dated regulations governing the fee disposition.

items.description: One reviewed supporting regulation with its retained text hash.

source_sha256.description: Reviewed supporting text hash.

additional_duties.description: Resolved and unresolved additional-duty components; missing programs are not zero.

items.description: One server-resolved additional-duty component, not proof of program completeness.

heading.description: Resolved additional duty heading.

status.description: Component assessment status.

rate_pct.description: Nominal additional duty in percentage points after owner exclusions and target calculation, before Chapter 98 apportionment.

basis_usd.description: Duty-specific customs basis in USD; null when unresolved or not applicable.

amount_usd.description: Assessed additional duty in USD; unresolved is null, not zero.

interaction.description: Source-specific duty basis; applicability must separately be resolved by a program owner.

heading.description: Additional duty heading.

basis.description: Basis prescribed by the reviewed interaction.

reason.description: Reason the interaction is unresolved, or null.

applicability_source_url.description: Program owner source URL; an empty value cannot support an assessed amount.

program.description: Program whose owner resolved the heading; the entry total matches it to the merchandise calculation's component.

assessed_duty_subtotal_usd.description: Sum of known assessed components in USD. Excludes unresolved charges and must never be presented as a payable total.

total_import_charges_usd.description: Always null until all applicable duties, interactions, taxes and fees are adjudicated.

unresolved_assessments.description: Remaining programs or data limitations preventing a complete result.

missing_facts.description: Additional valuation facts required.

reason.description: Reason the complete result is unavailable.

Chapter99ClaimEligibility.description: A chapter99_claim ruleset's decision on a claimed Chapter 99 heading: the subchapter III U.S. note 6 upland cotton quotas (9903.52.00-.26) the provisions U.S. note 5 states are suspended (9903.04.05-.55, 9903.41.25, 9903.41.35-.45), the U.S. note 15 sugar quota periods (9903.17.01-.10, 9903.17.21-.33, 9903.18.01-.10), which apply only during an effective period USTR announces, and subchapter III provisions the schedule states have ended (9903.19.19-.23, 9903.40.05/.10, 9903.45.01-.06, 9903.45.21-.29, 9903.53.01), the U.S. note 7 additional lean beef trimmings quantities (9903.54.01-.02), the U.S. note 32 fine denier polyester staple fiber quantities (9903.55.01), and the Section 301 retaliation rows 9903.08.04-.15, 9903.27.01-.15 (terminated, per the pinned Federal Register notices) 9903.41.15, .20 and .30 (shaded as expired in the schedule), 9903.41.05/.10 (in force, not assessed), 50 Section 301 China product-exclusion headings in 9903.88 that the schedule shades as expired, 9903.88.16 (List 4B, suspended indefinitely), the note 20(z)-(gg) derived-rate provisions 9903.88.21-.28, and the U.S. note 21 large civil aircraft rows 9903.89.05-.63 (terminated for goods of the United Kingdom from July 4, 2021 and of EU member States from July 11, 2021; goods admitted into a foreign trade zone in privileged foreign status before the suspension remain subject), and the Section 301 ship-to-shore gantry crane exceptions 9903.91.09 (contracts dated before May 14, 2024, entered before May 14, 2026), 9903.91.15 (the importer's attestation of no Chinese origin, components or ownership) and 9903.91.16 (contracts dated before April 17, 2025, entered before April 18, 2027), decided on the importer's declared facts. A qualifying claim requires review: certificates and quota fill are declared, not verified, and no rate is applied to a duty total.

status.description: The ruleset's outcome. requires_external_review means every declared condition is met; it is never applied relief.

reason.description: Stable diagnostic, such as upland_cotton_quota_not_in_effect, upland_cotton_quota_conditions_declared, provision_suspended_by_executive_action, quota_period_not_announced, provision_expired, outside_entry_period, origin_not_subject_to_note_32, section_301_action_terminated, provision_expired_per_schedule, section_301_duty_in_force_not_assessed, section_301_duty_suspended, section_301_derived_rate_conditions_declared, section_301_origin_not_covered, section_301_lca_ftz_status_required, section_301_sts_crane_claim_not_in_effect, section_301_sts_crane_claim_conditions_not_met, section_301_sts_crane_claim_facts_required or section_301_sts_crane_claim_conditions_declared.

heading.description: The claimed heading, normalized.

announcement.description: The Secretary of Agriculture's announcement in effect for the claimed heading on the entry date, with its pinned source.

heading.description: The 9903.52 subheading the announcement references.

purchase_by.description: Latest purchase date the announcement states.

enter_by.description: Latest entry date the announcement states.

quantity_kg.description: Quota quantity in kilograms, as printed.

provision.description: Ruleset provision key citing the announcement.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the announcement PDF as reviewed.

conditions.description: Each source condition with its status.

id.description: Condition id (a fact name or merchandise_classification).

label.description: The condition as the source states it.

status.description: Unknown until declared.

missing_facts.description: Facts this condition still needs.

authority.description: Edition and note the condition comes from.

missing_facts.description: Facts still to declare (chapter99_claim.<name>, merchandise_hts or country).

evidence_verification.description: Declared facts and certificates are not verified.

effect.description: What qualifying entry under the quota means, stated without applying a rate.

note.description: The announcement window, or why no announcement applies.

source_window.description: The entry dates the announcement review covers.

through.description: Date the announcement listing was last reviewed.

EntryClaimDecision.description: A sourced claim decision, distinct from a merchandise classification and from a completed duty calculation.

heading.description: Normalized claimed legal heading or statistical reporting number.

canonical_heading.description: Eight-digit legal heading, preserving the original reporting suffix in heading.

status.description: Coverage gaps are unimplemented or unverified treatment, not a determination that the goods are ineligible. Applied requires a rule-owner result, never catalog presence.

reason.description: Stable diagnostic, including source_edition_unavailable, executable_rule_not_adjudicated, heading_not_in_edition, reporting_number_not_relief, or multiple_subchapter_ii_provisions.

missing_facts.description: Facts required by an executable rule. An empty list does not resolve a coverage gap.

source.description: Authority for the stated decision, not a certification of an exemption.

edition.description: Pinned inventory edition, or null when the governing program has independent dated sources.

url.description: Primary source for the inventory or governing rule.

note.description: Governing note and limits of the source's use.

source_sha256.description: Retained export checksum for inventory identity; null for independently sourced program rules.

Section232EntryReporting.description: A quantity the entry summary line reports when the entry is made under this heading, as CBP's filing guidance states it; null where the guidance states none. Under 9903.82.03 (less than 15 percent of the applicable metal by weight), CBP asks for the aggregate weight of the applicable metal in kilograms as the second quantity (CSMS #68253075).

quantity_position.description: The quantity's position on the entry summary line; 2 is the second quantity.

quantity.description: `applicable_metal_weight`: the aggregate weight of the metal or metals the heading's list names for the classification.

source_url.description: The CBP guidance stating the requirement.

Section232ValuePartition.description: Complementary shares of customs value established by the selected shared legal measure; null unless all required declarations are established. Under HTSUS note 38(d) and (f), Commerce-approved USMCA MHDV entries report non-U.S. value under 9903.74.03 and U.S. value under 9903.74.06. These are value allocations, not whole-entry exclusions or additional duty amounts. Multiply each share by customs value to obtain its value allocation; all other applicable duties remain unchanged.

source_url.description: Primary authority establishing the complementary value allocation.

share_fact.description: The declared fact establishing the approved share of value.

slices.description: The two complementary customs-value slices; both remain explicit at zero and one share boundaries.

items.description: One source-established heading and its complementary fraction of customs value.

heading.description: Chapter 99 heading for this value slice, not necessarily a separate additional duty.

value_share.description: Fraction of customs value assigned to this heading. The complementary slices sum to one, including zero-value boundaries.

Section232HeadingAssignment.description: Where the tariff schedule stands on the chapter 99 heading reported next to it, present only where the schedule does not yet confirm the number the instrument states. The heading reported is the one the instrument states. Proclamation 11052 Annex II inserts U.S. note 42 and headings 9903.45.30-9903.45.36 from December 4, 2026; the reviewed schedule edition prints 9903.45.30 and 9903.45.31 as the U.S. note 41 quartz surface products safeguard headings and does not print 9903.45.32-9903.45.36. Check the current schedule and CBP guidance before reporting these headings on an entry.

status.description: `conflicts_with_schedule`: the schedule prints the number for a provision of another U.S. note. `not_in_schedule`: the schedule does not print the number yet.

stated_in.description: The document that states the heading.

schedule_edition.description: The HTSUS edition the heading was reviewed against.

schedule_note.description: `conflicts_with_schedule`: the U.S. note to chapter 99 subchapter III the schedule prints the heading under; null otherwise.

schedule_provision.description: `conflicts_with_schedule`: the provision the schedule prints under the heading; null otherwise.

source_url.description: The document that states the heading.

Section232Resolution.description: How the Section 232 line was resolved. `heading` is the chapter 99 heading the entry is made under; `facts_used` are declared facts the answer relied on and `facts_assumed` the facts it had to assume in the entry's favour. `reachable_measures` lists the measures one more declared fact would reach, so a caller knows which fact to supply next.

specific_duty.description: Present only where the line carries a Section 232 specific duty that stacks on the ad valorem answer (U.S. note 42(a); polysilicon minimum import prices, headings 9903.45.33-9903.45.36): the heading, the amount per unit, the unit, how it is sized, and the facts its outcome still turns on (`missing_facts`, e.g. `polysilicon_mip_documentation`). The sized amount is the `section_232` line item with `assessment: specific_per_unit`.

heading.description: The chapter 99 heading the specific duty is assessed under; null while the outcome is still between headings.

title.description: The measure, or the instrument while the outcome is unresolved.

source_url.description: The proclamation the specific duty is stated in.

rate_usd_per_unit.description: U.S. dollars per `unit` (the minimum import price); null only if the candidate headings state different amounts.

unit.description: The unit the amount is stated per; the entry's `quantities` are converted to it.

basis.description: `per_unit`: the full amount times the quantity (no resale documentation, Proclamation 11052 clause (2)(b)). `shortfall_below_entered_value`: the amount by which the entered value falls below it (documentation submitted, clause (2)(c)). Null while the documentation is undeclared.

headings.description: The chapter 99 headings the specific duty is assessed under or still between.

facts_used.description: Declared facts the specific measure relied on.

missing_facts.description: Declarable facts the specific duty still turns on; empty once it is decided. The quantity it is sized from is reported on the `section_232` line item with `assessment: specific_per_unit`.

hts.description: Merchandise classification in chapters 1–97; not the claimed Chapter 98/99 heading.

value.description: Full merchandise customs value in USD.

as_of.description: Required entry date; supported dates are bounded by each rule's retained sources.

mode.description: Transport mode for the canonical 9903 calculation. Chapter 98 fee owners require their separately documented facts; mode alone does not establish an exemption.

quota_state.description: Declared position only. Caller-supplied duty expressions are not accepted.

scope.description: Whether this result contains a canonical tariff calculation or only separately assessed declared components.

source_verification.description: Freshness of the daily source verification used by the component assessment; not approval of the entry or complete tariff coverage.

checked_at.description: Timestamp of the retained daily source check, null when unavailable.

status.description: Whether all monitored entry sources passed the latest daily check, only some passed, the check exceeded 24 hours, or no valid state was available.

entry_claim_decisions.description: Canonical decisions, evidence requirements, component amounts and coverage gaps for the requested entry claims.

tariff_calculation.description: Unmodified result of the existing tariff calculator; inspect its completeness and risk layers.

items.description: A requested heading without an individual claim decision in this assessment.

claims_requiring_separate_validation.description: Mixed claims not individually validated by the scoped assessment; nominal component calculations do not approve these claims.

chapter98_components.description: Non-additive projection of the single Chapter 98 claim into ordinary, additional-duty, fee and tax components; null without such a claim.

entry_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the normalized assessment request, not an approval receipt.

known_component_subtotal_usd.description: Sum of separately known components only, not full import charges; null if none is known.

total_import_charges_usd.description: No complete payable total is asserted.

unresolved.description: Unassessed owners and blockers to a full-entry total.

items.description: An unresolved charge owner or assessment condition.

components.description: Distinct charge-owner components; alternative claims are not added together.

owner.description: Charge owner, distinguishing Chapter 98 ordinary treatment, Chapter 99 additional duties, fees and taxes.

identity.description: Heading or charge identifier within its owner.

basis_usd.description: US-dollar valuation basis for this component, null if unknown or not monetary.

source_note.description: Authority-specific explanation of the component assessment.

total_import_charges_usd.description: No full-entry payable total is asserted by this component-assessment contract. When a finished Chapter 98 treatment or 9904 safeguard folds into the calculation, its total is `tariff_calculation.total_import_charges`.

full_coverage.description: Always false: this endpoint does not certify complete Chapter 98/99 coverage.

origin.description: Deprecated alias for country. If both are supplied, they must match.

value.description: Customs (dutiable) value in USD.

mode.description: Mode of transport. Affects HMF (only applies to ocean).

component_values_usd.description: Total line customs values in USD (not per-item values). Supply each component required by the source expression; omitted is not zero. Sum must not exceed value.

movement.description: Total line customs value in USD for movement; omitted is not zero.

case.description: Total line customs value in USD for case; omitted is not zero.

strap_band_bracelet.description: Total line customs value in USD for strap band bracelet; omitted is not zero.

battery.description: Total line customs value in USD for battery; omitted is not zero.

chapter99.description: Deprecated alias for claims. Both inputs use the same facts-aware resolver: missing facts yield needs_facts and failed conditions yield rejected. A same-family heading never overrides conditions. Do not supply both fields. Resolver unavailability returns 503.

CalculateRequest.description: Only the fields listed here are accepted. A request carrying any other key is rejected with `unknown_field` so a misspelled input cannot change the result silently.

DutyQuotaState.description: Tariff-rate quota position for lines whose base duty depends on in-quota or over-quota treatment.

inQuotaExpression.description: Duty expression that applies while the quota is open.

outOfQuotaExpression.description: Duty expression that applies once the quota fills.

assessment.description: Present on the second `section_232` line of a line carrying a Section 232 specific duty that stacks on the ad valorem `section_232` line (U.S. note 42(a); polysilicon minimum import prices, headings 9903.45.33-9903.45.36): `rate_usd_per_unit` per `unit` of the entry's `quantities`, in full (`specific_basis: per_unit`) or as the shortfall of the entered value below it (`shortfall_below_entered_value`). `not_applicable` when the entered value meets the minimum import price; `needs_facts` names what is missing in `missing_facts`.

heading.description: With `assessment: specific_per_unit`: the chapter 99 heading the specific duty is assessed under.

unit.description: With `assessment: specific_per_unit`: the unit the amount is stated per.

specific_basis.description: With `assessment: specific_per_unit`: how the specific duty is sized; null while the documentation that decides it is undeclared.

quantity.description: With `assessment: specific_per_unit`: the entry's quantity in `unit`, converted from `quantities` where needed.

unit.description: The unit the specific duty is stated per.

entered_value_per_unit_usd.description: With `assessment: specific_per_unit`: the entered value divided by the quantity.

missing_facts.description: On a `needs_facts` line with `assessment: specific_per_unit`: the facts or inputs still needed, such as `polysilicon_mip_documentation`, `quantities (kg)` or `value`.

target_rate_pct.description: For a `needs_facts` measure assessed on top of the standard rate: the combined rate it brings the line to.

entry_treatment.description: Present when a claimed Chapter 98 treatment or Chapter 99 subchapter IV safeguard sets this component: the claim heading, the HTS provision the amount rests on (see `entry_treatment.authorities`) and why an unknown amount is unknown.

heading.description: The claimed Chapter 98 or 9904 heading that sets this component; null for a merchandise component kept as calculated.

provision.description: Key of the HTS provision in `entry_treatment.authorities`, or the owner (`chapter98_fee_owner`, `chapter98_owner`) whose assessment states the amount.

reason.description: Why the amount is unknown or which owner status it reflects; null when established.

treatment.description: On `base_mfn`: the preferential rate replaced the General rate, on the importer's declaration.

program.description: On `base_mfn` with `treatment: preference`: the program symbol.

basis.description: On `base_mfn` with `treatment: preference`: the preferential rate rests on the importer's declaration, not a verified origin determination.

Chapter99ClaimResult.description: Compatibility projection of the canonical Section 232 claim outcome; never an independent rate override.

RiskLayer.description: Fact-dependent or non-deterministic duty layer. These are not silently included in deterministic totals; callers need additional importer, producer/exporter, quantity, quota, or certification facts before applying them.

last_verified_at.description: When the data was last verified against the official USITC source. Unlike data_updated_at, this advances even on days when the source is checked and found unchanged.

calculation_status.description: `complete` only when every component in `line_items` (and, under a folded claim, in `entry_treatment.line_items`) has an established amount. `incomplete_requires_facts` when a fact is outstanding or a component's amount is unknown, including a component whose treatment is not established for the entry date (for example IEEPA). The component is listed in `unresolved_facts`, `total_duty`, `total_import_charges`, `total_landed` and `effective_rate_pct` are null, and the `*_excluding_unresolved_base` fields carry the known components only. `not_a_classification` is returned for Chapter 98 and 99 headings; `line_items` is empty and every total is null. See `heading`.

totals_exclude.description: Components the published totals leave out; a component listed here is not zero. `ad_cvd` is always listed: antidumping and countervailing duty deposits are never part of these totals. `trade_remedy` covers an additional duty, such as IEEPA, whose treatment or rate is not established.

total_import_charges.description: Total duty plus customs fees; excludes the entered merchandise value.

total_import_charges_excluding_unresolve.description: Known duty and fee charges when a fact-dependent base duty cannot be completed.

total_landed.description: Entered merchandise value plus total duty and customs fees.

entry_claim_decisions.description: Present when a claimed Chapter 98 treatment or 9904 safeguard is folded into this calculation: each claim's decision (status `applied`), eligibility and assessed components.

entry_treatment.description: Present when a claimed Chapter 98 treatment or 9904 safeguard is folded into this calculation (tariff-rule engine ruleset entry-total.assembly). A component it cannot establish stays unknown: the totals are null and the component is named in `unresolved_facts` (code `entry_treatment_component`).

status.description: The claims are folded into this calculation.

treatment.description: Which claimed treatment is folded in.

authorities.description: HTS provisions the folded components rest on, with their pinned sources.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the pinned source bytes.

effective_from.description: First entry date the cited text governs in this edition.

line_items.description: Components the treatment adds beyond the `line_items` kinds, counted in the totals: a claimed 9904 safeguard (`agricultural_safeguard`), the dutiable-mail fee (`dutiable_mail`) and an item the Chapter 98 assessment leaves open (`chapter98_open_item`).

status.description: `needs_facts` when its amount is unknown.

heading.description: The claimed heading that sets it.

provision.description: Key of the HTS provision in `authorities`, or the owner whose assessment states the amount.

reason.description: Why the amount is unknown or which owner status it reflects; null when established.

totals_exclude.description: Every component the published totals leave out because a folded component is unknown, including customs fees (`customs_fees`), which the calculation's own `totals_exclude` does not list.

component_values_usd.description: Total line customs values in USD (not per-item values). Supply each component required by the source expression; omitted is not zero. Sum must not exceed value.

movement.description: Total line customs value in USD for movement; omitted is not zero.

case.description: Total line customs value in USD for case; omitted is not zero.

strap_band_bracelet.description: Total line customs value in USD for strap band bracelet; omitted is not zero.

battery.description: Total line customs value in USD for battery; omitted is not zero.

AuditEntryRequest.description: Only the fields listed here and on each line are accepted; any other key is rejected with `unknown_field`.

base_mfn.description: Ordinary duty; null when its required facts are unresolved.

section_232_specific.description: Present where the line carries a sized Section 232 specific duty (U.S. note 42(a)), stacked on `section_232` and included in the totals.

section_301.description: Section 301 duty for the line's origin (any country scope). section_301_china remains the China-scope mirror.

section_338.description: Section 338 duty on covered products of Canada.

section_201.description: Present where a Section 201 safeguard is billed on the line (U.S. note 41, quartz surface products, headings 9903.45.30 and 9903.45.31).

total_import_charges.description: Expected duty plus customs fees; excludes entered merchandise value.

totals_exclude.description: Components this line's totals leave out; a component listed here is not zero. `ad_cvd` is always listed. A line whose IEEPA or other component amount is unknown is `needs_facts` and its totals are null.

error.description: `not_a_classification`: the line's code is a Chapter 98 or 99 heading, which is claimed against a Chapter 1 to 97 classification rather than audited on its own. See `heading`.

entry_claim_decisions.description: Present with `entry_calculation`: each folded claim's decision (status `applied`).

entry_calculation.description: The same folded calculation /v1/calculate returns for this line (its `entry_treatment`, totals and `calculation_status`): present when a claimed Chapter 98 treatment or 9904 safeguard is finished and folds into the entry total (ruleset entry-total.assembly). The line's `expected` amounts are this calculation's; `expected` is null while any of its components is unknown.

totals_exclude.description: `total_expected_duty` sums complete lines only. `lines_requiring_facts` is listed whenever a line is left out; `lines_requiring_quantity_or_unit_facts` is also listed when a left-out line needs quantity or unit facts for its base duty.

EntryClaimReviewResponse.description: A 422 calculation refusal. Structured claim decisions are present for entry_claim_review_required, not for unrelated authentication errors.

entry_claim_decisions.description: Present when entry_claim_review_required prevents calculation. No duty total or exemption is implied.

import_prohibition.description: Present when `error` is `import_prohibited`: the declared goods are excluded from importation, so no duty total exists.

field.description: Path of the offending request field, e.g. `mode` or `lines[0].freight`.

unknown_fields.description: Present when `error` is `unknown_field`: every rejected key with the accepted names at that level and, when plausible, the intended name.

field.description: Path of the offending request field, e.g. `mode` or `lines[0].freight`.

unknown_fields.description: Present when `error` is `unknown_field`: every rejected key with the accepted names at that level and, when plausible, the intended name.

classification.description: Reporting units for the requested code: `data_unavailable`, because the code is not in the current schedule, unless it is a ten-digit number a statistical note defines for its eight-digit line (chapter 91 statistical note 1), which is `available` with the units the note states.

HtsArchivedEdition.description: An archived official HTS edition, with its effective interval [effective_from, effective_to) and the official source and SHA-256 of the archived file.

release_key.description: Official USITC release identifier of the archived edition.

title.description: Official title of the archived edition.

effective_from.description: First date the edition is in effect (YYYY-MM-DD).

effective_to.description: First date the edition is no longer in effect (exclusive, YYYY-MM-DD). Null when no later archived edition closes it.

source_url.description: Official source URL of the archived edition.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the archived official source file.

HtsCodeStatus.description: Status of a code the current schedule does not list. `historical_inactive`: an archived official HTS edition lists the exact code; it is not a current classification and no duty is calculated for it. `unknown`: neither the current schedule nor the archived editions list it. Dates are stated only when an archived edition or a reviewed official change record proves them; otherwise they are null. `current_alternatives` is present only with an official change record and always requires classifying the goods: no code is substituted.

status.description: `historical_inactive` when an archived official edition lists the exact code; `unknown` otherwise. Codes in the current schedule are answered normally and never carry this object.

hts.description: The requested code in dotted schedule form.

current_schedule.description: Always false: the current schedule does not list this code.

description.description: Official description from the latest archived edition listing the code.

hierarchy.description: Official description path from the latest archived edition listing the code, when the archive records it.

first_listed_in.description: Earliest archived edition that lists the exact code. Not an introduction date: the archive may begin after it.

oneOf.description: No archived edition lists the code.

last_listed_in.description: Latest archived edition that lists the exact code.

oneOf.description: No archived edition lists the code.

removed_on.description: First date the code is no longer listed. Null when the archive does not establish it.

removal_evidence.description: The archived edition or official change record proving `removed_on`. Null when the removal date is unknown.

authority.description: Title of the official edition or change record.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the official source file.

archive_coverage.description: Overall range of the archived editions available to check. Dates inside it without an archived edition are reported as `outside_archive_coverage`.

effective_from.description: First date covered by an archived edition.

effective_to.description: First date after the archived editions (exclusive). Null when the latest archived edition has no end.

as_of.description: Whether the archived edition in effect on the requested date (today when no date is supplied) lists the code.

status.description: `listed` or `not_listed` by the archived edition in effect on the date; `outside_archive_coverage` when no archived edition covers the date.

edition.description: The archived edition in effect on the date, if any.

oneOf.description: No archived edition covers the date.

current_alternatives.description: Current codes named by an official change record for this code. Classification of the goods is still required; no code is substituted. Null without such a record.

hts.description: Current codes named by the change record.

selection_required.description: What must be determined about the goods to choose among them.

source_url.description: Official source URL of the change record.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the change record file.

effective_from.description: Date the change takes effect.

assessment.description: Present on the second `section_232` line of a line carrying a Section 232 specific duty that stacks on the ad valorem `section_232` line (U.S. note 42(a); polysilicon minimum import prices, headings 9903.45.33-9903.45.36): `rate_usd_per_unit` per `unit` of the entry's `quantities`, in full (`specific_basis: per_unit`) or as the shortfall of the entered value below it (`shortfall_below_entered_value`). `not_applicable` when the entered value meets the minimum import price; `needs_facts` names what is missing in `missing_facts`.

heading.description: With `assessment: specific_per_unit`: the chapter 99 heading the specific duty is assessed under.

unit.description: With `assessment: specific_per_unit`: the unit the amount is stated per.

specific_basis.description: With `assessment: specific_per_unit`: how the specific duty is sized; null while the documentation that decides it is undeclared.

quantity.description: With `assessment: specific_per_unit`: the entry's quantity in `unit`, converted from `quantities` where needed.

unit.description: The unit the specific duty is stated per.

entered_value_per_unit_usd.description: With `assessment: specific_per_unit`: the entered value divided by the quantity.

missing_facts.description: On a `needs_facts` line with `assessment: specific_per_unit`: the facts or inputs still needed, such as `polysilicon_mip_documentation`, `quantities (kg)` or `value`.

target_rate_pct.description: For a `needs_facts` measure assessed on top of the standard rate: the combined rate it brings the line to.
